Overview

At ST Engineering iDirect, we’re reshaping the future of global connectivity. As a leader in satellite communications, our groundbreaking technology empowers customers to grow, innovate, and transform their networks. Here, your skills and passion meet our vision and expertise to create something extraordinary. If you're ready to tackle technology’s biggest challenges and redefine how the world connects, the most exciting chapter of your career awaits. With ST Engineering iDirect, the sky isn’t the limit—it’s just the beginning!

We are in search for an Software Engineer at ST Engineering iDirect who will work within the engineering department in a SCRUM team using an Agile framework. The candidate will be responsible for participating in the specification, design, development, testing, and support features for a satellite communications system from concept through completion. He/she will be a highly motivated self-starter with strong written and oral communication skills and work well in a team environment. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with the smartest team, and the very latest technology, then this is the job for you!

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

    • Analyze requirements and RFCs and come up with efficient software designs

    • Participate in determining the future direction of the satellite system and related products in the areas of software architecture, infrastructure performance, test and reliability

    • In an Agile framework, document, design, develop, test, and integrate software functionality for various components within a satellite system and related environments

    • Take a collaborative design and validation approach in working with a multi-functional Scrum team of software, firmware, embedded, application, and test engineers

    • Troubleshoot and provide resolutions for technical issues encountered in the deployment of software solutions.

    • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Technical Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electronics and communication engineering, information technology, a related subject area, or equivalent experience

  • 7+ years hands-on C/C++ software development experience with the ability to design, implement, debug, and maintain PHY-MAC control-plane software running on embedded ARM/Linux or X86 platforms.

  • Hands-on experience developing and optimizing real-time signal-processing algorithms on programmable DSP processors such as CEVA, NXP, or similar architectures.

  • Strong programming experience with Vector C/C++, including SIMD/vectorization and optimization of DSP algorithms for processor-specific architectures.

  • Experience implementing fixed-point DSP and digital communications algorithms on programmable DSP platforms.

  • Experience with development, debugging, profiling, and performance optimization tools for programmable DSP processors.

  • Experience partitioning communications/PHY functionality between FPGA fabric, programmable DSP processors, and embedded ARM processors is highly desirable.

  • Experience integrating programmable DSP-based PHY implementations with higher-layer software, MAC/control software, FPGA interfaces, and embedded ARM processors in a complete modem or wireless communications system.

  • Familiarity with 5G NR/5G NTN MAC and PHY-MAC interactions, including resource grids, slots/frames, numerology, scheduling, transport channels, HARQ, link adaptation, and the mapping of MAC-layer data and control information to physical channels.

  • Proven experience with solving real-time embedded issues, including threading, optimization, memory management, interrupt handling, etc. in multi-core/multi-CPU environments

  • Knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP), Sockets programming

  • Understanding of 3GPP standards, 5G architecture desired

  • Experience with cloud technologies (AWS/Azure) desired

Professional Qualities

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Must be a self-motivated individual with technical leadership potential and proven success in a structured development environment.

  • Possess the ability to proactively drive technical solutions in a collaborative environment.

  • Good software design skills using proven and best practice design methodologies & related principles; Strong command of Object-Oriented Design and Object-Oriented Programming techniques.

  • Demonstrated experience in developing quality and maintainable software.

  • Strong documentation and writing skills.

  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring of junior members of the team.

Additional Requirements

    • Excellent presentation skills required

    • Software design skills with analytical problem-solving abilities

    • Must be able to work in a fast-paced development environment

    • Working knowledge of UML is strongly desirable

    • Knowledge of professional software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

    • Experience/ knowledge in satellite/ terrestrial communications systems is desired

    • Working experience with tools such as GDB and Valgrind

    • Experience with version control systems (such as git) is strongly desired

    • Experience with Jira and Jenkins desired

    • Experience developing unit tests, integration tests, and functional testing, including the development of related test automation integrated in a CI/CD pipeline desired

    • Scripting using shell scripting or Python desired

Blockchain Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Blockchain Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $140,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Blockchain Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade decentralized applications (dApps), smart contract platforms, and blockchain-integrated backend services supporting financial services, digital asset management, and enterprise transaction processing. This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications.
You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages.
  • Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification.
  • Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications.
  • Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems.
  • Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms.
  • Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions.
  • Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components.
  • Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks.
  • Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput.
  • Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions.
  • Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks.
  • Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java.
  • Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts.
  • Experience implementing ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, or custom token standards.
  • Experience integrating wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or enterprise custody platforms.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and blockchain RPC interfaces.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Experience deploying applications on Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting skills in production environments.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum development teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing enterprise blockchain solutions for financial services, healthcare, insurance, or supply chain industries.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperledger Fabric chaincode development using Go or Java.
  • Experience with Layer-2 scaling solutions including Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism.
  • Familiarity with Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Multi-Party Computation (MPC), or privacy-preserving blockchain technologies.
  • Experience implementing decentralized identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC).
  • Knowledge of blockchain security standards, smart contract auditing tools, and common vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow, front-running, and flash loan attacks.
  • Experience using Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Ganache, Brownie, or Remix IDE.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience integrating blockchain applications with enterprise identity providers including Azure Active Directory or OAuth.
  • Blockchain certifications or contributions to open-source blockchain projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a team building a next-generation enterprise blockchain platform supporting:
  • Digital asset tokenization and lifecycle management
  • Smart contract-driven business workflows
  • Enterprise wallet and digital identity integration
  • Real-time blockchain event processing
  • Secure multi-signature transaction approval systems
  • Blockchain analytics and reporting dashboards
  • Cloud-native microservices deployed on Azure and AWS
  • High-availability distributed systems supporting millions of secure transactions annually

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll contribute to architecture, development, deployment, security, and operational excellence across mission-critical blockchain solutions.

How to Apply

jobs.title: Director of Onboarding & Enablement
jobs.excerpt: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien resolution process for personal injury law firms.
jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien resolution process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

We are seeking a Director of Onboarding & Enablement to own how new customers, primarily in our Single Event lien resolution vertical, get from signed agreement to fully running on Zipliens, and to build the training and content library that makes that experience consistent at scale.

This is a founding role. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will own the design and execution of the new customer implementation experience end to end, along with every asset that supports it: internal training and certification, the external knowledge base, tutorial videos, deck content, one-pagers, and in-product guidance. Onboarding today runs on an undocumented framework and a capable team. What it does not yet have is a single owner, measured outcomes, or a content system that keeps pace with the product.

You will build that. You will also define what this function needs to become and make the hiring recommendations that get it there. This role suits someone who has done this before and can operate from a blank page without waiting for direction.

In your first year, you will focus on:

  • Create a standard Onboarding framework and take it from a documented roadmap to a running program with named owners, stage gates, service commitments, and a measured time to value.
  • Define distinct onboarding paths for standard, pilot, and custom engagements, aligned to how we package and sell.
  • Build the customer-facing enablement library: knowledge base, tutorial videos, one-pagers, and training decks, with a governance model that keeps it current.
  • Build the internal enablement curriculum and ramp plan for Customer Success Managers, Account Managers and cross-functional peers, including a defined competency bar.
  • Instrument onboarding KPI’s: completion rates, time to first intake, training participation, and early adoption, reported on a set cadence.
  • Recommend the structure, sequencing, and first hires for the Onboarding & Enablement function.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Onboarding Program Ownership

  • Program Design: Own the end-to-end new customer implementation experience, from signed agreement through steady state, including stage definitions, named owners on both sides, timelines, and service commitments.
  • Execution Accountability: Run onboarding across the book of business, coordinating with Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, Operations Leads, and Product Support so every customer receives the same standard of experience.
  • Path Differentiation: Define and maintain onboarding paths by package and segment, including pilots, custom engagements, cross-product deals, and vertical-specific structures such as Mass Tort matters and programs.
  • Recovery Ownership: Identify onboardings trending off track and own the intervention, including root cause analysis that feeds back into program design.
  • Early Risk & Strategic Alignment: Partner with leaders across Customer Success, Sales & Partnerships, Lien Resolution Operations, Product, and Finance to surface implementation risk early, while it is still correctable, and to align onboarding decisions with broader portfolio health and revenue-impacting strategy.

Enablement Content & Collateral

  • External Content: Start and own the customer-facing knowledge base, tutorial and walkthrough video library, one-pagers, and training materials that support portal adoption and workflow best practices.
  • Training Delivery: Own kickoff and training curriculum design, including live sessions, self-serve paths, and refresher training available for the life of the partnership.
  • Internal Enablement: Build and maintain internal training, certification, and ramp materials for customer-facing teams, and identify capability gaps to fill through structured curriculum.
  • Content Governance: Maintain a single source of truth for all enablement content, with versioning, review cadence, named owners, and brand and voice continuity with marketing guides.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • KPI Ownership: Define and report onboarding and enablement KPIs, including time to value, onboarding completion, training participation, content utilization, and early adoption.
  • AI & Data Enablement: Leverage AI and data to optimize how onboarding runs and what it produces, using adoption, completion, and support signals to pinpoint where customers stall, then applying automation and AI-assisted content development to remove that friction and improve early customer outcomes.
  • Feedback Loop: Own post-onboarding feedback collection and translate results into program changes rather than observations.
  • Product Partnership: Surface onboarding and adoption friction to Product with supporting evidence, and advocate for changes that reduce implementation effort.

jobs.description:
Client Partner – Financial Services
Vertical Relevance | Business Development | 2026

Job Summary

The Client Partner (CP) is a strategic, quota-carrying role focused on growing Vertical Relevance’s business in financial services. You will find and close professional services engagements, build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, and position Vertical Relevance as the partner of choice for AWS cloud and AI transformation. Our model is domain-led, agentic by design, and platform-backed: financial services advisory, agentic AI delivery, and AWS cloud and AI platform engineering.
This role requires a proven track record of selling professional services into financial services firms, including cloud services built on AWS. Vertical Relevance is an AWS Premier Tier Partner, and the CP sells across all seven of our AWS practice competencies, from platform foundations, security, and resiliency through application modernization, data, and AI. GenAI and agentic AI, delivered with AWS and our Anthropic partnership, are a growing part of the portfolio, and the CP should be able to hold a credible conversation about them.

Our Seven AWS Competencies

The Client Partner is expected to understand each competency well enough to find the opportunity, frame the business case, and bring in the competency lead to shape the solution.
  • Enterprise Program Governance / PMO: Program and engagement management, IT transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and integration offices for large cloud programs
  • DevOps: DevOps platforms that deliver infrastructure and deployment pipelines through automation, including account, network, pipeline, and container foundations
  • Security & Compliance: SecOps platforms that deliver security and compliance policies as code, including identity and control foundations, policy as code, and our Control Broker asset
  • SRE & Resiliency: Monitoring, observability, and automated resiliency testing, including game days, chaos experiments, and performance testing for critical workloads
  • App Modernization: Re-designing, re-factoring, and re-platforming applications to run AWS-native, including monolith-to-microservices and migration programs
  • Data & Analytics: DataOps platforms for data ingestion, governance, and analytics, including lakehouse, data mesh, data marketplace, and catalog work
  • AI: Designing, building, and tuning AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker) and with Anthropic Claude
Each competency is backed by 35+ AWS reusable solution accelerators (playbooks, blueprints, modules, and libraries) that shorten timelines and reduce risk. The CP uses these assets to differentiate Vertical Relevance in every pursuit.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development
  • Identify and close new professional services opportunities across banks, asset and wealth managers, insurers, and payments firms
  • Build pipeline across all seven AWS competencies, and connect opportunities across them (for example, a migration that leads to security, resiliency, and data work)
  • Use personal networks, AWS account teams, and internal relationships to generate qualified pipeline
  • Run the pursuit from first meeting through executive briefings, assessments, proofs of value, and SOW
Direct Sales, AWS Partnership & Co-Sell (in priority order)
  • 1. Lead direct sales: Own and lead direct sales with financial services clients: originate opportunities, run the pursuit, build the relationship with the economic buyer, and close the SOW. Direct selling is the core of this role and the primary measure of success.
  • 2. Work the AWS partnership: Work closely with AWS account managers, partner development managers, and AWS field teams. Build joint account plans, use AWS funding and buying programs such as MAP, proof-of-concept funding, and AWS Marketplace, and position Vertical Relevance’s AWS Premier Tier status and competencies (Financial Services, Security, DevOps, Resilience, and GenAI).
  • 3. Co-sell with partners: Run co-sell motions with partners, including AWS ProServe engagements and staffing requests through the AWS partner delivery process, and joint pursuits with Anthropic and other technology partners.
GenAI & Agentic AI
  • Identify where GenAI and agentic AI create value for clients, such as operations, reconciliation, vulnerability management, software engineering productivity, and client service
  • Position our GenAI Center of Excellence, agentic reconciliation, and AI-driven vulnerability management (Mythos/Glasswing) offerings, delivered with AWS and Anthropic
  • Address the questions financial services buyers ask about AI: model risk, data privacy, security, controls, and regulatory expectations
Client Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at target accounts, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, and business line heads
  • Position Vertical Relevance as a strategic partner for business and technology consulting
  • Manage client relationships through the full sales cycle and into delivery
Collaboration & Strategy
  • Work with delivery teams to build competitive proposals, estimates, and SOWs
  • Build joint go-to-market plans with our technology partners, including AWS, Anthropic (Claude), and ServiceNow
  • Bring in competency leads and solution architects at the right moment to shape solutions, demos, and proposals
  • Drive account planning to expand within existing clients and win new logos
Sales Execution
  • Manage multiple deal cycles at once while keeping pipeline and forecast data accurate in the CRM
  • Meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas through strategic, outcome-based engagements
  • Grow accounts through a steady series of follow-on SOWs and change requests, using each delivered engagement to open the next
  • Restructure scope and pricing when a client’s budget or priorities shift, so the deal stays alive without giving up agreed principles
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle past signature: client procurement and vendor risk steps, resource requests, onboarding, billing start, milestone invoicing, and collections
Leadership & Advocacy
  • Act as a trusted advisor who understands each client’s business challenges and offers tailored solutions
  • Represent Vertical Relevance at industry events, executive roundtables, and partner forums to build brand awareness and thought leadership in financial services cloud and AI

What Great Looks Like Day to Day

Our best Client Partners share a set of daily habits. We are looking for someone who already works this way.
  • Runs every meeting with purpose. Every client meeting has a written agenda sent in advance and an internal prep session. Within hours of the call, a recap goes out with decisions, owners, and target dates.
  • Keeps a steady executive cadence. Sends a weekly executive status report to the client sponsor ahead of the standing call, and sets up short, frequent touchpoints to drive contracts and onboarding through to closure.
  • Captures and shares account intelligence. Writes up what was heard, the business problem behind it, the opportunity for Vertical Relevance, and specific next steps. Turns a single conversation into a working account plan.
  • Multi-threads every account. Builds relationships across the CIO, CTO, CISO, Chief Data Officer, head of cloud, and business sponsors, and tracks reorganizations, budget changes, and who influences each decision.
  • Leads with the client’s problem. Frames the opportunity as an end-to-end business outcome, not another tool or dashboard, and points to where agentic AI removes manual work.
  • Invests in face time. Plans onsite working sessions that pair tactical delivery support with strategic planning for the next phase, such as agentic process transformation.
  • Brings the right people in. Pulls in solution architects and security or AI experts to debrief and shape the pursuit, and brings in Vertical Relevance founders for senior client conversations.
  • Follows through relentlessly. Chases the open item personally, whether it’s a signature, a start date, a background check, or an overdue invoice, and doesn’t let it sit.
  • Uses judgment and discretion. Knows when to respond and when to let the client sponsor handle an internal issue, and protects confidential information about client people and politics.
  • Credits the team. Recognizes the delivery team’s work with clients and internally, and treats delivery as part of the sale.

Skills & Qualifications

Experience
  • Required: Minimum of 3 years selling professional services (consulting, systems integration, or technology services) into the financial services industry. Software or product-only sales experience does not meet this requirement.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience selling AWS cloud services, such as platform foundations, DevOps, security and compliance, resiliency, migration and modernization, data and analytics, or AI engagements.
  • Required: Track record of leading direct sales with financial services clients as the primary relationship owner, not only through partner-sourced deals
  • Experience working with AWS partnership teams (account managers, partner development managers, AWS programs and funding)
  • Active or past responsibility for co-selling with partners such as AWS ProServe or Anthropic is a plus
  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding quotas for professional services, including scoping engagements, pricing time-and-materials and fixed-fee work, and closing SOWs
Knowledge Required: Our Three Practice Pillars
Vertical Relevance goes to market as “Domain-led. Agentic by design. Platform-backed.” The Client Partner must be able to explain all three pillars, show how they connect in a single client program, and know when to bring in each practice lead.
  • 1. Financial Services Advisory (the domain layer): Enough financial services and regulatory fluency to lead the business conversation: AI value and strategy (use-case portfolios, value roadmaps, and operating model change for AI adoption); governance, risk, and regulatory work (GRC and regulatory remediation, model and agent governance frameworks); program leadership (transformation and integration offices, agile requirements and delivery management); and data strategy (data management and architecture for AI).
  • 2. Agentic AI Delivery (what we build): Enough understanding of production AI to sell it credibly and qualify it honestly: taking agentic pilots to production (for example, a 90-day agentic pilot on Amazon Bedrock); human-in-the-loop design with full audit lineage; financial services domain agents such as trading-desk and RFQ automation, risk and pricing analytics, and risk, surveillance, and regulatory-reporting agents; and vulnerability remediation at scale, including AI-accelerated discovery, triage, and remediation, legacy code remediated with Claude on Amazon Bedrock, and governed post-patch regression testing.
  • 3. AWS Cloud & AI Platform Engineering (where it runs): Solid working knowledge of AWS in regulated industries, across our seven competencies: AWS cloud transformation (migrations, landing zones and Control Tower, cloud security, compliance, and data-perimeter engineering, data and analytics platforms); modernization and resilience (application modernization to cloud- and AI-native, SRE and resiliency engineering); AI foundations on AWS (Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore architectures, Claude deployed in the client’s own AWS environment); and enablement (AWS- and Anthropic-certified delivery teams, co-funded delivery through AWS partner programs, and agent governance for identity, permissions, and audit).
  • Bringing it together: Ability to connect the pillars into one story. For example: a regulatory or risk problem (Pillar 1) is solved with a governed agentic workflow (Pillar 2) running on a secure, resilient AWS platform (Pillar 3).
  • Differentiators: Ability to position our differentiators: 20+ years leading tier-1 financial services transformation, AWS Premier Tier Services Partner status with co-funded solutions, agentic AI in production on Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude, proprietary reusable solution accelerators (RSAs), and human-in-the-loop design with audit lineage a regulator can follow.
Other Qualifications
  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in business terms at every level of an organization
  • Familiarity with business development methods, including technology roadmaps, assessments, and proofs of value
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degrees or certifications in cloud (e.g., AWS), AI, or related fields are a plus

Industry & Solution Focus

  • Financial Services: Wealth Management, Asset Management, Insurance, Banking, Cards / Payments
  • AWS Cloud Transformation: Enterprise Program Governance / PMO, DevOps, Security & Compliance, SRE & Resiliency, App Modernization, Data & Analytics, and AI
  • Artificial Intelligence: GenAI and agentic AI with Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude
  • Client Solutions: ServiceNow

Why Join Vertical Relevance?

At Vertical Relevance, you’ll work alongside industry experts who average more than 20 years of financial services experience, and alongside AWS practitioners who build cloud platforms, modernize applications, and deploy GenAI and agentic AI for some of the largest firms in the industry. We offer a collaborative environment focused on delivering meaningful results for clients while fostering professional growth for our people.
Vertical Relevance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you'll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

The Director, Business Development (DBD) is responsible for market expansion, pipeline development, and revenue growth across pharmacy, PBM, and pharmacy-adjacent market segments. The DBD will independently identify, pursue, and lead outbound business development efforts to form lasting and productive contract relationships with strategic target customers. The DBD is expected to maintain deep market expertise to develop and execute BD strategy to identify and contract new use-case innovations, prove their value, and generate new revenue and commercial opportunities. The DBD will help shape market strategy, originate new commercial opportunities through discovery, and contribute to DrFirst’s growth engine.

The ideal DBD is a market-maker and category-builder with a deep expertise in medication management, pharmacy, and PBM ecosystems who can enter a nascent market segment and drive it to scale. This person is a hunter, self-starter, with a disciplined approach to business development strategy and execution. They prospect relentlessly, build conviction-driven business cases, negotiate complex agreements, and drive deals to close with urgency. Succes is measured by contracting high-value prospects for key products/services with terms and execution plans that accelerate time-to-market, user adoption, and market share. This role demands the discipline to manage a rigorous BD process, the influence to command executive-level conversations, and the ownership mindset to treat Gadget’s commercial success as a personal mandate. This position reports directly to the Executive Vice President.

Who will love this job

  • A driver who works with purpose and passion; someone who will elevate our team through new perspectives, ideas, and solutions.
  • A pharmacy and PBM market expert who brings deep, current knowledge of pharmacy, PBM, and medication management ecosystems and can immediately identify high impact market entry points.
  • A healthcare sales veteran who understands challenges, trends, and opportunities in the healthcare market and how HIT vendors serve this market.
  • A proven consultative sales performer who can influence and deliver value to customer executives and exceed growth-minded company revenue goals.
  • A market expander who can independently identify and break into new pharmacy and PBM market segments, building DrFirst’s commercial presence in white space before the competition recognizes the opportunity.
  • A channel expert who understands how to build mutually beneficial and lasting relationships with channel customers, including ongoing collaboration on solution enhancements that drive joint success.
  • A strategic opportunist who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly from market insight to commercial action, and consistently finds the angle that turns a complex healthcare challenge into a growth opportunity.
  • A builder that enjoys developing new business opportunities, strategies, and solutions with Pharmacy, PBM, and HIT vendors.

Get To Know Us!

WebTPA, a GuideWell Company, is a healthcare third-party administrator with over 30+ years of experience building unique benefit solutions and managing customized health plans.

What is your impact?

The RN Case Manager primary responsibility is to create, implement, and monitor treatment plans to assist patients/members in meeting their healthcare goals. This would include understanding the member's healthcare benefits and healthcare best practices needed for effective treatment planning.

About Zapata Quantum

Zapata Quantum is shaping the future of quantum computing: setting the standards for what’s viable, valuable, and worth building. The Company powers quantum applications across cryptography, pharmaceuticals, finance, materials discovery, defense, and beyond, translating cutting-edge research into real-world impact.

Zapata is the only organization to have contributed across every technical area of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking program, giving it a uniquely comprehensive view of what it takes to make quantum computing work in practice. Now restructured and sharply focused, Zapata Quantum stands alone as the only publicly traded, pure-play quantum software company fully dedicated to unlocking quantum’s commercial potential.

We’re rebuilding at a pivotal moment for the industry—bringing together a team that will help define how quantum delivers value in the real world, with the opportunity for meaningful ownership as we shape the commercial path forward.

About the role

We are seeking a Quantum Solutions Engineer to work directly with clients to solve real-world problems with quantum computing. This role sits at the intersection of customer engagement and applied quantum engineering—partnering with clients to understand their use cases, then designing, developing, testing, and benchmarking the quantum algorithms and workflows that turn those use cases into deliverable solutions.

You will own end-to-end technical engagements: scoping problems with customers in domains such as cryptography, chemistry, finance, materials discovery, and defense; translating them into concrete quantum circuits and workflows; performing rigorous resource estimation on both near-term and fault-tolerant hardware; and communicating results clearly back to stakeholders. You will partner closely with quantum software engineers, research scientists, and domain experts, and contribute to deliverables for government and commercial programs.

This position offers a high level of individual ownership and is well-suited to engineers who are comfortable working independently within a small, focused team and engaging directly with technical and business stakeholders. This position is classified as exempt under applicable wage and hour laws.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with clients to scope, develop, test, and deliver quantum proof-of-concept and production engagements that demonstrate measurable value for their use cases
  • Develop, implement, and test quantum algorithms and end-to-end workflows for applications in cryptography, chemistry, finance, materials science, and defense
  • Perform end-to-end resource estimation for quantum workloads on both near-term (NISQ) and fault-tolerant hardware architectures, and communicate trade-offs to clients
  • Build, benchmark, and harden circuit compilation, error mitigation, and algorithmic primitives in service of client deliverables
  • Translate customer and domain-specific problems into well-posed quantum computational tasks and reproducible workflows
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact during client engagements, communicating progress, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Contribute to technical reports, customer-facing deliverables, peer-reviewed publications, and government program deliverables
  • Partner with internal software engineers and scientists to improve the quality, correctness, and performance of product and solution deliverables
  • Independently analyze complex scientific and engineering problems and drive them to a working, validated solution

Qualifications

À propos de Dialogue

Dialogue est le principal fournisseur de soins virtuels au Canada. En perfectionnant notre Plateforme de santé intégrée, nous offrons des programmes exceptionnels de santé et de bien-être en ligne (soins primaires, santé mentale, TCCi, PAE et bien-être) aux organisations qui souhaitent améliorer le bien-être de leurs employé(e)s et de leurs familles.

Lorsqu'il s'agit de notre travail, nous plaçons la barre très haut. Ensemble, nous transformons la santé et aidons des millions de personnes à améliorer leur bien-être. Nous croyons fermement qu’une équipe exceptionnelle exige plus pour sa :

  • Croissance

En étroite collaboration avec Elise Gagné, la cheffe d'équipe des services PAE, votre rôle consistera à conseiller les client(-e)s dans leurs objectifs de bien-être nutritionnel en proposant des solutions pratiques adaptées à leurs besoins spécifiques et à leurs préférences. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Authoring Tools (Remote, Greece or Cyprus)
jobs.excerpt: At LearnWorlds, we believe learning is the original human superpower — the force that turns knowledge into products, skills, and progress.
jobs.description:
At LearnWorlds, we believe learning is the original human superpower — the force that turns knowledge into products, skills, and progress.

Our platform helps creators, educators, and organizations in more than 150 countries turn expertise into scalable learning experiences that sell, teach, and transform. As AI floods the world with information, learning becomes the only countermeasure — the skill that keeps humans creative, relevant, and in control. The winners won’t be those who automate fastest, but those who learn and adapt fastest. They’ll need platforms that turn knowledge into teachable systems that scale — and that’s exactly what LearnWorlds enables.

Build. Ship. Learn. Improve. (Repeat.)

We’re redefining how people create and share online learning—and we’re doing it with engineers who care deeply about product quality, clean architecture, and meaningful impact.

We’re a remote-first, fast-growing EdTech SaaS with a global footprint. Our Engineering team builds the core experiences that thousands of educators and learners rely on daily. We move fast, we collaborate tightly, and we’re constantly leveling up—both as individuals and as a team.

We’re now looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Authoring Tools team—the team behind the experiences and tools our customers use to create engaging learning content.

This is a full-stack role with a strong frontend engineering focus. You’ll work extensively with Vue.js, while staying comfortable moving into our PHP backend whenever the product requires it. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where small groups of engineers own projects end to end, collaborate closely with Product and Design, and continuously iterate as requirements and opportunities evolve.

We’re looking for an Εngineer who combines strong technical judgment with adaptability, ownership, and a pragmatic approach to software development. Someone who can explain not only what they would build, but why and who is excited to use AI-assisted coding as part of their everyday engineering workflow.

If you’re a proactive builder who loves solving real product challenges, this is where you’ll do your best work.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and ship full-stack features for our Authoring Tools, from backend logic to polished, intuitive frontend experiences.
  • Take strong ownership of frontend architecture in Vue.js, applying thoughtful design patterns and helping us evolve consistent engineering practices.
  • Write clean, scalable backend services in PHP, focusing on performance, robustness, and maintainability.
  • Own work end to end—from understanding the problem and estimating the work to implementation, code review, iteration, and release.
  • Work across multiple projects and initiatives in parallel, adapting quickly as product requirements, priorities, and scope evolve.
  • Collaborate closely with PMs and designers—not simply implementing handed-off designs, but discussing solutions, sharing technical context, and shaping the final product together.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, giving clear, constructive feedback and being equally open to receiving it from your peers.
  • Make pragmatic decisions when working with both modern and legacy code, knowing when to improve, refactor, or build on what already exists.
  • Use AI-powered coding tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) throughout development and code review to move faster while maintaining strong engineering judgment and quality.
  • Keep the broader product and business context in mind, balancing technical quality with speed, customer impact, and the realities of shipping software.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll work on the tools at the heart of how LearnWorlds customers create learning experiences used by tens of millions of learners around the world.
  • You’ll have meaningful ownership: once you take on a problem, you’ll have the autonomy to drive it all the way to release.
  • You’ll work deeply on frontend engineering while remaining close to the full product stack.
  • You’ll collaborate directly with Product and Design and have real influence over how solutions are shaped—not just how they’re implemented.
  • You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, iteration, and pragmatic engineering are part of everyday work.
  • You’ll be part of a collaborative engineering team where ideas and feedback can come from anyone, regardless of title or seniority.
  • You’ll have room to challenge existing patterns, improve legacy areas of the product, and help shape how Authoring Tools evolve.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Prefer ownership over hand-holding and can independently move a problem from idea to production.
  • Are highly adaptable and comfortable when requirements, priorities, or scope change along the way.
  • Think speed and quality can (and should) co-exist.
  • Ask “why” before “how,” and can clearly explain the reasoning and trade-offs behind your technical decisions.
  • Care about frontend architecture and understand the difference between simply knowing a framework and knowing how to structure maintainable applications.
  • Are pragmatic about legacy code—you don’t need everything to be greenfield to do great work.
  • Give thoughtful, constructive feedback and are equally comfortable receiving it, regardless of someone’s title or years of experience.
  • Stay humble, curious, and open to changing your mind when new information emerges.
  • Keep product and business impact in mind rather than treating engineering decisions in isolation.
  • Believe AI won’t replace engineers—but it will empower the best ones.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, ideally in complex SaaS or product environments.
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript and Vue.js, with solid knowledge of frontend architecture, design patterns, anti-patterns, and maintainable UI development.
  • Proficiency in PHP and the ability to work confidently across backend services when needed.
  • A frontend-leaning full-stack mindset: frontend may be your strongest area, but you’re comfortable understanding, debugging, and contributing across the full stack.
  • Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, HTTP fundamentals, and modern frontend application architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with both relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and noSQL (MongoDB) databases.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason about technical decisions and articulate the trade-offs behind them.
  • Experience working with and evolving legacy codebases, with a pragmatic approach to refactoring and incremental improvement.
  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, manage changing requirements, and take ownership through delivery and release.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including giving and receiving constructive technical feedback.
  • High attention to detail and a product-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day engineering workflow.
  • Native or near-native Greek speaker, with a good working command of English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building complex authoring tools, editors, content creation experiences, or highly interactive web applications.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or microservices architectures.
  • Exposure to or interest in Go.
  • Experience in EdTech, LMS systems, or other complex SaaS products.
  • Experience working in small, autonomous engineering groups across multiple parallel product initiatives.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and contributing technical thinking during the design process.
  • GitHub repos, open-source contributions, or personal projects you’re proud of.

Benefits

  • Private life and health insurance plan
  • Fully remote work if you prefer to work from home, apart from when we have team meetings a few times per year
  • Your personal annual training budget
  • An annual home office allowance to set up your personal space
  • Company laptop
  • 23 days of paid time off
  • 3 early summer Fridays in July and August
  • Access to AI tools at work
  • A free LearnWorlds School to build and sell your own courses
  • Company retreats & other onsite team activities (see the video of our latest retreat).

Our recruitment process is designed to give you multiple opportunities to showcase your skills and experience - while also getting to know LearnWorlds and the people you could be working with.

Depending on the role, the process may include initial conversations with members of our team, recorded AI-assisted technical interviews, take-home assignments, and live assessment sessions. While we may use AI-assisted tools as part of the process, hiring decisions are always made by people. Our hiring team reviews the relevant recordings, transcripts, and assessment results before deciding on the next steps.

You can have a look at our AI Interview Privacy Notice here.

Become a part of our caring community

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 60 health benefits company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. It has transformed itself from the largest US nursing home company in the ’60s, to the largest US hospital corporation in the ’80s, to a leading health benefits company beginning in the ’90s. Today, Humana is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and is one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country.

The Enterprise Growth Strategy team is a newly created organization supporting growth across Humana’s businesses. The team has a strong dotted-line partnership with the Medicare and Medicaid organization, Humana’s largest, which comprises over 80% of the company’s total revenue and the majority of its earnings. Team members partner with the senior leaders of the business unit, and more broadly with leaders throughout the enterprise, as they deliver strategy projects addressing some of the businesses’ most important opportunities and challenges. These high-profile strategy projects place the team at the forefront of helping to define the future of Humana’s largest businesses.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member to support delivering some of Medicare and Medicaid’s highest priority projects and initiatives, with an emphasis on Medicare Advantage strategy development. As a Manager, you will deconstruct issues and challenges, perform targeted research and analysis, and craft sound, logical solutions and recommendations. You will also shape implementation considerations, and work with business owners as appropriate to transition analysis into execution. While doing so, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with fellow team members, subject matter experts, members of Humana’s executive Management Team, and corporate, functional, and business unit leaders.

This role will have a particular focus on Medicare enrollment growth strategy and investment optimization. The Strategy Manager will help develop a framework that takes into account key dimensions of growth strategy such as marketing as well as sales and product investment trade-offs that are responsive to local competitive and provider dynamics. The Strategy Manager will be responsible for driving the development of deep consumer and competitor insights to inform key strategic choices that support sustainable enterprise growth.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing analysis and/or work streams within high-profile, high-impact strategy projects

  • Leading interviews and working sessions with leaders within Medicare and Medicaid and across the broader organization

  • Conducting industry, market, competitor, and financial analysis and identifying insights for Humana

  • Working collaboratively with fellow team members and leaders across the company


Use your skills to make an impact

40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

jobs.description:
💸 EUR 34,000- 38,000 full time, permanent employment contract
🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Europe!

🏖️ 33 days paid leave and Benefits

🎬 Working with globally recognisable entertainment and media brands across German-speaking and international markets
✨ An account support role with AI agents, skills and smarter workflows at the centre of how work gets done
💻 High-end, fast computer and all the latest software and AI tools you'll need

Note - it is essential you are either fluent/near-fluent in German

About the Role

Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

As an Account Coordinator, you will support Account Managers and client teams by turning client priorities, agreed direction and account context into clear action. You will help keep delegated work moving: tracking follow-ups, preparing updates, coordinating information, checking quality, supporting client communication, and making sure the people around you know what is happening and what needs to happen next.

This is a German-speaking role. Native or near-native spoken and written German is required, and you need to move confidently between English internal communication and German client or community-facing work. That means understanding nuance, tone, grammar and cultural context, not just translating words from one language to another.

We're not talking about using AI as a search box or an autocomplete. The person we're looking for treats AI as a capable pair of hands. They delegate whole pieces of work, not just questions. They review what comes back with a sharp, critical eye. And they keep refining how they brief and direct it, so the quality compounds. If you read that and thought "that's just how I work now," this role is built for you.

You'll learn the ground first: how our account teams work, what strong client support looks like, and the quality bar for clear client updates, well-structured account workflows, audience-ready German communication and reliable follow-through. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this role gets done.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients across entertainment, media, technology and online communities.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We build products, produce content at scale, design smarter ways for clients and internal teams to work, and keep looking for new ways to improve how the company operates.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

What You'll Make Happen

  • Support Account Managers and client teams with delegated client tasks, account priorities, workflows and coordination needs, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working, not an afterthought.

  • Turn client requests, Account Manager direction and account context into clear tasks, updates, handovers, next steps or questions for the right people.

  • Keep delegated work organised and visible: actions, deadlines, decisions, approvals, blockers, status updates, tracker fields and follow-ups should be clear enough that others can trust what is happening.

  • Communicate promptly and clearly with Account Managers, collaborators and clients where appropriate, especially when work is time-sensitive or when a delay, missing detail or unclear owner could affect the client experience.

  • Move easily between English and German work: understand English internal context, produce natural German client or community-facing communication, and judge instantly when language sounds accurate, useful and culturally right.

  • Own repeatable account workflows and delegated account processes, using AI and better workflows to improve speed, structure, reliability and quality over time.

  • Build client, service and strategy understanding so you can use stronger judgement, spot risks early and escalate with clear context, options and evidence when senior input is needed.

  • Coordinate stakeholders professionally when feedback, assets, approvals, decisions or commitments are missing or late.

  • Check your own work carefully before handing it over, including a sharp, critical review of anything AI touched.

  • Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you.

Your Expertise

  • Native or near-native spoken and written German is required, plus strong written English and the ability to move between English internal context and German client or community-facing outputs that feel natural, accurate and audience-appropriate.

  • Clear, professional client communication: you know how to give useful status updates, ask focused questions, flag risks early and avoid vague or confusing messages.

  • Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools and AI agents in your real work, studies or personal projects: genuine capability, not just curiosity.

  • Strong judgement when reviewing AI output against the brief, context, audience, language quality and client need. You never treat AI output as finished work by default.

  • A systems thinker: you see repeatable work as a workflow to design and improve, not a list of tasks to grind through.

  • High agency and ownership: comfortable taking delegated work forward, spotting what needs doing, and driving improvements to completion, not just proposing them.

  • Strong prioritisation in a remote, async environment, including knowing when something is time-sensitive and when a small delay needs to be communicated.

  • Good technical adaptability: you can learn new tools, trackers, documentation systems, AI workflows and client processes quickly, and you troubleshoot before escalating.

  • Strong attention to detail, held at speed: you check your work carefully before handover and keep quality high even when work is moving quickly.

  • Curiosity about media, entertainment, creators, online communities and how client work gets delivered at scale.

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack

We do not expect you to make do with outdated tools while talking about innovation. Storm has an AI Operations team, approved tools, practical workflows and a strong appetite for better ways of working.

Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.

Team-Based, International, Remote-First

You'll be part of an international team of 175+ people. We work remotely, communicate clearly, and rely on people who can keep work visible without needing to sit in the same room.

Remote-First & Flexible

This role is fully remote. You will need to work reliably from 9:00–18:00 CET/CEST so you can support German-speaking work and collaborate with UK/EU-based teammates and clients. Final country-specific details will be confirmed before publishing.

Recruitment Process

  • Apply in English with your CV and any work you want to show us. It's optional but would be a bonus! Anything you think might be relevant.
  • Shortlisted applicants will answer a set of self-recorded video questions. We will use these to understand how you think, how you communicate, and how you already work with AI.
  • Next, you will meet with the recruitment team or account leadership. We will talk through your experience, working style, German/English communication, client judgement, and how you approach remote, async work.
  • You will then complete a short, time-boxed practical task built around a realistic account support brief. We'll ask you to show your working, including how you used AI to get it done. Your method interests us as much as your output.
  • The final stage is a second interview with a senior leader.

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We're more interested in your judgement, your communication, your language quality, and how you work with AI than in a perfect traditional CV.

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

About the Role

We're looking for a Community Manager – Algo Business to build one of the most trusted crypto algo trading communities.

India's algo traders are scattered across Telegram groups, Discord servers and Twitter threads. We want Delta to be where that community actually lives — where a beginner deploys their first bot and an experienced quant compares notes on execution.

This role is for someone who genuinely loves talking to algo traders. You'll spend your days in conversation with users — in Online forums, on calls, at meetups — and turn what you learn into content, events and product feedback. Success isn't measured in follower counts, but in how many traders are actively building and deploying on Delta.

  • Be the first responder: answer questions, unblock traders, escalate bugs, make sure no API question goes unanswered.
  • Identify and nurture power users and strategy builders; run ambassador and early-access programmes.
  • Plan and execute offline meetups, hackathons and strategy competitions across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and other hubs — plus online AMAs, workshops and guest sessions.

  • A real understanding of algo trading — you know what a backtest is, why slippage matters, what a webhook does. You don't need to be a quant, but you can't be faking it in front of one.

  • Ability to write Python well enough to build demos and debug user issues.

jobs.excerpt: About KadinceKadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote (must live in the USA) software company founded in 2013.
jobs.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote (must live in the USA) software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions do their jobs more efficiently.

Kadince has been profitable for several years (we’re fans of making more than we spend). We’re bootstrapped, which means we don’t have investors. So our owners answer to no one. And they aren’t just giving us commands from their vacation homes waiting to cash their next check. They’re fellow team members and in the trenches with us.

Why We’re Hiring

After our team members, our customers are our most important focus. As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re dedicated to giving each customer the best experience possible, which means having enough people to take care of all their needs. We’re growing quickly and so are the needs of our customers. That’s why we’re increasing the size of our development team.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a web developer at Kadince we prefer you have 5+ years of experience. This experience has given you an understanding of basic database driven web applications and a proficient knowledge of the MVC pattern. You understand that software development is all about the end-user (again, we really care about our customers).

You have a desire to continually learn and improve your development skills. We love giving team members opportunities to improve their skills, whether through online courses, workshops, or learning from others.

You’re able to adapt quickly to new environments, are organized and focused, can look beyond current constraints (you know, forest through the trees), and can provide solutions to complex problems. Simply put, we need a problem solver, not a taskmaster.

Our vision, mission, and core values should resonate with you. That’ll be crucial to your success and happiness if you join the Kadince team.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our dev team (hopefully you are), you probably want to know more about our tech-stack. Outside of our dev team, we’re not really sure what most of this means, but we sure hope you do.

Technologies/Frameworks

  • Ruby on Rails
  • GraphQL
  • Postgres
  • Redis
  • ReactJS
  • Minitest
  • Cypress

DevOps

  • Kubernetes
  • Helm
  • Docker
  • CircleCI

Other Tools

  • Jira
  • Rubymine
  • Sentry
  • Logrocket
  • Wooly Bugger

Our Vision and Mission

Our vision and mission aren’t something we hung on the office wall and forgot about. Seriously, we don’t have an office, let alone a wall to hang them on. But our vision, mission, and core values sit on the desks of each of our team members. And we discuss them regularly in our meetings. Your goals and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) will be developed to ensure you’re working to help us achieve our vision and mission.

Our vision and mission are what get us up each morning. They, in addition to our core values, help us make decisions.

Vision - Setting the standard for operating a great software company.

We’re big fans of author Jim Collins and his best-selling book, Good to Great (bonus points if you’ve read it). While there are lots of good software companies out there, we want to be one of the great ones.

The first word of our vision is also significant. To go “high school English class” on you, the present participle “setting” illustrates that we’re not looking to set the standard and then be done, but that the standard is always moving and we’re always chasing it. We continually stop to recognize the awesome things we’ve done and then look for ways to do them even better.

Mission - Building the best software for compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions.

As Jim Collins taught in his Hedgehog Concept (told you we think he’s great—pun intended), great companies need to determine what they can be the best at in the world and focus on that. There are so many things we could solve as a software company, but we’ve found what we think we can be the best in the world at and we stick to it every day.

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  1. Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  2. People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  3. Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  4. Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  5. Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

What a Day in the Life of a Web Developer Looks Like

Your day starts with a development team meeting where you go through announcements, sync up projects, and discuss any potential issues. After the meeting, you put your head down and work on your assigned tickets in Jira.

You spend the first part of the day reviewing your notes and prioritizing tasks for the junior developers. You make sure that you and the other developers are working on the most important tasks first, but you’re free to choose which ones you work on.

For lunch, you meet a friend at the cafe near his work. You haven’t seen your friend for a few months, so you talk about life and your careers. You can’t help but feel very lucky for the freedom you have to take a long lunch break and meet your friend, as he has to hurry back to the office and get working right at the hour.

Back at home, you continue working on tickets in Jira. At one point a junior web developer calls you on Slack and asks how to fix an issue. You expertly show him the process and he thanks you for being so helpful.

You notice that another developer has been really on top of it today, so you mention them in the company Slack channel and thank them for being so awesome. Many of your team members respond to your shoutout with party emojis and hearts.

In the afternoon your team has a standup meeting where you discuss what projects you’re all working on and whether there’s anything anyone can do to help. Your leader points out one of the awesome projects you’re working on and thanks you for being so attentive to the users’ needs.

After the standup you do some QA and manually test a couple of the changes your team made today. You write automated tests to ensure the functionality that was just worked on. You find one little bug, which you log and then fix easily.

You finish up your day by taking a look at tomorrow’s schedule and planning accordingly.

When and Where You’d Work and What You’d Work On

Kadince is a principle-based company, which means we focus on principles, not policies. You’ll work with your leader, Aaron Venezia, each week to review your goals/KPI and what you’ve been working on. You’ll meet regularly with the Development team to learn, keep projects on track, and ensure that goals/KPIs are being reached.

While we aren’t super particular about when and where you work, you’ll need to work around the schedules of other team members to ensure that goals stay on track and nothing falls through the cracks. Overall, your schedule needs to help you achieve our vision and mission and demonstrate our core values. After all, this is a full-time job, and we treat it that way!

At Kadince, work won’t tie you down to one location. You’ll be free to travel or relocate as you get the itch to try somewhere new. Want to spend a month abroad, working from a hotel and exploring the rest of the time? Go ahead. Just make sure you have a reliable high-speed internet connection (as if you would go anywhere without it anyway) and turn on the blurry filter during video calls so we don’t get jealous. We seriously get jealous. One of our teammates recently had zebras running around in the background of a video call during a team meeting. Come to find out he was working from the deck of his hotel at the Animal Kingdom in Disney World. Even though we were jealous, we thought it was pretty cool.

Who You’d Be Working With

We have over 50 team members (which makes us really happy since Kadince was started by two people in their basements). If hired, you’ll probably work with each team member in one way or another. Some of the people you’ll work with most frequently are:

Aaron makes sure that Kadince software runs smoothly and that any problems are addressed quickly and efficiently. When it comes to software wizards, he’s the Dumbledore of web developers (but really, he wishes he was Voldemort). He’s been here since nearly the beginning of Kadince, so he’s seen it all. Aaron loves to go skiing and mountain biking, as well as play video games and pinball (can you beat him?). He’s very proud of the fact that he’s his tiny dog’s favorite person, and he has a strange passion for curly fries.

Bernardo (better known around here as Beans) has been a web developer at Kadince since 2014. He’s originally from Chile, but has lived in Utah since he was 12. He loves to code, play video games, spend time with his wife, kids, and dogs. He also loves to learn new things. If he could do anything in the world he would go to space (although technically that’s not in this world, now is it?).

Luis is a senior web developer and has worked for Kadince since 2019. He likes to hike, run, and be outdoors. Luis is fun and gets along with everyone, so feel free to joke around and have a good time. Just don’t play Rocket League with him. He WILL beat you. Actually, do play, lots of the other developers do. And if you’re lucky, he might share his grandma’s tamales with you.

Benefits

Since we’re a remote company, we don’t offer office snacks and ping pong tables. But if you’re a fan of “core benefits” that bring great rewards and peace of mind, you’ll like what we have to offer. Competitive pay, 401(k) matching, generous paid leave, insurance (medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability), and a flex spending account. Yeah, it’s pretty great...

And we love to spoil our team. We celebrate big events with you, like birthdays and work anniversaries, so you can expect some pretty fun gifts. We once sent some high-quality lip balm to each team member so we could all play a prank on Scott, our Director of Product. We’re fun like that. And this year we’re giving every team member the last week of the year off (we like to spread holiday cheer).

How to Apply

Applicants who stand out are those who are interested in working for Kadince, not just applying for as many positions as possible or trying to keep unemployment benefits. We’ve seen it all. No kidding, we once had someone ask us in an interview what the name of our company is. Needless to say, we could tell that person wasn’t really passionate about joining our team.

Thank you for your interest in Kadince. We look forward to reviewing your application.
