jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Organic & AI Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: About Eleanor Health At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives.
jobs.description:
About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About the Role

Most people who find Eleanor Health should not have to see an advertisement first. They should find us because we show up when someone searches for treatment in their city, because an AI assistant recommends us when someone asks where to get help, because our reviews are real and our listings are accurate, and because trusted sources and communities help people discover Eleanor.

This role leads the organic growth and AI visibility function. It is the counterpart to our performance marketing function. Where that team captures and converts existing demand, this function builds sustainable non-paid demand through assets and systems that compound over time, including content, content infrastructure, search visibility, entity signals, listings, reviews, earned coverage, and brand.

This function is central to Eleanor Health's growth plan. Paid search currently drives roughly 60% of new member acquisition and is our most expensive channel. Our plan requires that share to fall substantially while total volume grows, which means non-paid acquisition must grow significantly. This role is accountable for developing and executing the strategy to grow non-paid acquisition, measuring its performance, and prioritizing the work and resources required to reach those goals.

You would lead organic search, AI visibility, reputation, earned media, content strategy and operations, and brand stewardship. You would also own the content architecture and systems that support those channels, including the structures, governance, and workflows that allow Eleanor's content to scale. You will manage a Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist and direct specialist partners across content, technical SEO, design, public relations, and web implementation.

Our organic foundation is real but evolving. Our directory presence across markets is fragmented and being addressed now. AI visibility is beginning to be measured and operationalized. Our website and content infrastructure are also evolving to support a more scalable, structured approach to organic growth. There is a substantial amount of high-leverage work available to a leader who can connect evidence to strategy, prioritize effectively, and build the systems and team required to execute it.

What You'll Do

Organic Growth

  • Own organic search strategy and performance across every market we serve, including content strategy, technical SEO priorities, and local search
  • Own non-paid new member volume and non-paid share of total acquisition as primary accountabilities
  • Set and manage the content strategy and roadmap across the customer journey, including location, service, educational, and high-intent content that drives discoverability and treatment-seeking action
  • Direct website information architecture and organic content experience in partnership with the performance marketing function, which owns conversion

Content & Content Operations

  • Own the systems, structures, and governance that support scalable content creation, publishing, maintenance, and reuse across channels
  • Own website content architecture, taxonomy, structured content, CMS governance, templates, and publishing workflows, translating business and editorial needs into requirements for technical implementation
  • Establish and govern editorial standards and workflows across internal and external contributors, including quality standards, review requirements, publishing governance, and ongoing content maintenance
  • Direct content migration and ongoing content lifecycle management, including decisions about consolidation, redirects, archival, and adaptation to evolving content structures
  • Build and maintain the operational framework that connects content strategy, evidence, execution, measurement, and learning so that decisions and outcomes inform future priorities
  • Manage the freelance copywriter and own the end-to-end editorial production workflow, including briefing and assignment, editorial review, clinical and compliance review, visual asset coordination, CMS staging, quality assurance, publishing, and ongoing optimization

AI Visibility

  • Own how often and how accurately AI assistants and AI-generated search results cite, describe, and recommend Eleanor Health
  • Establish and maintain measurement of AI citation, recommendation, and referral visibility, and use findings to inform organic, content, reputation, and distribution priorities
  • Set strategy for the entity, citation, structured data, content, and authority signals that make Eleanor Health legible and credible to AI systems
  • Monitor how Eleanor Health and relevant treatment topics are represented in AI-generated responses, identify material inaccuracies or recommendation gaps, and prioritize corrective action where Eleanor Health can influence the underlying sources

Reputation & Earned Media

  • Own the reputation and local presence strategy, directing your team to maintain listings integrity and local search presence across all markets, including Google Business Profiles and other priority directories, review generation and response, and disclosed community engagement
  • Establish a cross-functional reputation management framework for channels and sources that affect Eleanor Health's discoverability, credibility, and AI visibility, coordinating with People, Clinical, Operations, Payer Partnerships, and other stakeholders where source ownership or response authority sits outside Marketing
  • Identify, prioritize, and address inaccurate, outdated, or unfavorable third-party information about Eleanor Health based on potential impact and Marketing's ability to influence the source
  • Own the public relations agency relationship, setting priorities and measuring its contribution to business outcomes, brand authority, and discoverability
  • Own the editorial distribution and syndication program that builds authority, relevant third-party presence, and referring domains in priority markets

Brand

  • Own marketing brand strategy and governance, including voice, messaging, visual standards, and consistent application across channels
  • Maintain a documented, scalable brand system, including guidelines, components, patterns, and approved usage, that enables internal teams and external partners to execute consistently without routing every asset through you
  • Guide the application and evolution of the marketing brand system in partnership with design, translating business, audience, content, and channel needs into clear creative requirements
  • Own the design partner relationship, including prioritization, scoping, briefing, quality standards, and effective use of design resources

People & Partners

  • Manage and develop direct report/s through clear expectations in writing, a consistent feedback cadence, documented performance goals, and opportunities for growth
  • Lead a distributed team of internal and external specialists, establishing clear scopes, requirements, priorities, ownership, and measures of success
  • Partner cross-functionally with Performance Marketing, Access, Clinical, People, Payer Partnerships, Analytics, Technology, and other stakeholders whose expertise, systems, or decisions affect organic growth and AI visibility
  • Maintain a quarterly operating plan that translates growth objectives into prioritized initiatives, expected impact, owners, dependencies, resources, and timelines

Measurement

  • Build and continuously improve measurement and attribution for non-paid acquisition in partnership with Analytics, documenting methodology and limitations where attribution is incomplete
  • Report performance against non-paid acquisition and visibility targets, explain meaningful variance, and identify the actions or decisions the evidence supports
  • Synthesize performance, search, visibility, reputation, and customer-journey data into actionable findings, priorities, and testable hypotheses
  • Maintain the decision context needed to evaluate what changed, what worked, what did not, and what should inform future strategy and prioritization
  • Apply appropriate standards of evidence to attribution and performance claims, distinguishing observed relationships from conclusions the available data can support

You'll Be A Good Fit If You:

  • Would rather own a business outcome than a set of activities, and are comfortable being measured on outcomes that may take quarters rather than weeks to move
  • Can prioritize ruthlessly across a scope larger than any one person can execute, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and clearly communicate what is not being prioritized and why
  • Are excited by disciplines that are still evolving, including AI visibility, where there is no settled playbook and you will help build ours
  • Can translate evidence and business objectives into strategy, requirements, priorities, and executable work for others
  • Can lead a direct report and a distributed group of specialists and partners without becoming the execution bottleneck
  • Are comfortable building systems and processes where they do not yet exist, while improving them as evidence and organizational needs evolve
  • Approach the work with compassion, knowing that showing up accurately when someone is looking for treatment can influence whether they find a path to care

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 7+ years in organic growth, SEO, content strategy, content operations, or related digital growth disciplines, with experience owning business outcomes rather than a set of deliverables
  • Organic search: Demonstrated results in organic search, ideally including local, multi-location, or multi-market search
  • AI visibility: Hands-on familiarity with generative engine optimization, AI search visibility, or the entity, citation, content, and authority signals that underpin it. Early-stage experience is expected in an evolving discipline; genuine curiosity and experimentation are essential
  • Content strategy & operations: Experience translating business objectives into content strategy and managing the systems, workflows, governance, and contributors required to execute it
  • Digital content systems: Experience working with CMS platforms, structured content, taxonomy, information architecture, and web publishing workflows, including partnership with technical teams
  • Leadership: Experience managing or directing people and specialist partners, setting clear expectations and priorities, and creating the conditions for others to execute effectively
  • Measurement: Comfort working with imperfect attribution, establishing defensible measurement approaches, identifying data limitations, and translating evidence into decisions and testable hypotheses
  • Cross-functional leadership: Ability to lead work across teams where outcomes depend on stakeholders, systems, or expertise outside your direct authority
  • Judgment: Sound decision-making in a regulated environment, particularly around patient privacy, clinical accuracy, reputation, and public participation

Helpful but not required:

  • Behavioral health, addiction treatment, or healthcare marketing experience
  • Multi-state or multi-location organic and local search experience
  • Working knowledge of structured data and schema markup
  • Experience directing public relations, creative, SEO, or other specialized agency/freelance partners
  • Experience with brand governance or design systems
  • Experience with content migrations, CMS implementations, or major website redesigns

What This Role is Not:

We would rather be clear now than waste your time.

  • Not a paid media role. Paid search and paid media sit with our performance marketing function.
  • Not a conversion rate optimization role. Website conversion sits with performance marketing, though you will drive website changes related to organic & AI visibility.
  • Not a pure individual contributor role. You will remain close to the work, particularly where strategic judgment, editorial quality, systems thinking, or emerging capabilities require hands-on involvement, but success depends on building and directing the people, partners, systems, and workflows that allow the function to scale.

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage -We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).
  • Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.
  • Family Medical Leave -Eleanor Health’s Paid Family & Medical Leave (“PFML”) is designed to provide flexibility and financial peace of mind for approved family and medical reasons such as the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, and for serious health conditions that you or a family member/significant other might be facing.
  • Wellness Perks & Benefits -Mental Health is important to us and we want our employees to have the accessibility you deserve to talk things through, zen with a mindfulness app, or seek assistance from health advocates
    • Mindfulness App Reimbursement
    • EAP with eight face-to-face sessions
    • Virtual health and wellness visits covered by our medical plan.

jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

THE ROLE

OLIPOP is looking for an IT Manager who's passionate about empowering teams through technology and ensuring our systems are secure, scalable, and easy to use. This role is both strategic and hands-on, leading key IT initiatives while diving deep into tools like Microsoft 365, Zscaler, Okta, Arctic Wolf, and Abnormal. You'll drive IT policy, governance, and vendor management while helping shape how technology supports OLIPOP's next stage of growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Strategy

• Partner with the IT Director and company leadership to define and execute OLIPOP's IT strategy, roadmap, and annual priorities.
• Establish, document, and enforce IT policies, standards, and best practices across the organization.
• Own IT vendor management from sourcing to contract negotiation, renewals, and ongoing performance.
• Manage IT budget planning, spend optimization, and technology ROI reporting.Systems & Operations
• Oversee daily IT operations across cloud platforms, networking, endpoint management, and security infrastructure.
• Manage upgrades, new deployments, and migrations ensuring minimal disruption and clear communication across teams.
• Drive SaaS lifecycle management: onboarding, access control, renewals, and integrations.
• Partner with internal teams and external vendors to ensure uptime, system performance, and timely resolution of issues.

Security & Compliance

• Lead information security initiatives, including SSO/MFA, identity governance, and zero-trust architecture through Okta and Zscaler.

  • Experience advising hiring managers, managing expectations, and influencing decisions with data and market knowledge.
  • Solid understanding of offer negotiation and compensation conversations.
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one modern ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, or similar) and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication and a candidate-first mindset.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate sourcing, drafting candidate communications, summarizing interview feedback, or streamlining recruiting workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting hiring at a growth-stage or high-growth company.
  • Familiarity with recruiting analytics, dashboards, or reporting tools.

This role combines commercial ownership — including financial responsibility for the equipment portfolio — with hands-on team leadership and close partnership with engineering, proposal, and Enterprise Procurement Team. The Commercial Supply Chain & Procurement Manager sits within AISP department, giving equipment sourcing decisions a direct line to project delivery and technical requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Build, lead, and grow a high-performing equipment sourcing team dedicated to SCADA and metering procurement, including hiring, coaching, professional development, and resource planning as the team scales.
  • Own and manage the equipment financials — forecasting, revenue, cost of goods sold (COGS), and margin targets — balancing lowest total cost against supply resilience and delivery risk.
  • Develop and execute an equipment sourcing strategy, including supplier spend diversification, supplier capacity/capability balance, and supply chain risk management across the SCADA and metering portfolio.
  • Own supplier relationship management: agreements, terms & conditions, performance monitoring and reporting, payment terms, and bulk pricing negotiations.
  • Build and continuously improve core sourcing processes across the project lifecycle — quoting, requirements flow-down, supplier selection, inventory planning, PO management, order fulfillment coordination, end-of-life management, and change order execution.
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate technical specifications and bills of materials into sourcing requirements, ensuring procured equipment meets project design, quality, and schedule requirements.
  • Incorporate supply chain cybersecurity and regulatory considerations (e.g., NERC CIP supply chain risk management requirements) into supplier selection and sourcing decisions for SCADA and metering systems.
  • Partner with the Enterprise Supply Chain team on shared capabilities: supplier and subconsultant onboarding, strategic pricing negotiations, logistics, receiving, inventory management, ERP enablement, supplier corrective action programs, and supply chain analytics/KPIs.
  • Ensure the consistent application of Supply Chain best practices and adherence to Ulteig’s Supplier Management program.
  • Maintain market intelligence on SCADA/metering commodity pricing, lead times, supply chain risk, and evolving contract terms and conditions.

  • Identify, manage, and mitigate equipment delivery risk across active projects.

What We Expect From You

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a highly driven, technically curious, and customer-obsessed Customer Success & Product Manager to join our fast-growing team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven, technically curious, and customer-obsessed Customer Success & Product Manager to join our fast-growing team.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Solutions Engineering. You will work closely with customers to understand how they operate, help them get the most value from our platform, and translate their workflows, requirements, and feedback into actionable solutions for our Product and Engineering teams.

You will not simply answer customer questions. You will roll up your sleeves and use the product yourself, build AI-powered workflows, configure integrations, troubleshoot implementations, create demos, and work cross-functionally to turn customer needs into product improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who is high-ownership, meticulous, technically curious, and comfortable figuring things out without having every step defined for them.

Responsibilities

    Key Responsibilities

    1. Customer Success & Onboarding

    • Respond to customer inquiries and requests quickly and professionally, removing blockers that may delay onboarding or product adoption.

    • Own customer requests from initial inquiry through resolution, ensuring clear follow-through and communication.

    • Build strong relationships with customers and develop a deep understanding of their businesses, workflows, goals, and pain points.

    • Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption, engagement, and satisfaction.

    • Help customers understand and maximize the capabilities of the platform.

    • Identify opportunities to expand customer usage and recommend higher-tier plans or additional capabilities when appropriate.

      • 2. Product Implementation & Technical Solutions

      • Become an expert user of our Central products, including advanced functionality and integrations.

      • Build and configure workflows on behalf of customers.

      • Work with advanced capabilities such as:

        • AI prompting and prompt optimization

        • Webhooks

        • APIs and API connections

        • Zapier and other third-party integrations

        • Scripting and automation

        • Account and workflow configuration

        • AI-powered workflows and agents

        • Troubleshoot customer implementations and determine whether issues can be resolved through configuration, workflow changes, or product enhancements.

        • Experiment with new product capabilities and determine practical use cases for customers.

        • Create proof-of-concepts, demos, and customized solutions that showcase the platform's capabilities.

          • 3. Customer-to-Product Feedback

          • Conduct calls and conversations with customers to understand their workflows, requirements, and desired outcomes.C

          • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories, specifications, and implementation details.

          • Work closely with Product and Engineering to communicate customer requirements and ensure solutions are accurately understood and implemented.

          • Help identify recurring customer pain points and opportunities for product improvements.

          • Participate in product discussions and provide customer-informed input into feature development and prioritization.

          • Follow up with customers and internal teams throughout the development and implementation process.

            • 4. AI & Product Enablement

            • Use AI tools to research, prototype, improve prompts, build workflows, and accelerate customer solutions.

            • Develop compelling product demos and examples tailored to specific customer use cases.

            • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, techniques, integrations, and product capabilities.

            • Stay current with developments in AI automation and identify opportunities to apply them to customer workflows.

            • Help create customer-facing guides, documentation, specifications, and other enablement materials.

              • 5. Account & Documentation Management

              • Modify and configure customer accounts within the platform as needed.

              • Manage the operational back-and-forth associated with customer documentation, including contracts, specifications, guides, requirements, and implementation materials.

              • Maintain accurate records of customer requirements, configurations, workflows, and outstanding items.

              • Ensure customer requests and commitments are properly documented and communicated to relevant internal teams.

                • 6. Growth & Expansion

                • Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business and identify opportunities where additional product capabilities can create value.

                • Identify potential upsell and expansion opportunities and work with the appropriate teams to convert those opportunities.

                • Participate in customer expansion conversations and product demonstrations.

                • Commission opportunities may be available for qualified upsell and expansion activity.

Requirements

    What We're Looking For

    Must-Have Qualities

    • High ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

    • Customer obsessed: You genuinely care about solving customer problems and making customers successful.

    • Highly detail-oriented: You catch small issues before they become larger problems.

    • Technically curious: You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable learning technical concepts and experimenting with APIs, integrations, automation, and AI tools.

    • Fast learner: You can quickly learn a new product, understand how it works, and figure out how to apply it to different customer scenarios.

    • Resourceful: You are comfortable operating with limited guidance and finding answers independently.

    • Strong communicator: You can translate complex customer needs into clear requirements for Product and Engineering teams.

    • Strong problem solver: You can break ambiguous customer problems into practical solutions.

    • Organized and structured: You can manage multiple customers, requests, projects, and follow-ups without losing track of details.

    • Commercially minded: You understand that successful customers can lead to retention, expansion, and revenue growth.

      • Technical Curiosity

      Experience or familiarity with any of the following is a strong advantage:

      • SaaS products

      • AI tools and LLMs

      • Prompt engineering

      • APIs

      • Webhooks

      • Zapier or workflow automation platforms

      • Scripting

      • CRM or customer success platforms

      • No-code/low-code tools

      • Technical product implementation

      • Product management or requirements gathering

        • Qualifications

        Required Qualifications

        • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

        • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, Product Management, SaaS Implementation, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role.

        • Experience working with SaaS or technology products, preferably in a fast-growing or startup environment.

        • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both customers and technical teams.

        • Demonstrated ability to own customer issues from start to finish, including identifying the problem, finding a solution, coordinating internally, and following through to resolution.

        • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-up and project management skills.

        • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; able to break down ambiguous problems and determine practical solutions.

        • Comfortable learning new software, technologies, and systems independently.

        • Strong technical aptitude and willingness to work with APIs, webhooks, integrations, automation tools, scripting, and AI platforms.

        • Familiarity with AI tools and LLMs, including the ability to write, test, and improve prompts.

        • Ability to translate customer workflows and business requirements into clear product requirements, specifications, and actionable tasks for Product and Engineering teams.

        • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited guidance and changing priorities.

        • Demonstrated resourcefulness and initiative; able to research, experiment, and find solutions independently.

        • Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to understand customer goals and identify opportunities to increase product adoption and value.

        • Commercial awareness and willingness to participate in upselling and account expansion opportunities.

        • Ability to manage multiple customer requests, projects, and priorities simultaneously without losing attention to detail.

Ideal Candidate

You might be a great fit for this role if you are someone who sees a customer problem and thinks:

"Let me figure out how we can solve this."

You enjoy talking to customers, but you also enjoy getting your hands dirty inside the product. You can jump from a customer call to configuring an integration, then work with an engineer on a product requirement, build an AI-powered demo, and follow up with the customer—all while keeping track of the details.

You are comfortable with ambiguity, energized by fast-moving environments, and excited by the opportunity to help shape both the customer experience and the product itself.

jobs.description:
About Mainspring Recovery

Mainspring Recovery is a mission-driven behavioral health organization built on the belief that healing happens when the right people are in the room. We provide care across multiple levels, including Residential, Partial Hospitalization (PHP), and Intensive Outpatient (IOP), supporting individuals and families throughout the recovery process.

Every role at Mainspring, clinical and non-clinical alike, contributes to creating safe, structured, and effective environments where people can rebuild their lives. We invest in strong teams, clear systems, and thoughtful leadership, believing meaningful impact comes from doing the work well, supporting one another, and holding ourselves to high standards across the organization.

Job Title:

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner

Reports To:

Medical Director / Executive Director

Department:

Medical

Location:

Remote

Employment Type:

Full-time | Salaried | Exempt

Compensation:

The pay for this position is $170,000-180,000 salary, set in good faith based on the responsibilities of the role, qualifications, and market conditions

Job Summary

Mainspring Recovery is seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join our interdisciplinary clinical team supporting individuals in recovery from substance use disorders (SUD) and co-occurring mental health conditions. This position may be filled by a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) or a Medical Nurse Practitioner (FNP/AGNP) depending on the candidate's licensure and area of expertise. The NP will provide specialty-focused care — psychiatric or medical — while maintaining a whole-person approach aligned with Mainspring's mission.

Key Responsibilities

Upon admission, conduct a comprehensive specialty-specific intake evaluation:

For Psychiatric NPs (PMHNP):

  • Complete psychiatric intake evaluation including mental status exam (MSE), trauma history, and psychiatric review of systems
  • Diagnose and document DSM-5 psychiatric conditions (e.g., mood disorders, anxiety, PTSD, psychosis) co-occurring with SUD
  • Assess suicide/homicide risk andestablisha safety plan
  • Review current psychotropic medication history andidentifymedication-assisted treatment (MAT) need
  • Establish an individualized psychiatric treatment plan with short- and long-term goals
  • Routinely approve continuation of medications upon intake until full assessment can be completed.

SUD & Mental Health Focus During Mainspring Care

  • Identifyand address SUD-specific clinical needs including withdrawal management, detox monitoring, and MAT initiation or continuation (buprenorphine, naltrexone, etc.)
  • Collaborate with counselors, case managers, and behavioral health staff to ensure psychiatric and medical needs are integrated into the patient's individualized treatment plan
  • Participate in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings and case conferences
  • Provide clinical consultation to staffregardingthe intersection of medical/psychiatric conditions and SUD recovery
  • Screen for co-occurring disorders and refer internally or externally as appropriate

Routine Follow-Up & Ongoing Care

  • Conduct scheduled follow-up appointments throughout the patient's stay tomonitortreatment response, medication efficacy, and overall health status
  • Reassess and update the care plan based on patient progress, emerging concerns, or changes in clinical status
  • Document all clinical encounters, assessments, and care plan updates accurately andin a timely mannerin the EHR
  • Monitor vital signs, labs, and diagnostic results; communicate critical values andinitiateappropriate follow-up
  • Provide patient educationregardingdiagnosis, medications, side effects, and self-management strategies relevant to SUD recovery

Medication Ordering & Prescribing

  • Prescribe and manage medications within scope of practice, including MAT medications, psychiatric medications, and medications for co-occurring medical conditions
  • Conduct medication reconciliation upon admission, during treatment, and at discharge
  • Monitor for medication interactions, contraindications, and adverse effects with attention to substances common in SUD populations
  • Utilize the Virginia Prescription Monitoring Program (PMP) asrequiredprior to prescribing controlled substances
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director on complex or high-risk medication regimens

Peer-to-Peer Reviews & Utilization Management

  • Complete peer-to-peer (P2P) reviews with insurance medical directors asrequiredto advocate for medically necessary levels of care, continued stays, or treatment services
  • Document clinical justification for level-of-care determinations in alignment with ASAM criteria
  • Communicate with payers andutilizationmanagement teams to support authorization of clinical services
  • Partner with the clinical and administrative team to ensuretimelycompletion of P2P requests to avoid disruptions in patient care

Additional Responsibilities

  • Refer patients to outside healthcare resources and specialists when clinical needs exceed on-site scope of care
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of SUD treatment guidelines, MAT protocols, and psychiatric best practices
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by the Executive Director or Medical Director

Minimum Qualifications

Education / Credentials

  • Active Nurse Practitioner licensure in the Commonwealth of Virginia (required)
  • Board certification as a PMHNP-C/PMHNP-BC
  • Active DEA registration in Virginia (required)
  • Current BLS/CPR certification (required)

Experience

  • Minimum of one (1) year of clinical experience in a psychiatric, SUD, behavioral health, or related healthcare setting preferred
  • Experience with medication-assisted treatment (MAT) preferred
  • Experience completing peer-to-peer reviews with insurance companies preferred

Knowledge / Skills

  • Strong clinical assessment skills with ability toidentifyand manage acute and chronic conditions in SUD/MH populations
  • Familiarity with ASAM criteria and levels of care for SUD treatment
  • Proficiencywith electronic health records (EHR)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Commitment to trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and patient-centered care

Working Conditions

  • Direct Care Position
  • Full-time,40 hoursper week, Monday-Friday 10:00am-6:30pm, on-call
  • Remote

Why This Role Matters

  • At Mainspring Recovery, we believe that healing from substance use disorder requires addressing the full picture of a person's health — mind and body. Our Nurse Practitioners are essential to that mission. Whether yourexpertiseis psychiatric or medical, your work directly supports patients in one of the most vulnerable and transformative periods of their lives. You will be part of a compassionate, collaborative team dedicated to meeting patients where they are and guiding them toward lasting recovery.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Mainspring conducts, as required, job-related background checks, drug testing, TB testing, verification of employment history, and/or reference checks prior to employment.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Mainspring is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

You will design and improve coordination processes, own offer letter governance, administer recruiting systems, interpret recruiting policies, and influence the work of our recruiting coordinator team.

  • Interpret recruiting policies and guidelines and advise recruiters, coordinators, and hiring teams on how to handle non-routine cases.

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or recruiting operations, including demonstrated ownership of process improvements and independent problem-solving.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to offer processes, recruiting systems administration, or coordination programs.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make good decisions in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with limited direction.
  • Ability to guide and develop others and to influence process and tooling decisions.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$34—$37 USD

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

jobs.excerpt: Capital Partnerships LeadAbout TetonTeton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the resident and care environment.
jobs.description:
Capital Partnerships Lead

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the resident and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. From assisted living communities to hospital wards, our system delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

About the role

Some of Teton's most important relationships are with its capital partners, the REITs, private equity firms, and institutional owners who own the senior-housing assets our product runs in. They decide whether Teton scales from a handful of communities to entire portfolios. That channel is the difference between selling one community at a time and moving thousands of units in a single decision.

We are hiring a Capital Partnerships Lead to own it end to end.

This is a senior, high-autonomy seat. You will set the strategy for how Teton engages the institutional capital that sits behind senior housing, carry those relationships at the executive level, and lead the commercial work that converts them into portfolio-wide deployments. You will negotiate master agreements with owners who move hundreds of millions of dollars, and you will do it with real latitude on structure, pricing, and sequencing.

You will also shape what we sell them. Portfolio Intelligence, our owner-facing product, exists because capital partners need a different view of their assets than operators do. You will be the voice that defines that roadmap.

This role reports to the SVP of Strategic Growth and takes over a book of relationships he currently carries. Expect to be in front of C-suites and senior client execs within your first quarter.

What you'll do

  • Own Teton's capital-partner strategy: which owners we pursue, in what order, with what commercial construct, and why.

  • Carry senior relationships directly. Build trust with heads of asset management, CIOs, operating partners, and C-suites at REITs, PE owners, and large institutional holders.

  • Lead large, complex commercial negotiations. Structure and close master agreements and portfolio-level rollouts, working with legal, finance, and operators to land terms that scale.

  • Build the investment case. Frame Teton in the language owners actually use: NOI, occupancy, labor cost, insurance and liability exposure, asset value, and exit multiple. Defend it under scrutiny.

  • Convert pilots into portfolios. Own the path from initial deployment to portfolio-wide commitment, including the data, the narrative, and the internal champions required to get there.

  • Set the direction of Portfolio Intelligence as the owner-facing product. Partner with product and engineering on a roadmap driven by what capital partners will pay for.

  • Work across the operator relationship. Owners and operators are separate decision-makers with different incentives. You will navigate both and know when to align them.

  • Build the team. Hire and develop the capital-partnerships function as the channel scales, starting with the analytical bench beneath you.

  • Represent Teton externally at industry forums, owner conferences, and investor settings where this market is made.

What we are looking for

  • 8 to 10+ years of experience spanning rigorous analytical work and senior commercial ownership. Common paths: private equity or investment banking into a commercial or corporate development leadership role, real estate or healthcare investing into operating leadership, or enterprise sales and partnerships with genuine financial depth.

  • A track record closing large, structurally complex deals. You have owned a negotiation from first meeting to signature, not just supported one.

  • Strategic judgment. You decide where not to spend time, you see two moves ahead, and you can explain the reasoning to a skeptical board.

  • Executive presence with institutional investors. You are comfortable and credible with people who allocate capital for a living.

  • Real commercial instinct on structure and pricing. You understand how deal construct drives adoption, not just revenue.

  • Fluency, or the ability to reach fluency fast, in senior housing and real estate economics: how owners underwrite assets, what drives valuation, how the operator relationship works.

  • Genuine ownership mentality. You will have a broad mandate and limited scaffolding. That should sound appealing rather than alarming.

  • Ability to build. This is a function to be built, not inherited. You should want the building part.

  • Nice to have: existing relationships in senior housing, healthcare real estate, or institutional owner networks. Valuable, but not a substitute for judgment and horsepower.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, meaningful upside, and participation in our warrant program

  • Direct ownership of one of the highest-leverage channels in the business

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a rapidly evolving field

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

  • 401(k) plan, paid time off, and health insurance

What It's Like Working at Teton

We are a growing team of hard-working and highly talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is expected. This is a hands-on environment where you will be challenged, supported, and continually learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than a traditional 9 to 5 role. With Teton you will have the opportunity to make a real impact on the world through your work. So if you are looking for a ride and not just a job, come join us.

Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! 

As a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack supporting Broad Arrow Group, you will own fullstack development across the systems that power Broad Arrow Auctions, from the public auction experience to the internal tools used on the auction floor. You'll work across a platform that spans Azure and AWS, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Billboard software that displays lots and bids during live sales. Using modern technologies such as NextJS, TypeScript, React, and Node.js, you'll deliver fast, accessible, and reliable user experiences that hold up when the auction is live. You will contribute to architectural decisions that cross system boundaries, establish and maintain robust automated tests, support systems in production, and continuously raise the bar for patterns, practices, and overall quality across the Broad Arrow platform.

What you’ll do

Develop maintainable, scalable, secure, and resilient applications by:

  • Crafting solutions through a deep understanding of business objectives, architectural intent, system interactions, and operational requirements, often working in ambiguous problem spaces and within the most complex parts of the system.
  • Writing clean, human-readable code. Track and consistently apply the comments received on your code to future work.
  • Contributing to architectural design with an emphasis on complexity, performance, maintainability, and security.
  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining comprehensive automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Possessing a strong understanding of when and how to apply each test type, including test data management, environment-appropriate execution strategies, and ensuring tests remain reliable and valuable over time.

Own and support features, modules, and products by:

  • Being able to thoroughly explain and demonstrate how your product fits into the larger Broad Arrow Group and Hagerty ecosystem and how other services depend on it.
  • Thoroughly understanding upcoming epics and features of your product, helping product managers craft good feature definitions, and being able to explain them to less experienced engineers.
  • Helping to define key metrics that signal the health and performance of the product, monitoring them, and providing explanation for changes over time.
  • Owning and updating the Billboard software used during live auctions, ensuring it is stable, accurate, and ready ahead of every sale.
  • Actively practice troubleshooting and participate in the on-call support rotation for the team's production services, including support during live auction events.

Deepen technical expertise as an engineer by:

  • Evaluating, adopting, and when necessary, designing client and server-side libraries, frameworks, and shared abstractions, establishing clear guidance on when they should be used, when they should not, and the tradeoffs involved.
  • Defining and refining frontend and service integration patterns, including API contracts, data-fetching strategies, caching, and error handling that balance user experience, performance, operability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Building and maintaining working expertise in the Azure portions of the Broad Arrow architecture, including accessing, deploying, and troubleshooting Azure artifacts and resources, while working alongside Hagerty's AWS environment.
  • Understanding and integrating with Microsoft Dynamics 365 in Azure, keeping auction, consignment, and customer data flowing reliably between systems.
  • Maintaining deep expertise in the client-side ecosystem, including browsers, rendering and hydration models, accessibility standards, performance diagnostics, and modern build/deploy workflows, to deliver resilient user experiences.
  • Staying current with evolving frontend and platform technologies, thoughtfully incorporating improvements that raise user experience, system reliability, and/or developer productivity without chasing novelty.

Contribute to and engage in a collaborative environment by:

  • Being an active participant in all team activities: team ceremonies, banter, troubleshooting, design discussion, work breakdowns, etc.
  • Observing team practices and behaviors, working with your manager on ways to improve them, and explaining and modeling them.
  • Helping less experienced engineers effectively explore topics that are unfamiliar to them and participate in deliberate practice with them in those areas.
  • Helping teammates understand what it means to be good stewards of the products on which you are working.

This might describe you

  • Proven experience contributing as a senior engineer or technical lead on multiple large-scale, complex customer facing systems, including initial development, major feature delivery, and at least one year of ongoing production support.
  • A proven track record of building customer centered products with a deep understanding of how technical decisions impact user experiences.
  • Comfortable working and actively participating within smaller (5-10 people) technical groups.
  • Experience working across multiple cloud providers, with hands-on Azure experience and familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a comparable CRM platform, and a strong fundamental grasp on WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Comfortable building and evolving fullstack solutions across modern web interfaces, server-rendered application patterns, backend APIs, cloud infrastructure, and supporting data services.
  • Able to work across the application boundary, connecting user-facing workflows with reliable backend services, infrastructure, caching, storage, and integration patterns.
  • Comfortable supporting software where reliability during a live event is critical.
  • Eager to deeply learn, both independently and with help, our technologies and patterns such as:

o Languages & Runtime: JavaScript / TypeScript, CSS/SCSS, Terraform, Node.js

o Frontend Frameworks & Tooling: NextJS, React, Playwright, React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest

o APIs & Integration Patterns: REST, RPC, GraphQL

o Business Platforms: Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse

o Security: TLS, encryption in transit and at rest, secure coding, secret management

o Performance & Reliability: load testing, profiling, monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing

o Infrastructure: Azure and AWS, configuration management, and progressive deployment strategies

o Networking Fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, firewalls, load balancers

o Deployment: VMs, containers, cloud providers, configuration management, canary deployments

  • Able to clearly communicate your thoughts and actively listen to and integrate the thoughts and comments of others.

Other things to note

  • May require travel for quarterly events.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

Who We Are

Every organization runs on intelligence: years of accumulated knowledge, decisions, and context. As AI takes on more of that work, companies face a choice: rent that intelligence from vendors who keep the data, the context, and the results, or own it.

OpenTeams exists to make ownership possible.

Founded by Travis Oliphant, creator of NumPy and SciPy, and built by people with deep roots across the open-source ecosystem, including NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, and Jupyter, we help enterprises and governments build AI they control, govern, and evolve themselves.

If that sounds like your kind of work, we'd like to meet you.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer - AI/ML Platform

Location: U.S - Remote

Work Authorization: U.S. citizenship required

Clearance: An active clearance is not required at the time of hire. Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance, which includes a federal background investigation.

Salary Range: $85,000 - $120,000 USD, dependent on experience level and location

About the Role

We're looking for a Systems Engineer to join our platform support team. This is a role for someone early in their infrastructure career who wants real ownership of production systems and is willing to earn it by being the person others can count on.

The work runs across two streams. Internal Platforms covers the systems OpenTeams itself runs on — identity, cloud, internal applications, our website. You own that surface end to end, which means you're the first responder when something breaks and the one who fixes the underlying cause so it stops happening. Project Support means backing up our infrastructure engineers on the platforms we build and operate for customers, including government programs.

Both streams start at the front line. That's the entry point, not the destination - as you build real context, the scope grows toward environment builds, deployment configuration, and eventually owning pieces of a platform outright.

The two sides reinforce each other. Our internal systems run on the same open-source building blocks we ship to customers, so operating our own environments is how you become useful on a customer deployment. You will not be an expert in all of it on day one, and we don't expect you to be. We expect you to be curious, to write things down, and to ask before you break something.

This is a fully remote, U.S.-based role working with a distributed team that relies heavily on asynchronous communication.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Platforms

  • Own the internal request queue: triage what comes in, resolve what you can, pull in help when you can't, and make sure nothing silently falls through.
  • Administer Google Workspace and identity systems — accounts, groups, SSO integrations, security policy, and the onboarding and offboarding runbooks that keep access correct as people join and leave.
  • Support the provisioning and maintenance of cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent): accounts, IAM roles, networking basics, resource tagging, and cost visibility.
  • Deploy and operate internal applications on Kubernetes using Helm and ArgoCD, under the guidance of senior engineers. Understand what you're deploying, not just the command that deploys it.
  • Maintain the internal OpenTeams website - an Astro site backed by EmDash - including build pipelines, deploys, DNS, and content publishing support for the teams that use it.
  • Build and maintain monitoring and alerting for the systems you own, and help reduce alert noise rather than adding to it.
  • Handle security and access hygiene: patching, MFA enforcement, periodic access reviews, endpoint configuration, and offboarding.

Project Support

  • Handle incoming issues from customer teams: reproduce the problem, gather logs and context, resolve what's covered by existing procedure, and hand off cleanly when it isn't.
  • Execute established deployment and maintenance runbooks against customer environments, and flag the steps that are unclear, brittle, or missing.
  • Track issues through to closure and keep customer-facing status accurate, so nothing sits in an unknown state.
  • Assist with hardening and compliance work - applying hardened configurations, gathering evidence for control implementation, and keeping infrastructure documentation current.
  • Grow into environment builds, configuration changes, and platform ownership as your context deepens.
  • Carry what you learn back the other direction: patterns that work on customer platforms belong in our internal systems, and vice versa.

Across Both

  • Participate in incident response, and contribute to postmortems focused on the system rather than the person.
  • Collaborate with a fully remote, distributed team using asynchronous communication.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 1–3 years of combined experience in IT support, systems administration, or infrastructure work.
  • Comfortable in Linux and on the command line: filesystems, permissions, processes, logs, systemd, package management, SSH.
  • Working understanding of networking fundamentals — DNS, DHCP, HTTP/TLS, VPNs, firewalls — enough to reason about why something can't reach something else.
  • Scripting ability in Python and/or Bash, sufficient to automate a repetitive task rather than doing it forty times.
  • Comfortable with Git and pull request workflows.
  • Some hands-on exposure to at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and to containers.
  • Experience administering SaaS tools (Google Workspace, Slack, or similar) including user lifecycle and permissions.
  • Strong communication skills. Most of this job happens in tickets, pull requests, and documentation, and clarity in writing is a technical skill here.
  • Genuine service orientation. The people filing support requests are your teammates, and how they're treated when something is broken matters.
  • Willingness to say "I don't know yet, here's how I'm going to find out."
  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases — able to write queries independently to pull data and build dashboards
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience — kubectl, Helm, reading logs and events to figure out why a pod won't start.
  • Exposure to GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux) or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Any infrastructure-as-code experience: OpenTofu, Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible.
  • Familiarity with identity and SSO standards — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Frontend or static site experience, particularly Astro, or work with a headless CMS.
  • Familiarity with the Python data science ecosystem or JupyterHub.
  • Security+ or a comparable certification, or coursework in security fundamentals.
  • Any exposure to regulated or government environments — RMF, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, or restricted-network deployment.

Grow With Us

At OpenTeams, growth isn’t just about the company—it’s about you.

We believe the best careers are built at the edge of your potential. That is where new tools, ideas, and technologies change the world. Here, you’ll work alongside pioneers of AI, solving problems that matter: making AI more transparent, more ethical, and more empowering. As your skills grow, our career framework provides a pathway and recognition of that increased impact.

Opportunities aren’t limited by geography. You’ll collaborate with global experts, contribute to open source projects that power the world’s technology, and stretch your skills daily. That global perspective and diversity makes our solution more universal and robust. We are committed to continuing to celebrate diversity on our team.

Supported people are successful people. We offer 100% employer paid medical premiums for employees and self-managed PTO with a minimum time off requirement, so that our teams are able to do their best work.

We invest in curiosity, creativity, and ownership. That means you’ll be trusted to boldly innovate, supported to learn fast, and celebrated for successful collaboration.
