jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The roleThis is not a testing role in the traditional sense.
jobs.description:
The role

This is not a testing role in the traditional sense. We're not looking for someone to catch bugs at the end of the pipeline and hand them back. We're looking for someone to own how quality happens across the entire product. As we like to put it: QA owns the testing strategy, not product quality. Product quality is shared by Product and Engineering.

Your job is to make sure the whole system is set up so that everyone can build confidence in what we ship, from the moment a feature is designed to the moment it's released. That means enabling engineers to test effectively, driving a quality mindset across teams, and building the systems and processes that support it, not just writing and running test cases.

We think about quality the way our users experience the product: as complete journeys, not as a checklist of acceptance criteria. If you read this and think "quality is someone else's problem once I've logged the bug," this role isn't for you. If you think in terms of "can the user actually achieve their goal here, and how do I make the whole team confident that they can," keep reading.

This is a senior role because it demands ownership. Not the word, the behavior: seeing what needs to happen and making it happen without being told, working across Product, Engineering, Data as a matter of course, and taking responsibility for the testing strategy of a feature end to end.

Core responsibilities

  • Own the testing strategy for the features and areas you work on. Decide how confidence gets built, which validation happens at which layer (unit, component, integration, API, golden, E2E, accessibility, performance, security, manual, exploratory), rather than defaulting everything to end-to-end testing.
  • Get involved early. Join discovery and specification reviews before development starts: clarify assumptions, surface edge cases, identify risks and dependencies, and ask the hard questions ("what happens if the API fails, if permissions are denied, if the user abandons the flow?").
  • Design test cases as part of feature development, not after it. Covering user journeys, happy paths, edge cases, error handling, recovery, and regression.
  • Enable engineers to own their part of quality. Give developers the test suites, regression packs, environments, and mock data they need to validate their own work before it reaches you, and help build a culture where they do.
  • Do the testing that matters. Structured execution of prepared cases plus mandatory exploratory testing to find what predefined cases can't predict, like usability issues, cross-feature interactions, and wrong assumptions.
  • Maintain a living view of test coverage per feature. So release decisions are based on measurable confidence rather than "the ticket is closed."
  • Continuously improve the automation strategy and the process itself. Reduce flakiness, close coverage gaps, cut repetitive manual regression, and free up time for exploratory, accessibility, security, and performance work.
  • Bring AI/LLM tools into the workflow. Use them to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and exploratory testing, and keep pushing the team's QA practices forward as new tools emerge.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Senior level experience in QA. You've owned quality for real features or products, made your own calls on testing strategy, and been accountable for the outcome, not just executed test plans someone else wrote.
  • A genuine ownership and proactivity mindset. You spot gaps and close them, you drive things rather than wait to be assigned, and you don't treat quality as "done" the moment a bug is filed.
  • A user- and product-first way of thinking. You test journeys and business outcomes, not just acceptance criteria, and you keep the user at the center of every decision about what and how to test.
  • Security mindset.
  • Comfort with the "shift-left" idea: quality is built throughout development, not verified at the end.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as WebdriverIO, Patrol, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or Playwright.
  • Experience writing backend tests (API, unit, database) and testing RESTful services with tools such as Postman or similar
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
  • We prioritise strong automation skills, but if your background is mostly manual, a proactive attitude, a solid technical base, and a real drive to pick up automation quickly - will still get our attention.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in web3 or fintech, or anywhere you've tested products that handle real money. When money is on the line, there's no room for "probably fine," so it sharpens your attention to detail and your instinct for edge cases in a way that carries over well here.
  • Experience with testing across multiple layers (API, integration, golden/screenshot, performance, accessibility).
  • Experience with security testing

Personality Traits We Value

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
  • Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 140 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

ABOUT ROCKET MONEY🔮

Rocket Money’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial prosperity of millions of people. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

Rocket Money’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial lives of millions of people. We help customers understand their money, reduce waste, stay on top of bills and subscriptions, and take action with more confidence.

The Agents Group is building the agentic systems that let Rocket Money move from helpful product surfaces to assistants that can safely and reliably finish work for customers. The group owns the system responsible for enabling agentic capabilities and the methods that let agents interact with customers and systems across various contact methods (phone, email, web bots, etc) and autonomous workflows.

This work sits at the intersection of LLM-powered reasoning, deterministic execution systems, tool orchestration, product constraints, observability, evaluation, trust and safety, and consumer-grade product craft. The bar is not “can the agent respond?” The bar is “can the agent correctly, safely, and verifiably complete the work?”

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will help build, evolve, and operate the Capabilities Engine: the core platform that makes agentic behavior reliable, reusable, observable, and production-ready across Rocket Money’s AI-powered experiences.

You will create the primitives that capability teams need to turn ambiguous product needs into shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems. You will also partner with contact-method owners across phone, email, chat, web login, ODC, and autonomous workflows to make each method more agentic and better integrated with the Capabilities Engine. That means helping agents plan, discover and invoke capabilities, recover from ambiguity, handle real-world edge cases, and complete user-facing work safely and correctly.

This role is for an engineer who is excited by—and experienced in—AI as an execution layer, not just a conversation layer. You will build systems that let agents use tools, observe outcomes, recover from failure, and earn enough trust to act on behalf of users.

You will work across product and platform boundaries, moving between architecture, implementation, debugging, evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. Success means making the Capabilities Engine easier to extend, operate, and integrate with; improving task completion and recovery across methods; and ensuring new capabilities ship with clear contracts, tests, traces, ownership, and production-readiness expectations.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:

  • Build, evolve, and operate the Capabilities Engine as a core platform for agentic product behavior.
  • Design abstractions that make capabilities easy for agents and methods to discover, invoke, compose, observe, and improve.
  • Partner with method owners across all contact method subagents as well as supporting agents to make each method more agentic and better integrated with the Capabilities Engine.
  • Identify repeated patterns across methods and turn them into reusable capabilities, interfaces, evaluations, and operating practices.
  • Provide guidance on how to monitor and optimize reliability, latency, cost, observability, and safety of capability execution in production.
  • Develop practical evaluation loops for agentic behavior, including offline tests, production metrics, traces, regression suites, and qualitative review.
  • Debug complex failures across model behavior, tool execution, orchestration, product constraints, and downstream systems.
  • Translate ambiguous product needs into shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems.
  • Create the primitives capability teams need to successfully produce shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems.
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, platform, and operations partners to ensure capabilities are useful, understandable, and safe for real users.
  • Mentor and develop engineers across the Agents Group, acting as a technical multiplier by sharing expertise, fostering a culture where others feel empowered to propose ideas and take on high-impact work, and helping shape the group's overall technical direction and standards.
  • Document system behavior, capability contracts, tradeoffs, and operational expectations so other teams can build on the platform confidently.
  • Drop into high-priority method work when needed to accelerate agentic behavior, unblock launches, or stabilize production issues.
  • Stay curious about the frontier of applied AI engineering and help the team adopt new tools, patterns, and workflows where they make the product more dependable.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

  • Have experience shipping production software with strong engineering fundamentals.
  • Are excited by AI as an execution layer. You understand that durable customer value comes from orchestration, tools, workflows, evaluation, approvals, observability, and recovery.
  • Have hands-on experience or strong practical familiarity with LLM applications, agentic systems, tool calling, retrieval, workflow orchestration, or applied AI products.
  • Have strong product judgment. You can reason from customer need to product experience to technical architecture, and you know the difference between a clever demo and a dependable customer-facing system.
  • Are comfortable working across ambiguity. You can take a broad problem, identify the crux, sequence the work, make tradeoffs, and keep moving without waiting for perfect clarity.
  • Like building platform abstractions and shared services that help multiple teams or product surfaces move faster.
  • Hold a high bar for quality, reliability, and trust. You know that systems acting on behalf of users need clear contracts, observability, evaluation, and recovery paths.
  • Are energized by debugging messy production behavior across model outputs, distributed systems, product logic, user context, and downstream integrations.
  • Communicate clearly with engineering, product, design, data, operations, and platform partners.
  • Are motivated to actively mentor and grow others.
  • Are a tenacious learner who stays engaged with the frontier of AI engineering without chasing every shiny object.
  • Are motivated by measurable customer and operational impact, not just interesting technical demos.

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE:

  • Experience building production LLM applications, agentic systems, workflow engines, tool-calling systems, or AI-powered product surfaces.
  • Experience designing capability platforms, shared services, orchestration systems, or reusable product infrastructure.
  • Experience with TypeScript, Node, GraphQL, Postgres, LLM applications, agentic systems, and workflow orchestration.
  • Experience creating evaluation and observability systems for probabilistic or agentic behavior.
  • Experience improving reliability, alerting, tracing, incident response, operational quality, or other systems that make software safer and more dependable over time.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Legal, Support, or other cross-functional teams in a sensitive customer domain.
  • Firsthand experience building products where customer trust, permissions, explainability, and recovery paths are central to the experience.
  • A visible habit of turning repeated one-off work into reusable systems, patterns, and documentation.

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms.

You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP-based, open-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models.   • Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near-real-time operational metrics.

  • Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products.
  • Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business.
  • Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve.

What You Need (Must-Haves):

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT.
  • Proven track record of owning data products end-to-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment.

    • Expert-level SQL and DBT skills for complex queries and data transformations.
    • Proficiency in Python for transformations that extend beyond SQL.
    • Hands-on experience with query optimization across OLTP and OLAP systems (e.g., Postgres, Iceberg).
    • Proficiency with Semantic Layer modelling (e.g. Cube, dbt Semantic Layer).
    • Experience owning CI/CD workflows and establishing team-wide standards for version control and code review (e.g., Git).
    • Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP or AWS).

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with data ingestion tools (e.g., Airbyte) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
  • Domain experience for brokerage operations or a passion for financial markets and modelling financial datasets.

  • Health Benefits

As fleets become more connected, data-driven and technology-enabled, our clients are looking for a partner who can help them lower costs, improve productivity, manage risk and rethink how their fleets operate.


As a Relationship Manager, you will own a portfolio of important Element clients and be accountable for the health, retention and growth of those relationships. You will know your clients' businesses, understand what matters to their executives and bring the best of Element to solve their problems.

  • Develop and extend the shared component library and design tokens, implementing Figma specs faithfully across light and dark themes.

  • Own the server tier that sits between the browser and the platform: request proxying, session handling, and keeping backend service URLs and credentials securely off the client.

  • Implement authentication and authorization in the web tier — OIDC login against the platform auth service, JWT claim verification, session expiry, and role-based UI gating that mirrors platform permissions.

  • Maintain the generated TypeScript SDK produced from the platform's OpenAPI specification, including the codegen pipeline, compatibility gates, and drift detection against the live API.

  • Partner with backend teams on API contracts — push back when a response shape does not efficiently serve the UI, and negotiate the change rather than building front-end workarounds.

  • Write tests at every level — component tests with mocked network behavior, and Playwright end-to-end suites that run against live environments.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsive behavior, and optimal web performance (bundle size, render cost, and what ships to the browser on each route).

  • Instrument the application for production: error tracking, product analytics, feature flags, and structured logging.

  • Review peers' code, debug production issues to root cause with regression coverage, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews.

Senior Product Manager, Services #1149

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Services & Marketplace with 7+ years of product management experience to identify, launch, and grow Decisiv’s portfolio of billable add-on services and third-party marketplace offerings - creating new revenue streams that expand the value of the SRM platform.

In this role, you’ll own the full lifecycle of add-on services - from opportunity sizing and pricing strategy through launch, P&L performance, and EOL decisions. You’ll lead Decisiv’s third-party marketplace strategy, building a point of view on who to partner with versus when to build, and how to structure agreements that benefit the ecosystem without compromising Decisiv’s roadmap. Representing Decisiv externally, you’ll engage directly with potential partners and drive relationships from initial conversation through signed contracts.

You’ll collaborate closely with the Product Managers who own Decisiv’s APIs, platform capabilities and applications, contributing clear business and use case requirements that inform integration and application interaction design. You’ll bring enough technical and data fluency and SaaS experience to engage credibly with engineering and partners, and enough commercial instinct to keep every investment tied to real outcomes.

This role reports directly to the Chief Product Officer and partners closely with Product Development, Engineering, Customer Success, and Product Marketing. This is a remote role based in the United States, with occasional travel for partner engagements, customer visits, and company events.

Key Responsibilities

As a senior member of the Product organization, you will play a central role in shaping and monetizing Decisiv’s services and marketplace ecosystem:

  • Own the discovery, definition, and roadmap for Decisiv’s portfolio of billable add-on services that complement core platform capabilities and drive incremental revenue
  • Lead the full service investment lifecycle—build-vs-partner decisions, launch, adoption tracking, and ongoing P&L performance
  • Define and manage pricing strategies for add-on services, including subscription, usage-based, and tiered models, with ongoing margin and profitability analysis
  • Make disciplined invest/sustain/EOL decisions grounded in usage data, customer value, and financial performance
  • Lead Decisiv’s third-party marketplace strategy—identify, evaluate, and onboard partners whose services extend platform value for customers, dealers, fleets, and OEMs
  • Develop and maintain a rigorous competitive and partner landscape view—distinguishing partners to enable, compete against, or limit, and translating that into clear positioning decisions
  • Represent Decisiv externally as the primary commercial and product lead for third-party partnerships, driving relationships from first conversation through agreement execution
  • Lead or support contract and partnership negotiations, working with legal, finance, and executive leadership to structure agreements that deliver mutual value
  • Collaborate with platform PMs to contribute business and use case requirements for APIs that enable first- and third-party services
  • Leverage customer insights, market research, and usage analytics to validate service investments, inform pricing, and guide portfolio prioritization
  • Engage regularly with customers, prospects, and partners to gather feedback and evangelize the Decisiv services and marketplace strategy
  • Partner with Product Marketing on service and marketplace launches, including positioning, pricing communications, sales enablement, and go-to-market planning

Skills & Experience

Must Have Requirements:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experiencebuilding and scaling B2B SaaS products, with ownership of revenue-generating services or monetized platform capabilities
  • Proven P&L ownership and financial acumen—pricing model definition, service profitability tracking, and data-driven invest/sustain/EOL recommendations
  • Experience developing SaaS pricing strategies—subscription, usage-based, and tiered—with an understanding of margin management and competitive pricing dynamics
  • Demonstrated success identifying and managing third-party partnerships—partner evaluation, marketplace or integration agreements, and ongoing relationship management
  • Strong competitive intelligence skills applied to build-vs.-partner decisions and differentiated product positioning
  • Experience supporting or leading contract negotiations and commercial agreements with third-party vendors or technology partners
  • Technical aptitudesufficient to contribute meaningful API use case requirements and engage credibly with engineering teams and external technical partners
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and influence skills—with a track record of representing a product or company externally and driving clear decisions across stakeholders
  • High degree of professionalism, ownership, and accountability in a remote, collaborative, cross-functional environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience across product, commercial, and technical teams

Strong Pluses

  • Industry experience in commercial vehicle, fleet management, telematics, heavy equipment, transportation, or automotive—with an understanding of how fleets, dealers, OEMs, and service networks operate and buy
  • Familiarity with fleet management systems (FMS), dealer management systems (DMS), telematics platforms, or IoT-connected asset ecosystems in data-rich, integration-heavy environments
  • Experience building or operating a SaaS marketplace or app ecosystem, including partner onboarding, certification, revenue-sharing models, and governance
  • Background at the intersection of product management and business development—converting partner opportunities into launched, revenue-generating integrations or services
  • Working knowledge of API-based integration patterns—outbound data sharing and inbound data ingestion scenarios in SaaS platforms
  • Strong financial modeling and business case development skills; MBA or equivalent is a plus

Required

jobs.excerpt: About Community Solutions:Community Solutions is a “field catalyst” working to align and mobilize actors, locally and nationally who impact homelessness toward the shared goal of making homelessness rare and brief, everywhere.
jobs.description:
About Community Solutions:

Community Solutions is a “field catalyst” working to align and mobilize actors, locally and nationally who impact homelessness toward the shared goal of making homelessness rare and brief, everywhere. The organization directly supports more than 140 communities in the US in implementing accountable, community-wide efforts that drive measurable reductions in homelessness. This solutions-focused approach involves rigorous collaboration of public and private efforts, comprehensive, real-time information on those experiencing homelessness and increased access to housing. By 2027, Community Solutions’ network aims to reach a tipping point where homelessness is widely perceived to be solvable and public opinion has measurably shifted to support solutions; reductions in homelessness have been achieved in a diverse and growing array of communities, and solutions-focused policies increasingly drive federal, state, and local responses.

Achieving this “tipping point” requires the political will of elected officials, which in turn requires the expectation and support of community leaders.

Position Overview:

Community Solutions has built working AI tools in-house, quickly and at a cost that wasn’t possible before, and our portfolio is growing. The constraint now is that nearly all of the hands-on work- building the tools, making the build-or-partner calls, carrying the funder and technology relationships, preparing and executing a testing and deployment strategy, and forecasting the role that AI may play in our future strategy for making homelessness rare and brief nationwide sits with a small group part-time. The Senior Consultant will provide additional capacity and expertise to advance this work.

The Senior Consultant will support and advance the organization’s AI work in the field: guiding the building and shipping of tools for testing and refinement within our network of 170+ communities and informing the strategy for moving high-impact prototypes into adoption across the network. The Senior Consultant will help inform and apply Community Solutions’ principles around AI use and assure everything produced keeps a human in the decision loop and protects the dignity and data of the people the work serves. The Senior Consultant will review AI tools throughout development and deployment to control for bias.

The Senior Consultant will work closely with Community Solutions’ internal and external partners to advance the AI portfolio, support the development and testing of tools, and help identify opportunities to move high-impact prototypes toward adoption. The Senior Consultant will also develop the budget associated with the go-to-market strategy and present recommendations to the Community Solutions Executive Team and Board of Directors for review and approval.

Defining Success for this Position in Year One:

  • At least one AI tool moves from prototype to active use in Community Solutions’ partner communities.
  • The privacy-safe infrastructure needed to pilot tools that touch sensitive data is stood up and validated.
  • At least one meaningful technology or funding partnership is established that did not exist before this person joined.
  • The portfolio compounds, with tools building on each other rather than accumulating as one-offs.
  • The Year One AI strategy aligns with and informs Community Solutions’ post-2026 strategy.
  • Community Solutions has a credible, grounded voice on AI in homelessness response, demonstrated through what we ship and what we publish.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

A meaningful part of the role may involve building. The Senior Consultant will determine optimal strategies for developing and testing AI tools and prototypes, will own the technical architecture for the portfolio, and make the call on what to build in-house versus what to partner on or contract out. For anything touching client data, the Senior Consultant will be responsible for establishing a privacy-safe and local deployment approach.

Much of the initial work is expected to be external-facing but will interact with the in-house development team and potential development partners to continually refine high-impact products, manage relationships with technology partners, pursue opportunities through corporate AI programs, accelerators, and philanthropy, and track the AI for good landscape closely enough to move on time-sensitive windows. The Senior Consultant will be expected to carry key build and implementation relationships directly.

For the essential field adoption and governance questions involved in testing and implementing AI tools, the Senior Consultant will oversee the work with partner communities to pilot tools, gather feedback, and determine a scale strategy for tested tools with high impact potential. This will involve guiding the translation of tools into documentation and training accessible to practitioners.

Professional Experience and Qualifications:

  • The combination this role requires is unusual: technical depth, product judgment, and the ability to manage external partnerships without much hand-holding.
  • Demonstrated ability to build with current AI tools and ship working software, with comfort across the stack, APIs, prototyping, and data work. Familiarity with model deployment, security, and compliance is a strong plus.
  • Product judgment, meaning a track record of knowing what is worth building and what isn’t.
  • Experience managing partnerships with external organizations, ideally including technology or funding partners.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving situations and a bias toward shipping over planning.
  • Commitment to Community Solutions’ mission. Familiarity with homelessness or human services; data is a plus, or the ability to learn it fast matters more.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work credibly with field users, technology partners, and funders.

Salary

The compensation range for this consulting position is $168,827 - $191,848. The actual compensation will be commensurate with the consultant’s experience and qualifications.

Work Environment

The position provides for the flexibility to work from a remote US location without the standard support available at an office. Travel will be required to meet with communities, partners, and allies.

Diversity and Inclusion

We strive for inclusivity and diversity by attracting extraordinary people from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We seek to employ an all-star team of people who vary by their race and ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, age, culture, religion, veteran status, physical and mental abilities. We promote equal opportunity in the recruitment, selection, training, compensation, promotion, and benefits of all employees. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT RELENTLESS Relentless is an organizing company focused on unlocking political power through relational organizing.
jobs.description:
ABOUT RELENTLESS

Relentless is an organizing company focused on unlocking political power through relational organizing. Relational organizing is the simple, proven concept that people talking to their friends and family is more effective than strangers talking to strangers. Our flagship product, Rally, is a social graph, power-mapping tool, and program management platform that makes running scaled relational programs simple. Our in-house program team brings their deep experience to supercharge the programs that run on Rally and mobilize communities at scale to have meaningful conversations, get out the vote, and so much more.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This cycle, we’re running Rally Organizing programs that compensate tens of thousands of low-turnout voters for their time as they learn about upcoming elections and mobilize and persuade their friends and family to vote.

If virtual events are the heart of our program, the inbox is the brain. Our inbox is where participants go to celebrate successes, ask specific questions, and troubleshoot technical issues. We are often meeting participants at a vulnerable moment of frustration, and it is up to our inbox team to turn it into a positive experience for each person who interacts with a member of our team.

The Inbox Manager is the senior manager on duty for our program inbox; in the world of inbox, the buck stops with them! They also oversee our part-time program organizers (POs) during their inbox shifts – handling questions, escalations, and issues, while empowering each PO with the knowledge and support they need to problem solve effectively.

The Inbox Coordinator lives and breathes inbox support, and acts as the first level of support for program organizers (POs) during their inbox shifts – answering the questions they can, escalating those they can’t, and keeping the Inbox Manager informed of both how the inbox capacity is going and how POs are doing in the inbox.

Our program organizers will come from a wide range of work backgrounds and experience levels, and you should be genuinely excited by that — energized by meeting each one where they are and making sure everyone has what they need to succeed.

While the Inbox Manager will lead, the Inbox Coordinator will support the team as together you lead check-in calls with POs for their inbox shifts, provide targeted feedback on PO responses, and make sure we are at inbox 0 by the end of each work day. The Inbox Team will own complex and escalated tickets, loop in senior members of staff when necessary, and coordinate with multiple departments to answer participants' questions in a timely and efficient manner. The Inbox Manager makes the game plan, and the Inbox Coordinator helps to execute.

If you’re energized by solving complex participant inquiries with kindness and efficiency and love empowering a team to do the same, this team is built for you.

Inbox Manager: This is a full-time cycle role with an anticipated start date of September 22nd and an end date of November 13th, 2026.

Inbox Coordinator: This is a full-time cycle role with an anticipated start date of September 29th and an end date of November 13th, 2026.

DETAILS & COMPENSATION

Location: Remote

Compensation: Inbox Manager: $6,000/month, Inbox Coordinator: $5,250/month

Schedule: Full-time

Hours Expectations: This role requires a flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends, to accommodate recruitment and event volume. We anticipate a six day workweek in the final stretch, starting in October and running through Election Day.

JOB DUTIES

  • Implement a training program that equips 50+ program organizers with basic Zendesk knowledge, ticket workflows, and FAQ resources, prepping them for a high volume of tickets throughout the program.
  • Manage the execution of our inbox from end to end – ensuring that our part-time staff is informed and supported during each inbox shift. This looks like:
    • Lead check-in calls at the start of every PO’s inbox shift throughout the day – giving updates as information changes throughout the course of the program and reconnecting POs to the greater purpose of Relentless’s work.
    • Being the Manager-On-Duty for every inbox shift – handling questions in the Slack channel, monitoring the escalation folders, and jumping in during periods of high volume to ensure inbox 0 by the end of each workday.
    • General inbox oversight– noting patterns of high volume, question or issue trends, and staffing shortages or excesses – and escalating those observations to senior management.
  • Provide feedback on individual PO’s performance to the Deputy Director of Programs, Organizer Experience to ensure our participants get the best experience possible with our inbox team.
  • Handle the most sensitive and complex participant issues – looping in senior staff, coordinating across departments, and documenting any edge cases.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as they come up, with the expectation that your day-to-day mix of work will shift with program needs.
  • Inbox Manager: In collaboration with the Content Logistics Manager and Events Manager, you’ll ensure that our robust FAQs and Knowledge Base is updated throughout the program so that our POs have everything they need to answer questions in the inbox.
  • Inbox Manager: Directly manage the Inbox Coordinator, providing direction and feedback as they support and coach PO’s in the inbox each day.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Inbox Manager: Experience managing and leading staff, with a preference for those with experience leading sales, customer service, or help desk teams. Inbox Coordinator: Leadership or Team Captain experience a plus, with a preference for those with experience leading a team of vols or part-time staff.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate our event scripting voice into text and email messages in the inbox, ensuring a unified and friendly program experience from top to bottom.
  • You stay cool under pressure, have patience for a variety of communication styles, and are eager to meet participants and part-time staff where they’re at each day.
  • You’re a problem solver – you enjoy thinking through complex and niche participant issues to effectively and efficiently solve them, and are able to coach others to do the same.
  • Comfort and energy in fast-paced, scaling environments where priorities shift and you adapt with the team, ready and excited to jump in wherever needed to ensure inbox 0 at the end of each work day.
  • Access to a computer and reliable internet.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk highly preferred, or the willingness and ability to learn it quickly.

We’re excited about candidates who lead with empathy, care about accessibility in their communication, and are eager to motivate a team of enthusiastic and diverse workers.

HOW TO APPLY

In lieu of a cover letter, we’ll ask you to answer a couple of short-answer questions as well as a short skills assessment.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Relentless provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We welcome applicants from any educational background, race, ethnicity, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, sex, age, immigration status, citizenship status, national origin or ancestry, marital status, pregnancy, criminal record, mental or physical disability or disorder, HIV antibody status, parental or familial status, or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, leveraging expertise to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI Systems, Model Optimization
jobs.excerpt: About UnconventionalSince 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, AI Systems, Model Optimization, you will develop the path from model architecture to physical silicon. You will develop the training techniques, optimization strategies, and infrastructure required to make AI models run efficiently on our novel compute substrates, closing the loop between model design and tapeout.

What You'll Do

  • Energy Benchmarking & Performance Modeling: Develop rigorous performance models to evaluate compute, memory, and energy trade-offs. Track pareto-optimality across models and hardware configurations.
  • Advanced Mapping & Partitioning: Drive the partitioning and mapping of complex AI models down to hardware. Apply and invent advanced optimization strategies from first principles, including custom quantization schemes, sparsity/pruning, and distillation to fit the physical constraints of our substrates.
  • Hardware-Aware Training: Develop and apply Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), noise-aware training, and sparsification techniques to adapt models to the physical constraints of our analog compute substrates, including memory footprint, connectivity, precision, and noise.
  • GPU Optimization & Kernel Development: Develop and optimize kernels using low-level programming models like CUDA, Triton, or CUTLASS. Profile and debug complex ML codebases to resolve performance bottlenecks (training and inference).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a translator between AI model architects and hardware/infrastructure engineering teams, converting model requirements into concrete specifications and codifying learnings for tapeouts.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: An MS/PhD or equivalent research/project experience in a quantitative field such as AI/Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or Applied Math.
  • Experience: Deep, practical understanding of the modern AI/ML stack and optimized compilation and execution of algorithms on modern GPU systems. Proven experience in profiling, identifying, and resolving performance bottlenecks in complex ML codebases.
  • Systems Fluency: Demonstrated ability to map state-of-the-art AI model architectures (e.g., Transformers, Mixture of Experts, diffusion models) to system performance implications and apply advanced efficiency techniques such as sparsity, quantization, and distillation.
  • Software Development: Deep experience with PyTorch, including its internals, torch.compile, and distributed data parallel (DDP) / fully sharded data parallel (FSDP) libraries.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  • Training Infrastructure: Experience with production-grade training frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed) and distributed training at scale.
  • Unconventional Co-Design: A forward-looking perspective on co-designing training systems for unconventional computing paradigms that map closely to the physics of underlying systems.
  • Next-Gen Efficiency: Research or practical experience in advanced approximation/compression techniques beyond standard quantization, including noise-aware or physics-constrained training.

Why Join Us?

  • The Mission: Redefine computing for the next 50 years by solving the fundamental energy limitation of AI at a global scale.
  • The Impact: Shape the company's future as a foundational team member. Enjoy massive ownership and an outsized opportunity to drive change.
  • The Perks: A comprehensive package including best-in-class health benefits, 401k matching, truly unlimited PTO, and complimentary meals in our Palo Alto office.

jobs.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

  • Test Engineer
  • Full Time
  • Remote

The Test Engineer plays a critical role in software validation by designing, executing, and assisting with the maintenance of test cases to ensure the system meets defined requirements, perform as intended, and is free of defects prior to deployments. This position is responsible for software verification and validation (V&V) activities, ensuring that enterprise systems meet functional performance, and compliance requirements – particularly for U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) programs. The Test Engineer will support formal and informal testing while ensuring the collection of Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) to support system certification and accreditation. The ideal candidate brings at least 2 years of relevant experience in software testing, validation and test automation within complex IT enterprise systems such as Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or similar platforms in regulated settings – and possesses hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute test cases to validate system functionality, data integrity, and end-to-end business processes.
  • Maintain and refine automated test scripts using approved automation tools (e.g., Eggplant, Selenium, Katalon, or equivalent automated testing tools).
  • Support end-to-end validation efforts across integrated systems, including PLM, ERP, and interface/data exchange processes.
  • Support in the coordination and completion of internal testing activities (e.g., smoke, system, functional and regression testing) to ensure timely development completion and quality devlivery of software.
  • Ensure all testing activities produce appropriate OQE artifacts in support of DoD compliance requirements.
  • Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development and functional teams to support resolution and retesting.
  • Analyze test results and provide clear, concise status updates and report to the Test Lead.
  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects to align with DoD validation requirements.
  • Assist in building and expanding the regression test suite to support ongoing releases and system changes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., QA, IT, business users) to ensure alignment of testing scope, data, and expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency and quality.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required; advanced degree, relevant internship experience, or equivalent hands-on industry experience may be considered in lieu of traditional qualifications.
  • 2+ years of experience with test automation frameworks, scripting languages, and tools (e.g., Selenium, Katalon, Eggplant, Python, XML, JSON).
  • Experience with PLM platforms (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Enovia) or other enterprise systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of test planning, execution, and documentation aligned with DoD standards.
  • Experience producing OQE artifacts to support system certification/accreditation or acceptance reviews.
  • Proficient with tools such as Microsoft Office, Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance or be able to receive and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with DoD or federal system development lifecycle (SDLC) processes and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of DoD software documentation standards, including SDD, IDD, SDP, ICD, and CDRL requirements.
  • Understanding of RMF, ATO, and Cybersecurity Testing/Validation (e.g., STIG compliance).
  • Exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Model-Based Testing (MBT) practices.
  • Experience in Agile or hybrid Agile/Waterfall environments, and use of tools like Zephyr, TestRail, or qTest.
  • Security+ or other DoD 8570-compliant certification preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • This position may require the ability to travel up to 5%.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions will require access to U.S. National Security information. Positions that require this access will be required to receive and maintain a U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order to qualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currently possess this National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination and maintain that eligibility throughout their employment.

jobs.description:
Executive Director

Association for Death Education and Counseling

New York, New York (remote)


The Moran Company is pleased to partner with the Association for Death Education and Counseling to recruit the organization’s new Executive Director.

Organizational Background

The Association for Death Education and Counseling (ADEC) was formed in May 1976, when a group of interested educators and clinicians organized the Forum for Death Education and Counseling. Over the years, the organization grew to become the Association for Death Education and Counseling®. ADEC is the first interdisciplinary organization in the field of thanatology: the study of dying, death, and bereavement.

ADEC endeavors to promote and share research, theories, and practice in dying, death, loss, and bereavement. ADEC’s primary goals are to:
  • Promote excellence and recognize diversity in death education, care of the dying, grief counseling and research in thanatology
  • Provide leading-edge information, support and resources to ADEC’s international, multicultural, multidisciplinary membership and, through them, to the public.
  • Facilitate the sharing of research, theory and practice in death, dying and bereavement.
  • Recognize, through the Credentialing Program, those with specialized knowledge and experience in the field.
As an international nonprofit organization, ADEC’s members are cross-disciplinary specialists who practice within the scope of dying, death, loss, and bereavement. Members and credentialed colleagues include front-line care providers, clinicians, practitioners, educators, researchers, administrators, and others emerging from a wide variety of educational backgrounds, professions, and occupations.

Position Summary

The ADEC Board of Directors seeks an experienced and highly skilled Executive Director to work collaboratively with the Board, staff, and membership to lead and support all areas of the organization. The major responsibilities of the position include:
  • Providing and supporting leadership
  • Supporting the infrastructure of ADEC
  • Coordinating event planning and management
  • Maintaining and enhancing the financial sustainability of ADEC
As the administrative leader of ADEC, the Executive Director has the responsibility to effectively represent the organization and ensure all functions and services of the organization are focused on the ADEC mission: The Association for Death Education and Counseling® is an international, professional organization dedicated to promoting excellence and recognizing diversity in death education, care of the dying, grief counseling and research in thanatology. Based on quality research, theory and practice, the association provides information, support and resources to its international, multicultural, multidisciplinary membership and to the public.

NOTE: This is a remote Executive Director position.

Professional Qualifications and Personal Characteristics

The following qualifications and characteristics are desired for this position. Additionally, the successful candidate must possess a strong ability and desire to support the membership of ADEC.
  • Excellent experience in event planning management, membership, and meeting software
  • Transparent and high-integrity leadership
  • Ability to oversee and coordinate the implementation of ADEC’s programs that carry out the organization’s mission
  • Successful track record of effectively working with a volunteer Board of Directors to advance the mission of the organization
  • Experience working with the Board and staff to ensure that the mission is fulfilled through programs, strategic planning, and community outreach
  • Ability to support ADEC committees and volunteers to achieve the mission and goals as set by the Board
  • Successful experience in leading and managing staff and contractors
  • Demonstrated success in nonprofit fundraising, fund development, and membership growth
  • Ability to effectively manage all financial aspects of ADEC
Preferred Education and Experience

Master’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience. Five or more years of senior nonprofit management and leadership experience or equivalent experience. Preference will be given to those candidates holding the Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification.

Compensation

The ADEC Executive Director will receive a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. Salary is expected to be in the $100,000 range. ADEC does not offer benefits; additional compensation may be provided that can be used to access benefits. Paid time off and holidays will be included in the employment contract.

Statement of Non-Discrimination

The Association for Death Education and Counseling is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, genetic information, service in the military or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

Application Process

The search for the Association for Death Education and Counseling Executive Director is being conducted by The Moran Company. Questions about the position can be directed to Jon Rosell, Senior Search Consultant, The Moran Company at jon (at) morancompany.com. To apply for this position, submit a resume and cover letter via the secure online portal. Screening interviews for selected candidates are scheduled to take place approximately October 22nd – 23rd, 2026.

Our valet trash service provides simple, community-wide waste solutions. Fetch Market offers direct-to-door delivery of everyday essentials, giving residents unparalleled convenience. Fetch Storage extends our mission by offering secure, flexible storage options tailored to multifamily living.

Operating in communities across the U.S., we are tackling complex logistical challenges every day, from last-mile delivery to amenity innovation, while creating seamless living experiences for residents and measurable value for property managers and owners. With substantial growth ahead, Fetch continues to shape the future of multifamily living by combining technology, logistics, and hospitality into one cohesive platform.

Our Opportunity:

    We’re hiring a Manager of Partner Experience & Onboarding to own how Fetch attracts, onboards, and retains service partners who power our network. This role covers both Delivery Partners on the package side and Trash Service Partners on the valet trash side of the business, across every market we operate in. In this role you will own the strategy, the outcomes, and the quality of the experience a partner has from the moment they find us, through their first block, and every block after that. You decide where we source, how recruitment dollars are spent market by market, what a healthy funnel looks like, and where the onboarding workflow needs to change. You lead the team who executes against that plan. Success looks like consistent schedule fill, partners who move through onboarding without getting stuck, and service partners who think highly enough of Fetch to keep coming back for more work.

What you’ll deliver on the job:

    • Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for Service Partners: where we list, what we spend on recruitment, and how that spend is localized market by market so application volume matches the real capacity needs of each market

    • Own the metrics that define a healthy funnel, including application volume by market, conversion rate through each stage, cost per applicant, cost per activation, and time to first block, and drive every one of them in the right direction

    • Own sustained fill rates across the network, and partner with operations leadership early and directly whenever coverage is at risk in a market

    • Own the onboarding and recruitment workflows end-to-end—optimizing technical efficiency, calibrating screening friction to balance quality and conversion, and leading a targeted multi-channel communications strategy.

    • Take a holistic view of the full service partner experience, from application to first block to ongoing work, covering first-day experience, pay transparency, the in-app experience, and support responsiveness, so that partners view Fetch positively, come back for more blocks, and stay on the platform long term

    • Partner closely with Operations leadership to ensure they feel supported, identify the root cause of fill related issues and develop a recovery plan for each team as needed

    • Create sustainable feedback loops to consistently evaluate and improve the DP experience, and the ability to report on those findings to leadership in a clear and concise manner

    • Apply strong critical thinking when conversion, fill, or retention degrades: run root cause analysis to find the true driver rather than the symptom, and build a durable fix instead of a temporary patch

    • Lead, coach, and develop the specialists reporting into this role, setting their priorities and raising the ceiling on what this function can deliver

This cycle of the Atlantbh Internship will be organized remotely (with an opportunity for some in-office visits).

Internship programs

Software Development (2 interns)

Interns will develop a full-stack application using cutting edge technologies and learn how to implement best coding practices. RESTful web services will be developed using back-end technologies based on Java programming language and frameworks, such as Spring Boot.

The application’s front-end will be developed using React or Angular. Interns will have the opportunity to familiarize themselves with other interesting concepts during different stages of software development including Git, Jenkins, Maven, AWS, JUnit, Design patterns, MVC and CI. Additionally, the project will include working with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, as well as communication with external APIs. Finally, interns will have the opportunity to learn from experienced Software Engineers through workshop presentations and one-on-one mentorship.

Quality Assurance (2 interns)

Interns will have the opportunity to learn how to validate a web application, becoming familiar with all the necessary techniques, technologies and principles used for quality assurance of a system. They will work on designing and creating test plans, creating and executing test cases and learn about testing methodologies, as well as when to execute different kinds of tests (Smoke, Regression, API, etc.), in order to assure product quality.

The interns will collaborate with the development team, gaining hands on experience with scrum and the Agile methodology, and learn about the importance of teamwork. Additionally, for this internship cycle, we have organized 2 separate QA programs, distinguished by the applied programming/scripting languages used for automation development.

JS (1 Intern) - Programming/scripting languages include JavaScript, Playwright, Axios, Git, Postman, Jenkins, etc.

Python (1 Intern) - Programming/scripting languages include Python, Playwright, Pytest, Git, Postman, Jenkins, etc.

DevOps (1 intern)

The intern will have the opportunity to expand their knowledge of Linux filesystem and Bash scripting. While adopting DevOps practices, they will learn about CI/CD, containerization and orchestration, infrastructure management, monitoring and networking. During the internship, the intern will collaborate with other interns in a real life scenario. This will include packaging software in Docker images, deploying Docker containers server-side and on Kubernetes, and integration of Frontend and Backend apps with a database. The intern will also learn how to write CI/CD pipelines, automate, build and deploy, manage Kubernetes infrastructure, and basic information security principles.

By the end of the internship, the intern will be acquainted with the tools necessary for setting up and managing infrastructure, Continuous Integration and automated deployment processes (i.e. bash scripting, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, Jenkins, etc.), as well as troubleshooting network issues and basic InfoSec principles.

UX/UI Design (1 intern)

UX/UI design is a field that focuses on creating user-centered designs for web applications. The intern will learn how to create user experiences and interfaces that are intuitive, easy to use and visually pleasing. This will involve using design processes and methodologies that are commonly used in the industry, such as user research, wireframing, prototyping, and user testing. The intern will also have the opportunity to learn how to use design software such as Figma, which is a popular tool for creating and sharing design mockups. Additionally, the intern will be able to experience how design and development teams work together, and how design decisions are integrated into the development process.

Please note, your application for the UX/UI Design internship program must include a portfolio/samples of your work.

Product Management (1 intern)

The intern will have the chance to gain practical experience in product management by working on tasks that simulate real-world scenarios, such as defining product requirements, communicating with stakeholders and the different roles in the development team, and using Agile methodologies and tools such as Trello and Jira. By the end of the internship, the intern will have a solid understanding of Agile practices and be able to apply them in their future career.

Like the other internship projects, the PM program is created for internship purposes only. Nevertheless, it is designed to provide a realistic and valuable learning experience and is modeled after actual challenges and tasks encountered in the field.

Machine Learning (1 intern)

This internship offers a comprehensive introduction to the world of Machine Learning (ML). The goal is to understand and work through the entire ML lifecycle, from processing and manipulating data all the way to model deployment.

During the foundational first month, the focus is on becoming familiar with the tools and practices necessary to create and fine-tune models. Throughout the internship, participants will gain experience with widely adopted open-source tools and ML frameworks, setting the stage for future learning and development.

For this internship cycle, the emphasis is on the solution interpretability of Natural Language Processing (NLP). The NLP programme will cover key concepts such as tokenization and transformer architectures, and the intern will fine-tune pre-trained models for a variety of tasks, including sentiment analysis, summarization, and named entity recognition.

Requirements

The Atlantbh Internship assumes familiarity with the principles of object oriented programming, as well as knowledge of relational and non-relational databases. Candidates must be unemployed and hold BH citizenship. Likewise, students who are completing the final years of their technical university studies will be given priority. Beyond these requirements, however, there are no specific criteria for candidate selection, as Atlantbh considers various factors in the selection process. Although the internship is not intended as a programming school, we expect that some interns will be experiencing certain technologies for the first time.

Candidates interested in more than one Internship program are welcome to submit multiple applications.

Candidates applying for the DevOps internship program should have basic knowledge and experience with Linux based OS, networking, and some scripting language (Bash, Python etc). Any knowledge related to Development, QA and Operations is a plus.

For the UX/UI Design internship program, the candidate's application must include a portfolio (send it to us together with your resume, or via email at ).

Please note, only unemployed applicants that hold BH citizenship will be taken into consideration.

Benefits

Feedback - Interns will have the opportunity to present their work on a monthly basis to receive feedback on various aspects of their work.

Presentations - Experienced Atlantbh engineers will hold presentations for the interns. Topics will cover cutting edge technologies and best practices, as well as their tips and tricks for research, learning and problem solving.
