jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on VoIP/VTC Solution Engineering Manager to lead our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on VoIP/VTC Solution Engineering Manager to lead our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team. Reporting directly to the Director of Digital Engineering, this position is primarily accountable for people leadership, engineering quality, resource planning, and the successful delivery of the team's technical commitments.

This is a people-management role with significant hands-on technical leadership responsibilities. The manager will supervise, mentor, and develop a team of approximately four Solution Engineers while remaining actively engaged in solution architecture, design reviews, complex implementations, and Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering escalations.

As a Level T5 leader, the manager will serve as the domain technical authority for assigned enterprise voice, video teleconferencing (VTC), telephony, and collaboration solutions. The position will partner closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, and vendor partners to establish engineering standards, modernize legacy telephony environments, and architect secure, resilient, and supportable on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-based collaboration solutions.


Key Responsibilities


1. People and Team Leadership

  • Team Management: Directly supervise, coach, and manage a team of approximately four VoIP, VTC, and Telephony Solution Engineers.
  • Performance and Career Development: Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, establish measurable performance objectives, complete annual performance reviews, identify training needs, and guide employee career development.
  • Workload and Capacity Planning: Prioritize projects and engineering tasks, balance workloads across team members, assign technical leads, and ensure the timely delivery of engineering commitments.
  • Staffing and Succession Planning: Forecast staffing requirements, identify technical skill gaps, develop succession and cross-training plans, and maintain appropriate engineering coverage.
  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Lead technical interviews, candidate evaluations, hiring recommendations, and onboarding activities.
  • Team Culture: Foster a high-performing, collaborative, accountable, and inclusive engineering culture that encourages technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

2. Engineering Delivery and Governance

  • Delivery Management: Own the engineering quality, technical execution, schedules, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations associated with the team's assigned work.
  • Engineering Lifecycle: Ensure solutions progress through documented requirements, alternatives analysis, architecture, detailed design, design review, laboratory validation, implementation planning, acceptance testing, configuration control, and transition to operations.
  • Engineering Documentation: Ensure the development and maintenance of high-level and low-level designs, bills of material, test plans, implementation procedures, rollback plans, configuration baselines, and as-built documentation.
  • Operational Readiness: Confirm that new or modified solutions are secure, supportable, monitored, documented, resilient, and ready for operational ownership before deployment or transition.
  • Standards and Compliance: Establish and enforce engineering design standards, approved product and configuration baselines, Quality of Service (QoS) requirements, cybersecurity controls, and disaster recovery and business continuity requirements.
  • Performance Reporting: Establish and communicate meaningful measures for engineering backlog, milestone delivery, design quality, lifecycle risk, operational readiness, and recurring technical issues.

3. Technical Leadership and Architecture

  • Solution Architecture: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and architectural authority for assigned enterprise voice, VTC, SIP trunking, Session Border Controller (SBC), telephony, and collaboration solutions.
  • Technical Roadmaps: Develop and maintain technical roadmaps for modernizing legacy PBX and telephony environments and transitioning to appropriate on-premises, hybrid, UCaaS, and cloud collaboration platforms.
  • Enterprise Telephony Engineering: Provide technical direction for enterprise dial plans, E.164 number normalization, digit manipulation, call routing, SIP trunking, carrier interconnections, PSTN services, voice gateways, voicemail, and emergency calling capabilities.
  • Availability and Resiliency: Define technical requirements for high availability, geographic redundancy, survivability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and service continuity.
  • Technology Evaluation: Lead product evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, interoperability testing, and technical risk assessments for new voice, video, and collaboration technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, and vendor partners to align collaboration solutions with enterprise infrastructure, security, and operational requirements.
  • Vendor and Carrier Coordination: Lead technical engagements and escalations involving equipment manufacturers, software providers, telecommunications carriers, SIP service providers, and system integrators.

4. Hands-On Technical Engineering and Escalation

  • Design and Deployment: Perform and oversee the configuration, integration, testing, and deployment of IP telephony systems, SIP proxies, SBCs—including AudioCodes, Ribbon, and Cisco CUBE—and unified communications platforms.
  • VTC Engineering: Architect, integrate, configure, and troubleshoot multi-vendor VTC and audiovisual collaboration environments, including Cisco Room Series and Webex devices, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Crestron, and Zoom Rooms.
  • Cloud Voice Integration: Design and support integrations between on-premises voice infrastructure and cloud collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams Phone, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, and comparable services.
  • Engineering Escalation: Serve as the senior engineering escalation point for complex voice and video incidents involving call routing, signaling, media negotiation, interoperability, packet loss, jitter, latency, one-way audio, call quality, or service availability.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Lead technical investigations, identify underlying causes, develop permanent corrective actions, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into standards, designs, and operating procedures.
  • QoS and Transport Optimization: Collaborate with Transport and Network Engineering to design and validate end-to-end QoS, including traffic classification and marking using DSCP and Layer 2 CoS, queuing, shaping, policing, call admission control, bandwidth planning, and class-of-service mapping across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and carrier transport services.
  • Monitoring and Service Assurance: Support the implementation and use of monitoring, alerting, call-quality analytics, call-detail records, capacity reporting, and trend analysis for enterprise voice and video services.

Required Experience and Education

  • Professional Experience: Ten or more years of progressive engineering experience in VoIP, VTC, enterprise telephony, unified communications, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: At least three years of technical leadership experience, including formal supervisory or people-management responsibilities such as staffing, performance management, employee development, and workload assignment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and practical experience may be considered.

Preferred Technical Proficiencies

  • VoIP and Telephony Protocols: Advanced knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP/RTCP, SRTP, H.323, MGCP, ISDN/PRI, and related voice and video signaling and media protocols.
  • Call-Control Platforms: Proven experience with enterprise platforms such as Cisco Unified Communications Manager, Cisco Unity Connection, Microsoft Teams Phone, or comparable on-premises and cloud-based call-control systems.
  • Dial Plans and Carrier Services: Experience with enterprise dial-plan architecture, E.164 numbering, digit manipulation, SIP trunks, PSTN connectivity, carrier interconnections, voice gateways, and emergency calling.
  • VTC and Collaboration Systems: Extensive experience designing, integrating, and deploying enterprise video collaboration systems, including Cisco, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Crestron, or comparable platforms.
  • Session Border Controllers: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise SBCs such as AudioCodes Mediant, Ribbon SBC, Oracle Communications Session Border Controller/Acme Packet, and Cisco CUBE.
  • Cloud and Hybrid Voice: Experience integrating on-premises telephony with cloud collaboration services, including Microsoft Teams Direct Routing and Operator Connect, Webex Calling, or comparable platforms.
  • Network and QoS Analysis: Strong knowledge of IP networking, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, Network Address Translation, SIP and media traversal, packet-capture analysis, QoS policy design, and bandwidth and capacity planning.
  • Security and Identity: Working knowledge of SIP TLS, mutual TLS, SRTP, certificates and PKI, directory services, identity integration, secure configuration baselines, vulnerability remediation, and change and configuration management.
  • Troubleshooting Tools: Demonstrated ability to use Wireshark, platform traces, SBC logs, call-detail records, monitoring systems, and other diagnostic tools to isolate complex signaling, media, network, and interoperability problems.

Leadership and Communication Skills

  • Ability to balance people leadership, engineering delivery, technical governance, and hands-on technical contribution.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to prioritize competing requirements and manage technical and delivery risks.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations to engineers, customers, program leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to establish expectations, communicate constraints, and resolve technical or organizational issues.
  • Proven problem-solving ability and experience leading teams through complex, high-pressure operational or engineering situations.
  • Commitment to employee development, knowledge sharing, process improvement, and engineering excellence.

Preferred Certifications and Qualifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional Collaboration or Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Collaboration.
  • Current Microsoft certification related to collaboration communications systems, Microsoft Teams Phone, or an equivalent voice and collaboration technology.
  • Current AudioCodes, Ribbon, Cisco, Microsoft, or comparable voice and collaboration certification.
  • Experience developing technical proposals, statements of work, bills of material, level-of-effort estimates, staffing plans, or technical risk assessments.
  • Experience with automation and scripting for telephony administration and provisioning using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or comparable technologies.

  • Develop programs for the implementation of Remedial Action Schemes, PV Solar, Battery Energy Storage Systems, Microgrid, Renewable Curtailment, Volt/Var Control, Load Shedding, Anti-Islanding, and other custom logic.
  • Develop and implement innovative solutions to automate complex processes.
  • Establish and maintain best practices and guidelines for automation and control systems.
  • Provide leadership and direction to engineering teams, enhancing skill development.

  • Expertise in SEL AcSELerator for RTAC, CODESYS, and Python.
  • 2+ years’ relevant experience in working with SEL RTAC 33XX and 35XX SCADA systems utilizing IEC 61131 structured text programming.
  • 2+ years of experience in Relaying, Planning, Substation, Information Technology, or Distribution design, construction, or operations preferred.

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As an Adjunct Faculty for American College of Education, you maintain a strong academic presence and growth in professional development for teaching, scholarly or creative works, and service to the profession and to the college. You report and work directly under the leadership of the department chair who provides guidance regarding 1) academic and teaching responsibilities, 2) service to students, department, college, and community, and 3) professional development.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. Adjuncts are paid per student per course here at ACE, and in general the pay is $50/student at the bachelor and master levels, and $126/student at the doctorate level. There are also opportunities to serve on paid committees, as well as receive payment for writing and developing courses.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by the organization and leadership.

  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.

  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities
In this role, you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

Academic and Teaching Responsibilities

An adjunct faculty relates directly to students, handling instructional responsibilities to support, strengthen, and enhance the learning experience.

  • Interacts directly with students in an appropriate, professional manner.
  • Facilitates a safe and productive learning environment for students.
  • Responds in a timely manner to student requests for information, clarification of content, posts, and personal queries, and contacts inactive students as the need arises.
  • Oversees the quality of the course by reviewing the functionality and content, ensuring high-quality delivery of content.
  • Expands the student experience by “fingerprinting” the course content with unique personal experience, insights, or other professional knowledge.
  • Monitors and provides appropriate student feedback on assignments within college policies.
  • Synthesize and reports student performance data in a timeline manner.

Service to Students, Department, College and Community.

  • Provides appropriate leadership within one’s individual sphere of influence.

Professional Development.

We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This position will join the Advizex team, a Myriad360 company.

About Advizex

Advizex, a Myriad360 company, brings together over 50 years of innovation and client commitment. As part of Myriad360’s growing portfolio, Advizex continues to operate with the same trusted expertise and customer-first philosophy—now strengthened by broader resources and reach.

For over 50 years, Advizex has done more than simply keep pace with technology—it has helped organizations stay ahead of it. With deep, real-world experience across healthcare, education, government, manufacturing, and retail, Advizex delivers IT solutions that solve meaningful business challenges across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

This role will join the Advizex team and play a key part in continuing that legacy.

Learn more about Advizex here!

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing Managed Services Provider. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Level 5 Storage & Backup Enterprise Services Architect to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of storage and backup systems and demonstrate strong leadership and problem-solving skills. This is a senior-level position that requires extensive experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining complex storage and backup environments.

This position is supported by a 24x7x365 team, but occasional evening and weekend work may be required to handle emergencies or perform system maintenance.

Candidates must be based in the United States.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture & Managed Services Leadership
    • Define and own customer-facing hybrid cloud architectures for Azure-based managed services.
    • Design, standardize, and evolve multi-tenant managed service platforms supporting multiple enterprise customers.
    • Ensure architectures align with contractual SLAs, SLOs, and support models.
    • Establish and enforce architecture, security, and operational standards across customer environments.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
    • Maintain hands-on involvement with storage and backup systems in production.
    • Lead troubleshooting and serve as the highest-level escalation point for complex customer issues.
    • Architect resilient platforms with strong monitoring, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Customer Engagement & Advisory
    • Act as a technical lead and trusted advisor for enterprise customers.
    • Participate in customer architecture reviews, technical workshops, and QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).
    • Translate customer business requirements into secure, supportable cloud architectures.
    • Support presales and solution design, including architecture validation, scoping, and risk assessment.
    • Guide customers through cloud adoption, modernization, and hybrid integration strategies.
  • Operations & Reliability
    • Provide architectural leadership for 24×7 managed service operations, including on-call participation.
    • Lead major incident response efforts, including customer communication and post-incident reviews.
    • Drive reliability, performance, and cost optimization improvements across customer platforms.
    • Ensure operational readiness for new customers and onboardings.
  • Mentorship & Influence
    • Mentor senior engineers and architects within the MSP organization.
    • Influence technical strategy, tooling, and service offerings across the managed services portfolio.
    • Evaluate Azure services and technologies to improve customer outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience:
    • 15+ years of experience in storage and backup system administration and engineering in enterprise environments.
    • 5+ years designing and operating Microsoft Azure for enterprise or MSP customers.
    • Deep, hands-on storage and backup system administration experience in enterprise production environments.
    • Proven experience managing Dell storage and backup solutions.
    • Deep expertise in the administration of storage and backup systems.
    • Experience with backup and recovery processes.
  • Certifications:
    • Required: One Dell backup/data-protection certification, such as Dell Avamar, Data Domain, or PowerProtect; and
    • One specialized Dell enterprise storage certification in either:
      • Dell PowerScale(formerly Isilon); or
      • Dell PowerMax(formerly VMAX).
    • Azure Architect Certification (nice to have).
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated leadership abilities, including project management and team mentoring.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and technologies.

Preferred:

  • 15+ years of prior Storage and Backup administration experience in complex corporate or enterprise environments.
  • Extensive experience delivering customer-facing managed services in SLA-driven environments.
  • Strong expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, enterprise networking, identity, and security.
  • Strong expertise in Cisco products.
  • Extensive background in 24×7 cloud and infrastructure operations, including incident response.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration at scale (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS).
  • Additional Azure certifications (Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  • Experience working in MSPs or consulting organizations supporting multiple enterprise customers.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, SRE, or service management frameworks.
  • Experience supporting regulated, high-availability, or compliance-driven environments.
  • Exposure to cloud migration and modernization engagements.

As an Advizex employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits and perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical benefits
  • Dental and vision coverage offered
  • 17 PTO days
  • Flexible Work Arrangements
  • Retirement Savings Plans
  • Paid Long Term Disability
  • Basic Life Insurance offered

Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is $145,000-170,000 base salary, plus opportunities for bonus and/or commission. Compensation in other geographies may vary. 

Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a results-driven recruiter to join SpaceXAI’s Human Data team, where you will spearhead high-volume sourcing efforts to attract top-tier talent and fuel our mission. In this role, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process for priority requisitions, leveraging a world-class, data-driven approach to deliver exceptional candidate experiences and meet aggressive hiring goals. Ideal candidates are go-getters who thrive in fast-paced, startup-like environments, excel at building creative sourcing strategies, and are passionate about scaling SpaceXAI’s workforce with top talent across all disciplines.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner closely with leaders to deeply understand requirements for priority hires and develop high-volume sourcing strategies to match top talent to open roles at speed.
  • Manage a robust, full-cycle hiring process, including sourcing, screening, and closing candidates for both high-volume and niche roles across all available channels.
  • Leverage data to optimize candidate ROI, increase conversion rates, streamline processes, keep stakeholders informed of hiring trends, and monitor recruitment pace to meet ambitious targets.
  • Create frameworks to analyze the talent market and align sourcing strategies with SpaceXAI’s needs for roles.
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience at every stage of the recruitment journey, from initial outreach to offer acceptance.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years of recruiting experience in fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, either in agency or in-house settings.
  • Proven track record of managing high-volume pipelines and specialty positions, delivering measurable results.
  • Full-cycle recruiting experience, including expertise in challenging closes, stakeholder management, and building key internal partnerships.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience using Greenhouse ATS to manage high-volume recruitment workflows.
  • Proven success supporting hiring events and analyzing post-event ROI to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Familiarity with talent attraction techniques and staying current with market trends to inform sourcing strategies.
  • Experience recruiting at a high-growth startup, building scalable talent acquisition solutions.
  • Expertise in hiring candidates across STEM, finance, humanities, creative, and multilingual fields.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Outcome-oriented with strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • A proactive, adaptable mindset with a touch of humor to thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Preference for candidates based in or willing to relocate to the Palo Alto, CA area; remote work is also possible
  • Candidates must be based in one of the following countries where SpaceXAI has a physical office; remote work is also possible

    - United States

    - Dubai

    - Ireland
    - United Kingdom
    - Ireland
    - Japan
    - India
    - Indonesia
    - South Korea
    - Philippines
    - Singapore

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $105,000 - $174,000 depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Remote, Latin America
jobs.excerpt: Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives.
jobs.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

Sobre a oportunidade

Você vai transformar dados de demanda, ocupação e comportamento de compra em modelos que precificam uma malha com milhares de pares origem-destino e rotas multi trecho — um problema de revenue management cientificamente rico, com inventário perecível de assentos, sazonalidade forte, no-show e tetos regulatórios. É um papel centrado na descoberta: formular hipóteses, validá-las com rigor estatístico e mover receita e margem na escala de milhões de viagens por ano.

Seus Desafios

•Investigação e EDA —conduzir análise exploratória e estatística para descobrir padrões, levantar hipóteses e guiar a modelagem.

•Previsão de demanda —modelar demanda e no-show por par origem-destino com gradient boosting e séries temporais, corrigindo o viés de demanda censurada (unconstrained demand).

•Elasticidade e disposição a pagar —estimar elasticidade-preço e willingness-to-pay por segmento e rota, base para a otimização de preço.

•Revenue management em rede —modelar proteção de assentos e alocação de capacidade (fare buckets) em rotas multi-trecho, equilibrando ocupação e receita.

•Experimentação causal —desenhar testes A/B e inferência causal que validam mudanças de preço e medem uplift real, com critérios estatísticos claros de promoção.

•Explicabilidade e confiança —garantir interpretabilidade (ex.: SHAP) para defender cada preço perante o negócio e o regulador.

•Cold start e calibração —desenhar estratégias para rotas com pouco histórico, partindo de priors de literatura e evoluindo para ML, por tenant.

Você é a ponte entre ciência e produto: colabora com ML engineers no caminho até produção, com data engineers na disponibilidade dos dados, e com as áreas comercial e de operações na definição das metas.

Stack & Ferramentas

  • Linguagem & libs:Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), XGBoost, LightGBM
  • Estatística & ML clássico:EDA, modelos estatísticos, regressão, classificação, clustering

  • Causal & temporal:séries temporais/forecasting, inferência causal (ex.: EconML, DoWhy), bayesiano/hierárquico

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een data-gedreven proof of concept zoeken we 2 profielen die meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van een overdraagbare oplossing voor de geautomatiseerde detectie en verklaring van trendwijzigingen in binnenvaarttrafieken.

De beschikbare data bevatten onder meer informatie over vervoersstromen, herkomst en bestemming, corridors, ladingen en lossingen, tonnages, doorvaarten en andere reiskenmerken. De opdracht onderzoekt in welke mate technologie relevante evoluties automatisch kan signaleren, mogelijke verklarende parameters kan identificeren en de sterkte en onzekerheid van verbanden transparant kan weergeven.

Het gaat nadrukkelijk om een ondersteunend analyse-instrument en niet om een autonoom beslissingssysteem. Inhoudelijke validatie door de eindorganisatie blijft noodzakelijk. De opdracht moet bovendien aantonen of deze aanpak technisch, organisatorisch en operationeel haalbaar is binnen de bestaande ICT-context.

  • Een proof of concept ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, documenteren en overdraagbaar opleveren.
  • Trendwijzigingen, afwijkingen en trendbreuken in trafiekdata automatisch detecteren en analyseren.
  • Directe en indirecte verbanden onderzoeken tussen trafiekdata en interne of externe verklarende variabelen.
  • Rapporteren op een transparante manier over bron, methode, sterkte van verbanden, onzekerheid, beperkingen en reproduceerbaarheid.
  • Een werkend en testbaar prototype opleveren binnen de goedgekeurde projectomgeving.
  • Rekening houden met functionaliteit, beveiliging, technische haalbaarheid, toegangsbeheer, dataclassificatie en integratiemogelijkheden.
  • Zorgen voor volledige kennisoverdracht, inclusief broncode, configuratie en technische documentatie, zodat verdere uitbreiding en beheer mogelijk blijven.
  • Complexe analyses helder toelichten aan stakeholders met uiteenlopende technische achtergronden.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met data-analyse en het analyseren van datastromen.
  • Je hebt sterke kennis van tijdreeksanalyse, trenddetectie en change point detectie, bijvoorbeeld met tools zoals Darts, Sktime of PyTorch Forecasting.
  • Je beheerst scriptingtalen zoals Python en/of R; kennis van Shell of Perl is een meerwaarde.
  • Je hebt grondige kennis van SQL, databanken zoals Oracle en het optimaliseren of tunen van databases en queries.
  • Je hebt ervaring met data modelling, bij voorkeur in een Databricks-omgeving.
  • Je beschikt over kennis van LLM en RAG.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Power BI voor dashboards, datavisualisatie en data-optimalisatie, en je kan noden van stakeholders vertalen naar passende Power BI-oplossingen.
  • Je hebt kennis van gevorderde statistische technieken en concepten.
  • Je bent sterk in rapportering en kan bevindingen gestructureerd en begrijpelijk presenteren.
  • Ervaring met projecten binnen de overheid is een plus.

Based on discussions with the Trial Staff and COR, plans, implements and oversees large and complex auditing investigations as required in support of litigation.

  • Extensive working knowledge of appropriate accounting and financial analysis ADP systems and applications.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

As the Enterprise AI Program Office matures, this role may flex across operating model design, governance and controls, platform/tool coordination, functional AI leader support, workforce enablement, portfolio visibility, decision support, communications, and special initiatives

  • Support Enterprise AI Program Office work across assigned workstreams, business areas, functional stakeholder groups, governance backlog items, enablement activities, and special initiatives.
  • Help shape, assess, and route AI opportunities by clarifying business value, user population, data sensitivity, workflow impact, autonomy level, vendor or tool status, regulated process exposure, technical dependencies, adoption needs, and support model.
  • Maintain the enterprise AI portfolio and backlog view across business use cases, functional roadmaps, platform requests, AI tools, pilots, production candidates, adoption initiatives, and workforce enablement activities.
  • Coordinate risk-triggered governance and control activities with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, QA/Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, SWE, IT, data owners, business owners, and other accountable subject matter experts when those reviews are needed.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Lead Engineer, Data to join our team. This individual will be responsible for modernizing, integrating, and optimizing Dutch Bro’s foundational data ecosystem. This individual will play a crucial role in building world-class data platforms that power analytics, machine learning, and AI-driven workflows and will be responsible for designing and implementing highly scalable and resilient data infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Snowflake database administration, data modeling, database migration, and is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining data cloud platforms that enable us to collect, store, process, and analyze vast amounts of data efficiently and effectively. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in an evolving environment, is eager to learn, and is ready to contribute innovative ideas. If you’re humble, hungry, and excited to grow your skills, we’d love to have you join our team!

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related study, or 4 years of experience, required

  • 7+ years of data and/or software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on backend distributed systems or data infrastructure at scale.

  • Deep Engineering Roots: You are an expert coder (Python and SQL) who grew up building software. 4+ years deep Python and SQL experience.

  • Hands-on expert-level knowledge and experience with Snowflake (Snowpipe, SnowSQL, replication, data-sharing), Airflow, and Power BI for production-grade data solutions.

  • Mastery of AWS services (IAM, VPC, Glue, S3, SFTP, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS) , Gitlab CI/CD, DataDog Monitoring/alerting.

  • Real-time ETL/ELT and Big Data pipeline experience, especially with Kafka, Workato, ADF, Matillion, and DBT.

  • Expertise in implementing automated CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and fostering a unified engineering culture across disciplines.

  • Nice to have - Passion and drive for a POC / designing RAG architecture, vector databases, or integrating LLMs into data pipelines.

  • Familiarity with data privacy regulations knowledge (GDPR, CCPA) and Attribute-based data security.

  • Snowflake administration knowledge, preferred.

  • Knowledge and experience with Data Governance - Data Quality, Metadata management, Data Security, Data Archive is preferred.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with a focus on business insights.

  • Excellent communication for conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

  • Adaptable and proactive in learning new technologies in a dynamic data environment.

  • Strong time management skills to handle multiple projects and ensure high-quality deliverables.

Location Requirement:
This position is eligible for remote work within any state Dutch Bros currently resides in (AL, AZ, CA, CO, FL, ID, KS, KY, MO, NM, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, UT, WA, WY)

Key Result Areas (KRAs):

Assess, design, build, and maintain the data pipelines that enables Dutch Bros teams to collect, store, process, and analyze vast amounts of data efficiently and effectively:

  • Seamless Snowflake Implementation: Successfully develop and deploy production- grade data solutions on Snowflake, databricks or similar tools Optimized Data Pipelines: Design and enhance ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations for efficiency, supporting advanced analytics and real-time data processing with technologies such as Kafka, fivetran, databricks , and Matillion or leveraging pyspark

  • High-Quality Data Models: Implement dimensional and data products to improve data accuracy and accessibility, enabling comprehensive ad-hoc analysis, reporting, and visualization

  • Advanced Analytics Support: Develop and maintain data engineering frameworks that support machine learning workflows and complex data analyses, ensuring that data is readily available for actionable insights

  • Effective Communication and Collaboration: Articulate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to drive project success and meet business objectives

Skills:

  • Data engineering

  • Functional Expertise

  • Data modeling

  • Data management and data governance

  • Leading by Influence

  • Detail-Oriented

  • Multitasking

Physical Requirements:

  • In-Office Environment: Must be able to work in a busy, crowded, and loud office with frequent distractions and interruptions.

  • Office Conditions: Adaptability to typical office conditions, which may include exposure to air conditioning, heating, artificial lighting, and varying noise levels

  • Mobility: Ability to sit, stand, reach, twist, stretch, and work at a desk for long stretches. Must be able to occasionally move or lift office items up to 25 pounds

  • Hearing Requirements: Hearing must be sufficient or correctable to ensure clear understanding of spoken information, including participating in virtual meetings and phone calls. Use of hearing aids or other assistive devices is acceptable if needed.

  • Reading and Writing Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English is essential for processing documents, drafting reports, and following up on necessary actions. Proficiency in written communication is required to handle job-related tasks effectively.

  • Vision Requirements: Vision must be adequate or correctable to perform essential job duties, such as reading documents on a computer screen and using other visual tools. Use of corrective lenses or other measures to meet visual requirements is expected if needed.

  • Technology Proficiency: Must be proficient in operating a computer and other office productivity tools such as printers, scanners, and collaboration software.

  • Effective Communication: Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members, clients, and other stakeholders via email, video conferencing, and other in office communication tools.

Compensation:

DOE

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex problems, building production software, and working directly with clients?

We're looking for Forward Deployed AI Engineers to join our growing team.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with customer engagement, serving as both a builder and trusted advisor as you help organizations transform business challenges into AI-powered solutions.

Working side-by-side with client stakeholders, engineers, data scientists, and business leaders, you'll take solutions from concept to production and see firsthand how your work creates impact. One week may involve collaborating onsite with a client to understand a business challenge; the next may involve building applications, deploying AI workflows, or launching production systems that support critical decisions. This role includes approximately 30% travel, providing opportunities to work directly with clients, build relationships, and see firsthand how your solutions drive business impact.

What You'll Do

  • Partner directly with clients to understand complex business challenges and identify opportunities where AI can create measurable impact.
  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications using AI, machine learning, cloud technologies, APIs, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop solutions utilizing large language models (LLMs), retrieval systems, agents, workflow automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Lead projects through the full lifecycle, from discovery and prototyping to deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Collaborate with client teams, product leaders, engineers, and data scientists to deliver scalable and impactful solutions.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into actionable plans and deliver results in fast-moving environments.
  • Measure solution performance, reliability, and user adoption, continuously improving the systems you build.
  • Contribute to the evolution of NIQ's AI capabilities by sharing learnings, creating reusable frameworks, and influencing future product direction.
  • Travel to client locations as needed to support discovery, implementation, and strategic engagements.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Build AI solutions that are deployed in production and used by real customers.
  • Work directly with some of the world's largest retailers and consumer brands.
  • Tackle complex business challenges where no predefined solution exists.
  • Join a founding team helping define the future of AI at NIQ.
  • Operate with the autonomy and ownership of a startup environment while benefiting from the scale and resources of a global leader.
  • Influence not only the solutions you build, but also the products, processes, and capabilities that shape the future of the business.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and customer engagement, seeing firsthand how your solutions affect real business decisions.

We're hiring across multiple levels and welcome candidates with a range of experience. Responsibilities and scope will align to your background, with opportunities for more experienced candidates to lead complex deployments, influence technical strategy, mentor team members, and help shape the future of the Forward Deployed Engineering organization.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or a related field. Candidates with additional experience may be considered for senior or lead-level opportunities.
  • Proven ability to build and deliver production systems from requirements gathering through implementation and adoption.
  • Strong software engineering skills with experience building production systems in Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages, along with experience working with APIs, SQL, cloud platforms, data pipelines, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience building or deploying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based applications in production environments.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical, scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong systems thinking and an understanding of reliability, security, performance, and maintainability considerations.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and clients.
  • Experience collaborating directly with customers, gathering requirements, and building trusted relationships.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions, influence decisions, and drive projects forward in fast-paced environments.
  • Comfortable working in highly collaborative, entrepreneurial environments with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% to client locations for discovery, workshops, implementation support, and strategic collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, Customer Engineer, or similar client-facing engineering role.
  • Experience building and deploying applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working in fast-growing technology companies, startup environments, or highly entrepreneurial teams.
  • Experience supporting enterprise clients and leading complex technical engagements.
  • Familiarity with retail, consumer packaged goods (CPG), analytics, or data-driven decision-making environments.

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $110,000 - $240,000. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support and more.

  • Flexible spending accounts and a Health Savings Account (including company contributions).

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD/month Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing / eCommerce English Proficiency: Advanced Professional English Required (C1 or higher)

About the Company

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.

The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Founder Support

  • Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions.

  • Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients.

  • Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making.

  • Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion.

Vendor Relationship Management

  • Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits.

  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records.

  • Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership.

Operational Systems & Technology

  • Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms.

  • Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding.

  • Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.

  • Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.

Process Design & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.

  • Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.

  • Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.

  • Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.

  • Maintain organized financial and administrative records.

  • Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.

Business Development & Revenue Support

  • Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.

  • Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.

  • Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.

  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.

  • Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

  • Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.

  • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.

  • Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.

  • Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency.

  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

  • Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment.

  • Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social commerce operations.

  • Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch.

  • Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled.

  • Executive calendars, communications, and administrative responsibilities run smoothly with minimal supervision.

  • Vendor relationships are professionally managed, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.

  • Operational systems and workflows become increasingly efficient through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • The business development team receives meaningful support through prospect research, outreach, pipeline management, and sales preparation.

  • You consistently identify opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and contribute to the company's growth without waiting for instructions.

Who We're Looking For

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

Most importantly, you understand that supporting leadership means creating capacity for the business to grow, whether through operational efficiency, better systems, stronger vendor relationships, or direct contributions to revenue-generating activities.

Work Arrangement & Compensation

  • Location: Remote – Latin America

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

  • Monthly Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD, depending on experience and qualifications

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

This is a remote/telecommute position.

GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist – CRM, Email & Social Media

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours (PST Preferred)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist to manage day-to-day marketing execution, CRM workflows, email campaigns, social media, and operational coordination.

This is a hands-on execution role — not a strategy-only position. You’ll work directly inside GoHighLevel (GHL) to manage automations, pipelines, nurture sequences, and lead follow-ups while also supporting content, social media, and broader business operations.

If you’re highly organized, comfortable with marketing technology, and know how to keep CRM + marketing + operational workflows running smoothly, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

GoHighLevel CRM & Marketing Automation

  • Build, manage, and optimize workflows inside GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Create and maintain:
    • CRM automations
    • Nurture sequences
    • Email campaigns
    • Follow-up workflows
    • Lead pipelines
  • Maintain clean and accurate contact and pipeline records
  • Ensure leads and customers receive timely communication
  • Monitor workflows for errors, missed follow-ups, or automation gaps
  • Support funnels and outreach campaigns from setup through execution

Email Marketing & Lead Nurturing

  • Build and execute email campaigns within GoHighLevel
  • Manage automated lead nurture and follow-up sequences
  • Organize audience and contact data
  • Monitor campaign execution and engagement
  • Ensure leads move through the appropriate CRM stages
  • Improve follow-up consistency across marketing and sales workflows

Social Media & Content Execution

  • Create, schedule, and publish content across:
    • LinkedIn
    • Facebook
    • Instagram
    • Online communities
  • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement
  • Maintain consistent brand messaging across channels
  • Track engagement and maintain performance reports
  • Support promotional and advertising campaign execution

Content Creation & Digital Assets

  • Create and edit:
    • Short-form videos
    • Social media clips
    • Graphics
    • Marketing assets
  • Use tools such as:
    • Canva
    • Veed
    • Opus Clips
  • Format and organize:
    • Guides
    • Scripts
    • Workbooks
    • Program materials
  • Maintain consistent branding and organization across digital assets

Operational & Executive Support

  • Coordinate calendars, scheduling, and day-to-day operational workflows
  • Maintain task trackers, project workflows, and documentation
  • Support leadership with execution and follow-through
  • Keep files, records, and communication systems organized
  • Identify workflow gaps and recommend practical improvements

Program & Membership Operations

  • Maintain digital program and membership materials
  • Support participant onboarding and communication
  • Track member progress and follow-ups
  • Troubleshoot minor platform and workflow issues
  • Ensure participant and membership processes run smoothly

Lead Generation & Research

  • Research Ideal Client Profiles (ICPs)
  • Build prospect lists and outreach databases
  • Support lead generation and outreach campaigns
  • Assist with basic website updates and account setup
  • Conduct operational and marketing research
  • Compile structured reports and insights for leadership

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Marketing Operations
    • Marketing Coordination
    • Executive Assistance
    • Operations Support
    • Virtual Assistance
  • Hands-on GoHighLevel (GHL) experience
  • Experience with:
    • CRM management
    • Marketing automation
    • Email campaigns
    • Lead nurturing and follow-ups
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Calendar
    • Google Drive
  • Experience with social platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram
  • Familiarity with content tools such as Canva, Veed, or Opus Clips
  • Strong written English communication
  • Excellent organization and multitasking skills
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Availability during U.S. PST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting founders, coaches, or entrepreneurial businesses
  • Community or membership management experience
  • Experience building funnels and lead nurturing systems
  • Familiarity with:
    • Slack
    • ClickUp
    • Notion
    • Airtable
    • HubSpot
  • Experience improving CRM or marketing automation workflows

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re highly execution-oriented and dependable
  • You have real hands-on experience working inside GoHighLevel
  • You naturally keep CRMs, workflows, and documentation organized
  • You proactively identify missed follow-ups and process gaps
  • You’re comfortable balancing marketing, operations, content, and communication
  • You communicate clearly and professionally
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities can change quickly

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing GoHighLevel pipelines and automations to make sure leads and follow-ups are moving correctly. From there, you could build an email campaign, update CRM records, schedule social content, and respond to community messages.

Throughout the day, you may edit short-form content, support participant onboarding, conduct prospect research, organize operational tasks, and coordinate with leadership on priorities.

In short: you keep GoHighLevel, marketing campaigns, content, CRM workflows, and operational execution organized and moving every day.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean and accurate GoHighLevel CRM data
  • Reliable execution of workflows and automations
  • Zero missed lead or customer follow-ups
  • Consistent and timely email and social media execution
  • Strong engagement and responsive communication
  • Organized program and digital assets
  • Accurate pipeline tracking
  • Reliable completion of operational priorities

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership of GoHighLevel and marketing automation
  • Exposure to CRM, email marketing, social media, and operations
  • Direct collaboration with leadership
  • Opportunity to build and improve automated marketing workflows
  • Fast-paced, fully remote environment
  • Growth opportunities into Marketing Operations, CRM Management, Automation, or Operations Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Marketing & Operations Interview
  4. Practical Task – GoHighLevel Workflow or Content Exercise
  5. Final Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

We're looking for a contract Social Media Manager to own and grow indie.io's brand presence while also supporting the discoverability, momentum, and long-term growth of the games in our catalog. This is a 3-month contract position with the potential to convert to a full-time hire based on performance and business needs. This role blends traditional social media management with light community management responsibilities. This is a fully remote contract for U.S.-based candidates.

You'll be responsible for shaping how our publisher brand shows up online, amplifying our games in ways that feel native to each platform, and building genuine relationships with players, developers, and creators. This is a role for someone who is comfortable working autonomously, juggling multiple game titles at different stages, and making smart judgment calls without needing heavy oversight.

Social & Brand Strategy

  • Plan and maintain a rolling social content calendar across a large, active catalog.
  • Track performance metrics (reach, engagement, growth, click-throughs) across platforms.
  • Use data to iterate on content formats, posting cadence, and platform focus.
Game & Catalog Promotion
  • Promote multiple games concurrently across different lifecycle stages (announcement, launch, updates, discounts, long-tail support).
  • Work closely with Marketing Managers and our in-house Creative teams to align messaging, beats, content production, and timing.
  • Identify scalable ways to spotlight games across multiple beats, including sales, physical and digital events, RDA and launch messaging, and more.
  • Maintain relationships with indie.io developers, cross-promoting their content and providing guidance on content strategies.
Community & Engagement
  • Engage with players, developers, and fans in comments, replies, DMs, and community spaces.
  • Act as a light-touch community manager: surfacing feedback, flagging sentiment shifts, and escalating issues when needed.
  • Help set expectations and best practices for developer-facing social and community interactions.
Content & Trends
  • Ideate, write, and publish platform-native content (including short-form video concepts, memes, threads, and reactive posts).
  • Stay current on gaming, internet, and platform trends.
  • Collaborate with internal designers, editors, and video teams to scale content production efficiently.
Who You Are
  • 3–4 years of experience in social media and/or community management, ideally in games, entertainment, or digital-native brands.
  • Strong understanding of, and passion for, gaming culture, indie games, and player communities.
  • Proven experience managing multiple brands, products, or content streams at once.
  • Excellent written communication skills and sharp content judgment.
  • Comfort working independently and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketing, creative, and product teams.
  • Experience utilizing social media management & intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with Discord moderation and community tools is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating with content creators or influencer teams is not required, but a plus.
Compensation
  • $55,000 – $70,000 USD annualized rate (paid over the 3-month contract period, with adjustment to full-time salary upon conversion)

The starting salary range for this position is $145,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success measures for the Student Acquisition value stream, aligned with institutional enrollment, revenue, and student experience goals.
  • Own the end-to-end prospect-to-started-student journey; use research, journey mapping, funnel data, and stakeholder feedback to identify friction, unmet needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Establish and monitor product objectives and key performance indicators, including speed-to-lead, stage conversion, application completion, yield, cycle time, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Prioritize initiatives across the product ecosystem based on expected business value, student impact, risk, cost, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; make transparent trade-off recommendations.
  • Translate business problems and desired outcomes into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and decision context for Product Owners, delivery teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Partner with Product Owners and technology teams to sequence delivery, manage cross-platform dependencies, validate releases, and confirm that delivered capabilities achieve intended outcomes.
  • Guide product discovery, experimentation, usability testing, and continuous optimization; apply quantitative and qualitative evidence to product decisions.
  • Ensure consistent funnel definitions, lead qualification rules, attribution, consent, and data flow across channels and platforms in partnership with data and business owners.
  • Own the integrated product roadmap across CRM, marketing automation, digital experience, inquiry and application, communications, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Evaluate platform capabilities, vendors, and investment options; develop business cases and recommendations that address value, total cost, scalability, reliability, integration, and technical debt.
  • Align Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, IT, and executive stakeholders around priorities, decisions, risks, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with operational leaders on process design, service levels, adoption, training, change management, and readiness for peak enrollment cycles.
  • Ensure product decisions support FERPA, privacy, consent, accessibility, security, data governance, responsible AI, and other applicable institutional requirements.
  • Communicate roadmap progress, product performance, financial impact, risks, dependencies, and decisions to executive and operational audiences.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, technology, marketing, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in product management, digital product strategy, business technology, CRM, enrollment technology, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a product strategy and roadmap across multiple platforms, business functions, and stakeholder groups.
  • Experience using product discovery, customer research, journey mapping, experimentation, and data analysis to prioritize work and improve measurable outcomes.
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM and lead management, marketing automation, digital experience, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Proven ability to define meaningful product metrics, interpret funnel and operational data, build business cases, and evaluate value, cost, risk, and trade-offs.
  • Experience partnering with Product Owners and Agile delivery teams; ability to translate strategy and business problems into outcome-based requirements without prescribing technical solutions.
  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive decisions across competing priorities.
  • Experience with vendor evaluation, contract or service performance, implementation partners, and third-party platform dependencies.
  • Knowledge of privacy, accessibility, security, data governance, and responsible AI considerations for digital products.
  • Experience in higher education, student recruitment, enrollment, admissions, or a regulated consumer journey is strongly preferred.
  • Product management certification is preferred but not required.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

•HSA and FSA options

•Paid volunteer time
