•And more…

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive) and database systems (SQL and NoSQL)

About Total Health: Total Health is a medical education company dedicated to creating high-quality educational programs and experiences for oncology healthcare professionals. We develop and execute live, virtual, and hybrid conferences that bring together leading experts, healthcare providers, industry partners, and the patient perspective.

Our team combines thoughtful program development with exceptional execution to deliver education that is relevant, engaging, inclusive, and impactful for the oncology community.

Summary: The Program Coordinator plays a key role in the planning, promotion, and execution of multiple medical education programs throughout the year. Coordinators take ownership of their assigned programs from initial planning and attendee recruitment through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation.

This position requires someone who can confidently manage competing priorities, communicate professionally with a wide range of stakeholders, anticipate needs, and take ownership of details and deadlines. Successful candidates will be comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with a remote, cross-functional team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both behind-the-scenes planning and being on-site to bring an event to life. Frequent travel is an essential part of the position, including weekend travel and event execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the planning and execution of multiple live, virtual, and hybrid oncology education programs from initial planning through completion.
  • Develop and maintain program timelines, task lists, budgets, and key deliverables to ensure programs remain on schedule and within budget.
  • Take an active role in attendee recruitment for assigned programs, developing and executing targeted outreach strategies to drive registration and achieve attendance goals.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for program faculty, vendors, venues, partners, and other stakeholders throughout the planning process.
  • Coordinate faculty logistics, including invitations, scheduling, travel, accommodations, meeting materials, and on-site needs.
  • Manage event logistics including venue coordination, food and beverage, audiovisual requirements, room setups, signage, shipping, registration, and other operational details.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, including Sales, Marketing, Accreditation, and Finance, to ensure program deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
  • Track program expenses, invoices, and budget activity while identifying potential discrepancies and opportunities for cost efficiencies.
  • Schedule and facilitate planning calls, internal check-ins, and post-program debriefs, ensuring action items are documented and completed.
  • Provide hands-on, on-site event management, including registration, faculty and sponsor support, vendor coordination, room management, and troubleshooting.
  • Anticipate potential challenges and proactively identify solutions before they impact the program, faculty, partners, or attendees.
  • Maintain organized and accurate program records, documentation, and internal tracking systems.
  • Support adherence to applicable medical education, accreditation, and industry compliance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, program execution, and the overall attendee experience.
  • Support additional programs, initiatives, and special projects as needed.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Professional Skills and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in meeting planning, conference management, event operations, medical education, hospitality, or a related field; healthcare or medical education experience is preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple programs, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate professionally with physicians, partners, vendors, clients, and colleagues.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate unexpected changes calmly and effectively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with event management, project management, registration, or CRM platforms is a plus.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a remote, cross-functional team.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently drive assigned programs toward established attendance, budget, timeline, and execution goals.
  • A growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, collaboration, and shared team success.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including frequent weekend travel and occasional early-morning or evening event responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Successful Program Coordinators at Total Health are highly organized, accountable, and proactive. They take ownership of their programs, communicate early and often, stay several steps ahead of deadlines, and understand that a successful meeting is measured by more than flawless logistics.
  • They actively work toward program goals, including attendee recruitment and registration, while ensuring faculty, partners, vendors, and attendees receive a high-quality experience.
  • Our Program Coordinators are equally comfortable developing a program timeline from their home office, communicating with a nationally recognized physician, conducting targeted outreach to prospective attendees, reviewing a hotel banquet order, managing an on-site registration desk, and quickly solving an unexpected challenge during a live event.

Why Join Total Health?

At Total Health, our work is centered on creating meaningful educational experiences that can ultimately contribute to better oncology care. Our programs and company culture are guided by a commitment to:

  • Evidence-based, unbiased medical education
  • Meaningful representation of diverse voices in science and medicine
  • Detail-driven, thoughtful program execution
  • Health equity and addressing disparities in cancer care
  • Geographic, cultural, and professional diversity
  • Gender equity in faculty and leadership opportunities
  • Incorporating the often-unheard patient perspective

Join Us in Making a Difference

If you are energized by fast-moving work, enjoy taking ownership of complex projects, and want to help create exceptional educational experiences for the oncology community, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead Testronic’s information and cyber security programme at a global level. The CISO will define and deliver the security strategy, oversee enterprise security risk and governance, lead the Information Security function, and provide senior leadership and Board-level advice on cyber security, resilience and compliance.

Responsibilities:

Information Security Strategy

  • Develop and deliver Testronic’s global information security strategy, aligned with business objectives, technology plans and risk appetite.
  • Translate security objectives into measurable programmes, capabilities and annual priorities.
  • Monitor the security landscape and adapt the strategy to emerging threats, technology and regulatory requirements.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Own the global information security governance framework, policies and risk management processes.
  • Ensure material security risks have clear ownership, treatment plans and appropriate escalation.
  • Oversee the Information Security Management System and promote security accountability across the organisation.

Board & Senior Leadership

  • Provide clear, regular reporting to the Board and senior leadership on cyber risk, security posture, incidents, compliance and resilience.
  • Advise executives on significant security risks and support informed business decisions.
  • Communicate complex security topics in clear business and financial terms.

Security & Incident Management

  • Act as the senior escalation point for significant information security incidents.
  • Lead or support executive-level response to major cyber incidents, working with IT, Legal, Privacy, Communications and business teams.
  • Ensure incident response exercises, lessons learned and remediation activities are effectively managed.

Security Programme & Assurance

  • Oversee security programmes covering corporate technology, cloud, applications, products and third parties.
  • Provide oversight of security architecture, vulnerabilities, penetration testing, control testing and independent assurance.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of internal and outsourced security services and ensure key security improvements are delivered.

Compliance & External Stakeholders

  • Oversee information security requirements arising from legislation, regulations, customer contracts and recognised standards.
  • Support ISO 27001 and other relevant certification and assurance programmes.
  • Represent Testronic in significant security matters involving clients, auditors, regulators, insurers and other external stakeholders.

Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Lead, develop and build a capable global Information Security function.
  • Work closely with IT, Legal, HR, Facilities, Commercial, QA and other departments to embed security into business and technology decisions.
  • Manage the security budget, strategic suppliers and major security investments.
  • Ensure security risks are considered in acquisitions, outsourcing and major organisational or technology changes.

Requirements

  • Significant senior-level experience in information and cyber security.
  • Experience developing and implementing an enterprise security strategy.
  • Experience advising Boards, executives or senior governance committees.
  • Strong experience in enterprise security risk management and governance.
  • Experience leading security programmes across complex technology environments.
  • Experience managing significant cyber security incidents or crisis situations.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary security teams.
  • Strong understanding of security governance, architecture, operations, assurance and operational resilience.
  • Knowledge of cloud, infrastructure, identity, application and product security.
  • Experience with security frameworks, ISO 27001 and third-party risk.
  • Strong stakeholder, programme, budget and supplier management skills.
  • Knowledge of relevant UK legal, regulatory and contractual requirements.

GOOD TO HAVE: CISSP, CISM, CCISO, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CRISC or equivalent qualifications.

Job Description:

Senior Software Engineer (AI-First, Agentic AI)

Remote Canada

Compensation & Role Details

Expected Salary Range: $130,000 - $170,000 CAD, depending on experience and qualifications

Role Type: New Role

AI Disclosure: AI is used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this role

Overview

We’re a software company at the start of building a brand-new, highly visible SaaS application. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the technical foundation: you’ll help set technical direction, establish engineering standards, and ship foundational capabilities that will shape the product for years. We’re looking for a motivated senior engineer who thinks and builds with an AI-first mindset—someone excited about agentic AI workflows, automation, and using modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. This project will be using AI-Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) to drive the creation, testing and deployment of this application. This is a tremendous opportunity to be fully supported in an AI first approach.

In this role, you’ll design and implement core backend systems using .NET/C# and proven architectural patterns such as Event Sourcing, CQRS, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Vertical Slice (vertical event-sourced) architectures. You’ll work in a cloud-native environment leveraging AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and Docker, contributing to a platform built for scale, reliability, and rapid iteration. You’ll also be a technical leader—taking ownership, mentoring others, and helping define best practices for a high-performing team.

Responsibilities

  • Own major components of a new SaaS platform from design through production

  • Build event-sourced, CQRS-based services in C#/.NET using DDD principles

  • Design clean domain models, message contracts, and integration patterns using RabbitMQ

  • Deliver cloud-ready solutions using Docker and AWS (deployment, observability, reliability)

  • Apply an AI-first approach to engineering: agentic AI tools, automated workflows, code generation/review, test generation, and productivity accelerators

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define architecture, standards, and delivery practices

  • Write high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code and raise the bar through reviews and mentorship

Must Have

  • AI-first mentality with practical experience using AI tools to accelerate development

  • Senior-level experience building production systems with C#/.NET

  • Hands-on experience with Event Sourcing and CQRS in real-world systems

  • Strong working knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

  • Experience with Vertical Slice architecture (or similar modular service boundaries)

  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL

  • Experience with asynchronous messaging and integration patterns, ideally RabbitMQ

  • Experience containerizing services with Docker

  • Experience building/operating cloud-hosted applications, ideally on AWS

  • Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (autonomous workflows, tool-using agents, orchestration, evaluation/guardrails) and excitement to apply them in day-to-day engineering

  • Strong ownership mindset: you ship, you improve, you operate, you lead

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MartenDB

  • Experience with Wolverine

  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS systems (auth, billing, isolation, scaling, observability)

  • Familiarity with modern DevOps/IaC practices (e.g., Terraform/CDK), CI/CD, and distributed tracing

Business Unit:

Computrition - Canada

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

37.5

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

GENERAL SUMMARY

The Senior Symitar System Analyst reports to the Host Services Manager and supports the analysis, design, integration, testing, implementation, administration, and support of the Symitar core banking system and related Host Services applications. Core Banking, Host Services Applications & Integrations

We are headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and Europe. Modern’s mission is to partner with the world’s leading organizations to reimagine and implement a modern approach to leadership and talent. Our unique ability to integrate who runs the organization (people and talent) with how it operates (structure, operating model, and roles)—while aligning both to the future leadership needed to drive change—delivers outsized value for our clients.

Our Leadership Advisory Services team, consisting of executive assessment, coaching, and leadership development consulting, is critical to our integrated value proposition. Execution: You will deliver world-class executive assessment and coaching solutions to leaders in iconic organizations. Your impact will build trust, create traction, and expand Modern’s influence through exceptional execution.

Growth: You will provide expertise to shape impactful solutions for new and existing clients, in partnership with Modern’s diverse team of industry, functional, and practice experts.

Job Title: Revenue Cycle Specialist - Orthopedic Care

Icon Health is a leading provider of value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care, collaborating with payers and providers to enhance outcomes and experience for individuals. By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care.

Who You Are

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Revenue Cycle Manager with deep expertise with multi state telehealth and in-person claim submission, copays, payment posting, insurance guidelines, and revenue cycle workflows that ensure we are reimbursed accurately and on time. More importantly the right candidate has deep expertise in medicare and medicare advantage regulations surrounding telehealth practices and compliance

End to End RCM Responsibilities include:

  • Stay up to date on regulatory and compliance rules for Medicare and Medicare Advantage payers
  • Track, analyze, and appeal payer claim denials through structured denial management workflows to recover lost revenue and identify systemic adjudication trends.
  • Monitor payer contract performance and fee schedules to audit for underpayments and ensure accurate reimbursement according to negotiated terms.
  • Calculate and collect up-front patient financial responsibility utilizing real-time eligibility tools.
  • Reconcile underpayments against specific payer contract fee schedules, auditing high-reimbursement cases to ensure contractual rates for supplies, procedures, and instrumentation are paid in full.
  • Ensure that all Reimbursements for medical services or supplies are provided to a qualified beneficiary, medically reasonable and necessary, performed by a qualified practitioner (within the scope of their practice) and coded accurately (procedures and diagnosis) in accordance with the documented medical record.
  • Determine the root cause of billing errors and act to prevent any recurrence, retrain on coding practices as needed and review policies and procedures for clarity of expectations and requirements.
  • Provide timely overpayment refunds to the payor in compliance with associated federal or state funded healthcare program payor requirements. Continuously enhance skills and knowledge in compliance coding and billing training to minimize potential risk of receiving improper payments.
  • Participate in coding reviews and monitoring of coding practices. Regularly participate in internal audits to verify that billing updates have been properly integrated and adhered to across all claims and address discrepancies with corrective actions as needed.
  • Stay up-to-date on coding, reimbursement, and regulatory changes to ensure accurate claims, compliance, and efficient revenue management.
  • Ensure that collections and accounts receivable (AR) management processes adhere to federal and state regulations, safeguard patient information, and maintain financial integrity
  • Maintain and enforce a billing and receivables framework that maintains compliance, ensures accurate reimbursement, protects patient privacy, and optimizes cash flow

What You’ll Bring

We are always looking for new team members who will add to our company’s DNA and have a strong passion for impact. None of the following are strict requirements, but they describe qualities and skills that will help a candidate be successful in this role:

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
  • Ability to use multiple digital tools for billing, record keeping and patient care directive

jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer – Encounter Processing & Data Platform

Job Summary
The Senior Data Engineer will serve as the primary technical owner responsible for the ongoing maintenance, enhancement, operational support, and reliability of Nebraska's enterprise data processing framework supporting Medicaid Encounter Processing and enterprise data ingestion.

This mission-critical platform processes provider, member, reference, and encounter data used by downstream Medicaid systems and reporting. The application framework is developed using Scala, Apache Spark, Hive, and Drools and operates on the Cloudera Data Platform (CDP).

Following the State's migration from an Apache open-source Hadoop environment to Cloudera Data Platform, this position will assume primary responsibility for maintaining the production code base, implementing business and regulatory changes, supporting production operations, resolving application defects, and performing routine operational administration of the data processing environment.

This position serves as the single primary technical owner of the application framework and is expected to maintain sufficient expertise across the complete technology stack—including Scala, Apache Spark, Hive, Drools, and the Cloudera Data Platform—to ensure the ongoing reliability, maintainability, and operational continuity of this mission-critical system.

Primary Ownership

  • Own the Scala/Spark application framework supporting Medicaid Encounter Processing.
  • Own the Drools business rule implementation and ongoing rule maintenance.
  • Own enterprise data ingestion processes for master data and source system files.
  • Own Spark and Hive batch processing workflows.
  • Own production issue investigation and application defect resolution.
  • Own production releases, version management, and deployment coordination.
  • Own application performance tuning and optimization.
  • Own technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge transfer.
  • Provide basic operational administration and monitoring of the Cloudera Data Platform while coordinating with infrastructure and cloud operations teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of experience developing enterprise-scale distributed data processing applications.
  • Strong hands-on development experience with Scala.
  • Experience developing applications using Apache Spark 2.x and/or Spark 3.x.
  • Experience developing and maintaining applications running on Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) 7.x or equivalent enterprise Hadoop distributions.
  • Experience with Apache Hive 3.x for data processing and Hive table management.
  • Experience implementing business rules using the Drools Rules Engine.
  • Strong SQL development and query optimization skills.
  • Experience supporting Linux-based production environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting distributed Spark applications in production.
  • Experience using Git and modern version control practices.

Preferred Qualifications

·Medicaid or healthcare experience.

  • Experience with Medicaid Encounter Processing.
  • Experience with Cloudera Manager, HDFS, and YARN.
  • Experience integrating with IBM DataStage.
  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure supporting Cloudera.
  • Experience with Agile, Jira, and Confluence.

Who We’re Looking For

At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.

We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them. And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)

What is ScalePad

At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.

Our mission:help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner).Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion.

Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.

But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs.

Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.

With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.

About the Role

Lead the sales journey for our clients by building strong partnerships, understanding their needs, and showcasing the value of ScalePad’s innovative solutions. You’ll receive the training and support needed to master our products and confidently demonstrate their capabilities. With your sharp market insight and go-to-market instincts, you’ll excel in our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. A self-starter with a creative edge, you balance priorities with empathy and serve as ScalePad’s voice to the world- driving growth and elevating MSP solutions on a global stage.

What you’ll own

Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:

  • Lead the complete sales process, from initial engagement, sales demo and strategic consultation with prospects and core partners to understanding their unique needs, articulating the value proposition of ScalePad, and ultimately closing deals. Your ability to navigate this cycle efficiently and effectively will be key to our continued success.
  • Serve as the face of ScalePad to our prospects and core partners, acting as a trusted advisor and educating them on the full suite of sales resources available. Demonstrate how our solutions can address their needs now and in the future to support their business growth and client success.
  • Stay ahead of the curve in the fast-paced world of MSPs by maintaining a deep knowledge base of market behaviour and trends. Anticipate partner needs and tailor your approach accordingly.
  • Utilize exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively. Listen with empathy and understanding, becoming a trusted advisor and advocate for our partners.
  • Play a crucial role in contributing operationally to the growth and success of our company. Provide insights and feedback to shape strategies, processes, and product offerings, ensuring we remain at the forefront of innovation in the MSP space.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM software, leveraging insights to optimize outreach strategies and meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Provide feedback to internal teams on product enhancements, process improvements, and market insights to ensure we remain innovative and competitive.
  • Drive revenue growth within our existing partner base by identifying and executing strategic cross-sell opportunities among partners already leveraging at least one ScalePad solution.
  • Engage partners through proactive outreach, tailored consultations, and value-driven conversations to uncover additional needs, position complementary offerings, and expand account footprint.

What we’re looking for

We care about what you can do more than where you’ve done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:

  • 2+ years of successful SaaS or B2B experience in a business development or sales rolewhere you learned and applied in depth industry product knowledge to consult on the needs of the client.
  • We would love to know if you have experience in the MSP space or selling to IT decision-makers. If you do not yet have experience with IT or MSP, tell us why you are interested in ScalePad and the MSP space now.
  • You can discuss a past demonstrated ability to succeed with a plan which may have included strategies to position and advise on new products or new features within existing products.
  • You can share a process or methodology you have learned to support your clients experience in evaluating and selecting a service or product based solution.
  • Metrics-driven mindset with expertise in pipeline management, conversion tracking, and leveraging CRM systems like Hubspot or SFDC to manage and communicate your potential results and forecast.
  • Proven success in fast-paced, dynamic, and entrepreneurial environments, balancing multiple priorities with precision and empathy.
  • Self-starter with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, adept at building rapport with partners, colleagues, and managers.
  • You actively use AI tools in your sales workflow— for account research, personalized outreach, deal strategy, and pipeline management — and can point to specific ways it improves your performance. (Non-negotiable)

Perks

ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.

  • Everyone's an owner. Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) matching.
  • Support for growing families. Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.

  • Set yourself up with great tools. Work with brand new, top-of-the-line hardware and equipment so you can do your best work, whether you're at home or in one of our hubs.

  • Well-being and time to recharge. Take care of yourself and your family with comprehensive health and dental coverage.

Before You Apply

This is a full-time role for those who are eligible to work in Canada or the United States. We thank all applicants for taking the time to apply, but only candidates who make it to the next stage will be contacted.

Orbital Engineering, Inc. is seeking a Senior Manager of Electrical Engineering to support our Heavy Industrial Services division. This is a remote position that will interface with teams and resources across the United States and international locations.

  • Responsible for the execution of all activities of the electrical departments within the division. Schedule, organize, direct and review all electrical resources and activities.

  • Identify resource and staffing needs, lead and/or participate in recruiting and interviews, onboard new team members, establish individual goals and expectations, and conduct performance reviews

  • Develop and implement policies, standards and procedures for the engineering and technical work performed in the department. Periodically assess availability of required discipline industry codes and standards and maintain and upgrade technical standards/specifications when required.

  • Contribute technically or managerially on high visibility projects
  • Review discipline project financials with the department managers. Assist in the development of mitigation plans and corrective actions when necessary.
  • Promote Orbital’s safety culture through active safety engagements and compliance audits of Orbital’s safety requirements, including but not limited to, employee training and site visit checklists
  • Support the organization through interaction with the other discipline managers, project managers and business unit leads
  • Ensure all department operational and project activities are completed in accordance with the Orbital Quality Management System (QMS) through implementation and enforcement of stated policies and practices.

Other Duties

Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 15 years of experience, preferably in a consulting environment, and well-rounded expertise in heavy industrial engineering projects such as oil & gas, chemicals, steel, and power generation

  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must excel in working in a team environment

This is a remote position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.

Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.

With Lifestyle Experts focusing on nutrition, exercise, and sleep, we offer a truly holistic approach that helps people take ownership of their health. We’re proud to work with forward-thinking organizations and are committed to raising the bar on accessible care.

OpenUp is ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025. We are expanding our international teams and we are searching for like-minded talent. We are already helping over 2000+ (international) companies and 550K+ employees, e.g. Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonalds.

To fuel our growth, we are looking for entrepreneurial, purpose-driven experts who share our vision of making mental well-being direct, approachable, and impactful.

At OpenUp, we focus on prevention. We don’t diagnose; we provide guidance for life’s everyday challenges - whether it’s work-related stress, self-confidence, relationship dynamics, or finding direction in uncertain times.

We offer planned and on-demand video consults seven days a week, ensuring people can access support when they need it most - no long waits, no barriers. In each session (usually 25 minutes), you’ll help clients set clear, actionable goals and guide them toward meaningful first steps.

Our mission is to help people build skills and autonomy, so they feel confident to continue their journey independently. Many clients find they gain what they need in just a few focused conversations - thanks to your structured, goal-oriented support.

You’ll engage with a wide variety of people, from diverse cultural backgrounds and industries, and you’ll have opportunities to grow through weekly intervision sessions and ongoing development. We work together to make mental well-being accessible, practical, and empowering for everyone.

jobs.description:
Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role:

Are you passionate about improving patients' lives? Join our Clinical Care team at Arine! As a valued team member, you will utilize Arine's software platform to optimize patient outcomes, enhance patient care, and efficiently deliver our clinical services.

Under the supervision of a Clinical Support Lead, you will make outbound calls to patients, providers, and pharmacies to intervene in patient cases identified by Arine's platform. These calls may involve obtaining and accurately documenting health and contact information, scheduling appointments, resolving medication-related issues, and performing patient engagement activities. In addition, you will answer inbound customer support requests and handle other assigned duties.

This is a patient-facing, phone-based role in a call center–style environment where you will spend the majority of your day engaging with patients, providers, and pharmacies by phone. We are seeking a patient-centric, compassionate problem solver who is self-motivated, receptive to coaching and feedback, and thrives on helping others navigate healthcare challenges.

Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail in documentation, comfort working with technology, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment. You will be expected to manage your workload independently while demonstrating accountability and reliability in your work. Arine fosters a metrics and feedback-driven environment where ongoing coaching is used to support individual growth, performance improvement, and development.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Engaging patients over the phone to deliver Arine's services on behalf of their health plan, including clearly explaining clinical programs (i.e. medication adherence, medication therapy management, medication reviews, etc.) and benefits
  • Managing a consistent volume of outbound and inbound calls while maintaining productivity and service quality
  • Meeting individual and team performance metrics related to outreach, engagement, documentation quality, and service outcomes
  • Escalating potential medication-related and health-related issues to a pharmacist
  • Obtaining provider contact information to facilitate the delivery of clinical interventions
  • Obtaining patient information required for clinical interventions
  • Answering phone calls from patients, providers, and pharmacies and responding to inquiries professionally
  • Accurately documenting all interactions, interventions, and outcomes in Arine's software platform
  • Participating in process improvement meetings and team meetings to optimize workflows
  • Following up with hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and patients to resolve clinical issues and concerns
  • Preparing and sending patient educational materials and other necessary items as needed
  • Scheduling patients for telephonic or videoconference appointments with clinical pharmacists
  • Assisting with obtaining referrals and authorizations
  • Following established workflows while remaining flexible as processes evolve
  • Taking ownership of assigned work and seeing it through to completion

Who You Are and What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Health Sciences or a related field preferred. Healthcare certification preferred (e.g., Certified Pharmacy Technician, Certified Medical Assistant, Behavioral Health Technician). Candidates with equivalent medical, healthcare, call center, customer service, or patient-facing experience are encouraged to apply
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of basic medical terminology and medication names (brand and generic)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, with the ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and remain patient-focused during high-volume phone interactions
  • Demonstrated reliability, accountability, and follow-through
  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to documentation accuracy
  • Comfort working in a metrics-driven environment where outcomes and quality are tracked
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Google Workspace and Mac (Apple) environment, with comfort using collaboration and contact-center tools such as Slack and Five9, navigating multiple browser-based systems simultaneously, utilizing keyboard shortcuts, maintaining a high typing speed (WPM), and performing basic technical troubleshooting to stay productive in a phone-based environment
  • Comfort learning and using new technologies, including clinical software platforms
  • A team player mindset with the ability to work independently
  • Openness to coaching, feedback, and continuous learning
  • Ability to work 40 hours/week (within company operating hours of Monday-Friday, 6AM-6PM Pacific Time, with up to two rotating Saturday shifts/month)

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with other electronic medical records
  • Experience in an ambulatory care setting, including taking medication histories
  • Experience working in a high-volume, metrics-based healthcare call center or similar patient-facing environment

Remote Work Requirements:

  • An established private work area that ensures information privacy
  • Reliable internet capable of low latency with the ability to carry video and voice calls without breaking up
  • This role is remote, but you will be required to come to on-site meetings multiple times per year. This may be during the interview process, onboarding, and for team meetings

Perks:

Joining Arine offers you a dynamic role and the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and shape its future. You'll have unparalleled learning and growth prospects, collaborating closely with experienced Clinicians, Engineers, Software Architects, and Digital Health Entrepreneurs.

This position is temp-to-hire for an expected duration of 6 months, with the possibility of extension or conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business needs. Throughout the temporary period, you will receive full benefits starting from day one.

The posted range represents the expected hourly rate for this position and does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, benefits, and perks. Ultimately, the final pay decision will consider factors such as your experience, job level, location, and other relevant job-related criteria. The hourly pay rate for this position is: $20-22/hour.

Seasonality & Schedule:

Our Clinical Care team operates within a seasonal business cycle, and we want candidates to have a clear picture of what to expect. During peak season (May through early December), our team plays a vital role in supporting business operations. Workload and scheduling demands increase during this time, and time off may be limited. Optional overtime may also be offered to meet business needs. Each year, the Clinical Care department observes a holiday shutdown of approximately 2–3 weeks between late December and early January. Please note that while Arine remains operational, the Clinical Care department is closed during this period. Following the shutdown, the team transitions back to full capacity on a modified schedule through February, during which some shifts or hours may differ from standard operations. We value transparency and encourage candidates who thrive in dynamic, seasonal environments to apply.

Job Requirements:

  • Ability to pass a background check
  • Must live in and be eligible to work in the United States

Information Security Roles and Responsibilities:

All staff at Arine are expected to be part of its Information Security Management Program and undergo periodic training on Information Security Awareness and HIPAA guidelines. Each user is responsible to maintain a secure working environment and follow all policies and procedures. Upon hire, each person is assigned and must complete trainings before access is granted for their specific role within Arine.

Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

About the Role

As Torc advances toward commercial deployment of its Level 4 autonomous trucking platform, we're looking for an experienced litigator and product counselor to own our litigation function and serve as a key product counseling partner. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel – Litigation & Commercial, you'll manage Torc's active litigation, build the processes that keep the company litigation-ready, and serve as a trusted legal partner to our Engineering, Product, and Safety & Regulatory teams (including Government Affairs).

This is an ownership role on a lean, high-performing legal team at a pivotal moment in the company's history. Beyond managing the docket, you'll build and maintain Torc's litigation readiness infrastructure, including the playbooks and protocols needed for driver-out operations. Over time, you'll also grow into Torc's regulatory legal work, partnering with our Safety & Regulatory team and outside regulatory counsel on NHTSA and FMCSA matters. Deep AV regulatory expertise isn't required on day one, but curiosity and a willingness to learn are.

What You'll Do:

Litigation and incident response

  • Review external communications, technical publications, and customer-facing materials for legal risk

Supporting the Legal team

What You'll Need to Succeed:

  • Sound judgment and the ability to give clear, practical advice in a fast-moving, technically complex environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts to executives, engineers, and other non-lawyers
  • A collaborative style and the ability to earn trust with Engineering, Safety, Product, and Operations teams
  • An owner's mindset: you're comfortable building and running a function, not just working within one
  • Genuine curiosity about complex technology and interest in developing regulatory expertise over time
  • Availability to respond on short notice, including occasional evenings and weekends, when incidents or urgent matters arise
  • Integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and privileged information

Preferred Qualifications

  • In-house experience at a technology company, automotive OEM, Tier 1 automotive supplier, or advanced mobility company
  • Experience advising on product liability for hardware-software systems in regulated, safety-critical industries (e.g., automotive, aviation, medical devices, industrial automation)
  • Familiarity with NHTSA, FMCSA, or other federal transportation safety frameworks
  • Experience working alongside a Government Affairs function on regulatory matters

Work Location and Travel

This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S. You'll work with colleagues across multiple time zones and at our Blacksburg, VA, Fort Worth, TX, and Ann Arbor, MI sites, with occasional travel to those locations (estimated 5-10% of the time). Who We Are
Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Workflow and Project Management team. This role is ideal for an energetic problem-solver and strong communicator who thrives in a fast-paced advertising or marketing agency environment.

As a Project Coordinator, you will support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing projects, working closely with teams across Client Success, Strategy and Media, Creative, and Marketing Technology and Operations. You will help keep projects organized, timelines on track, and stakeholders informed while ensuring teams have the information and resources needed to produce high-quality work.

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities. You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments, and approach challenges with curiosity and a solutions-oriented mindset. You are eager to learn new technologies, strengthen your project management capabilities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes. Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

Responsibilities

Project Coordination

  • Coordinate the planning, scheduling, resourcing, and execution of a variety of integrated marketing initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain project schedules, task assignments, status reports, meeting notes, and other project documentation.

  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to help ensure work is completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with the approved brief.

  • Anticipate potential project issues and roadblocks, communicate concerns promptly, and partner with project leads to support timely resolution.

  • Help manage changes to project scope, schedules, or deliverables and ensure updates are clearly documented and communicated.

Workflow Management

  • Support established project management processes and help ensure they are followed consistently across assigned projects.

  • Maintain project information, documentation, and workflows within the appropriate systems and tools.

  • Identify potential process gaps or inefficiencies and recommend opportunities to improve how work is planned and delivered.

  • Help coordinate resources and priorities across teams, escalating scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns as needed.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Communicate project goals, priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and status updates clearly and consistently to internal stakeholders.

  • Facilitate or support project meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and tracking follow-up actions.

  • Build positive and collaborative working relationships across teams and functions.

  • Escalate risks, delays, and competing priorities to the appropriate project or account lead in a timely manner.

  • A post-secondary degree in business, marketing, communications, project management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Ability to prioritize competing demands, adapt to changing requirements, and remain composed in a deadline-driven environment.

  • A demonstrated commitment to accountability, follow-through, and continuous learning.

  • Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

  • CAPM or another relevant project management certification is an asset but not required.

Our Culture

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

We aim to offer competitive and equitable compensation based on factors such as location, relevant experience, skills, and market benchmarks. The anticipated salary range for this role is $43,000 to $55,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

Overview

JOB TITLE: Trial Consultant

AGENCY SUPPORTED: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) – MEGA 6 Automated Litigation Support

POSITION TYPE: Full-Time, Contingent Upon Award

LOCATION: Remote

CLEARANCE: Public Trust – Candidates do not need to be cleared at the time of application but must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, 3 weeks’ Paid Time Off

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Trial Consultant to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

This is a very senior consultant position, responsible for the overall preparation and presentation of evidence for trial, arbitrations, mediations, hearings, jury research and client meetings.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with trial teams throughout the pre-trial and trial.
  • Provides expert consulting services to litigation teams regarding the effective application of trial communication methods and multimedia presentations.
  • Works with the trial team, including expert witnesses, to develop and execute plans for presenting a case in the courtroom using a courtroom presentation system.
  • This individual will be responsible for the overall trial presentation including: exhibit presentation, overseeing the courtroom setup, and conducting ‘hot seat’ activities during trial.
  • The individual in this position will be responsible for recommending dynamic graphic and multimedia presentations for use at trial.
  • Must have experience supporting mobile devices, tablets and iPads at trial.
  • Coordinates with the trial team both before trial and during trial to develop scripts for presenting exhibits in a particular order to support testimony.
  • Assists in the identification, development, and presentation of trial themes.
  • Recommends and oversees the preparation of graphic images and exhibits using standard off the shelf software packages.
  • Oversees graphics production capabilities such as in using PowerPoint, Adobe Product Suite (InDesign, Illustrator & Photoshop), other 2D, video editing, and 3D animation.
  • May coordinate the development of demonstrative graphics that enhance persuasion opportunities.
  • May design and implement custom database, imaging and trial presentation systems to support complex cases.
  • Designs courtroom display schematics and oversees the installation of the Courtroom and War Room presentation equipment.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • Minimum experience of 10 trials supporting and consulting with trial teams on the use of technology in the courtroom.
  • Must be thoroughly familiar with standard courtroom presentation packages such as Trial Director and Sanction.
  • High proficiency in graphic design, infographics and MS PowerPoint, Adobe Creative Suite, MS PowerPoint with experience in WordPress, Webflow, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS and Dreamweaver.
  • Experience in designing and creating mockups for web-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with standard litigation support applications (e.g., Relativity, iConect, CaseMap, etc).
  • Must be able to work effectively as a team member in an extremely pressured environment.
  • Work on-site with attorneys and experts to discuss and develop strategic visuals to associate with case presentation.
  • Must be able to travel for long periods of time.
  • Must have excellent oral communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required from an accredited college in Multimedia, Digital Design, Marketing, Fine Arts, or related concentration or discipline.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A law degree or litigation paralegal training desirable.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This is a fully remote position; work is performed from a home office.
  • Must be located in or near the Washington, DC area and available for short-notice on-site meetings.
  • Work is primarily sedentary, performed while using a computer for extended periods of time.

  • Rolling out an AI Harness across engineering: not a chatbot bolted onto the sidebar, but tooling and workflows that change how we actually ship, review, and debug code day to day.
  • Building disaster recovery that actually recovers: complete regional failover, so if an entire cloud region disappears mid-transaction, our system keeps moving people's money and nobody but us ever notices.

🏋️‍♀️ How we actually work

  • You build it, you run it, you own it. Engineers at Centrapay ship features end-to-end and see them through production. When something breaks or could be better, you have the context and autonomy to fix it - no waiting for permission or handoffs to other teams.
  • Learn by building. We give you business problems, not specs. "Partners need faster onboarding" is your starting point, and how you solve it is up to you. You'll do market research, run spikes, and explore the solution space. No ticket grooming, no story pointing. We also have 10% time and hackathons where you can experiment with new tech you wouldn't normally get to use.
  • Progress over perfection. We deploy to production daily, and you'll push code on your first day. We believe in shipping early, iterating fast, and learning from real usage.
  • Work across the stack. Backend, frontend, infrastructure. Whatever it takes to deliver amazing experiences for our customers.

📚 Our stack

Don't stress if you haven't touched some of these, we'll help you bridge the gaps:

  • AI tools:Claude Code, Cursor, Github Copilot
  • Backend & data:Node.js, DynamoDB, Redis, Vitest
  • Frontend:Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Testing Library, Playwright
  • Infrastructure & operations:AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry
  • Tooling:Claude, Github, Slack, Notion, Figma

Requirements

👀 Who we're looking for

  • At least 3 years shipping real code to users - we're looking for people who've learned from real mistakes and know what it takes to build reliable systems
  • Clear writing: since we're async-first and most of our communication happens in writing
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you’ll be expected to talk to users and figure out what to build

🏌️ Why you might not apply (and why you should anyway)

  • "I don't have AWS experience" - We care more about how you think than what cloud services you have used. If you can build on GCP or Azure, you can learn AWS in a week, and we'll pair with you to help you get up to speed.
  • "I don't live in Auckland" - No problem, we want you work to where you work best.

👋 The interview process

We believe in being open and transparent, so here’s exactly what to expect:

  1. First chat (1 hour video call) - an opportunity to get to know you, talk about the role and Centrapay
  2. Take-home task - 2-4 hours on your schedule
  3. Code review session (1 hour video call) - discuss your task, design decisions, and trade-offs together
  4. Final chat (30 minutes) - an opportunity to connect with our CEO and CTO

🚀 Why Join Us?

Benefits

We look after our people at Centrapay, a key focus is our culture and ensuring we create a positive and healthy work environment. We continuously look at ways to make improvements and regularly ask for employee feedback and input.

jobs.description:
We are an international broker. Our clients fund and withdraw through roughly 60 payment methods across Asia, Africa, LATAM and the Middle East.

Payments Product is a standalone function, and we are building the team around it. This is an early core hire.

We are looking for a Payment Integration Manager who will own payment integrations end to end: from the technical call with a provider through to stable production. You will also be the first line on every payment incident, and the person who decides whether a new integration is ready to go live.

This is a technical operations role rather than a coordination one.

Your responsibilities will be:

Running the full onboarding cycle for new payment providers: first technical call, credentials and sandbox access, configuration, test design, UAT, production launch and post-release stabilisation

Owning first-line response for payment incidents, including failed and stuck transactions, unconfirmed payments and method-level anomalies, and driving them to resolution rather than passing them on

Defining the acceptance standard for new integrations and holding the go or no-go decision before launch

Reading provider API documentation and turning it into implementation-ready specifications for engineering, including edge cases, failure paths and confirmation model behaviour

Running hands-on verification: manual checkout testing on mobile and desktop, callback verification through Postman, and SQL queries against transaction data

Maintaining the catalogue of payment methods and providers: what each supports, which integration types are available, what has been tested and where known failure modes sit

Building the first capability inventory of all live methods and providers

Later, producing a 90-day breakdown of deposit attempts by outcome: completed, declined by the provider, abandoned by the user, abandoned at redirect, and completed but never confirmed back to us

Requirements

What you'll need:

4+ years in payments, PSP integrations or fintech platforms, with hands-on ownership of integrations rather than tracking them, basic knowledge using AI tooling in daily work

Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks and asynchronous payment status, plus an understanding of confirmation models, callback mechanics, redirect flows and common failure modes

The ability to read a provider API specification and identify what is missing from it

Postman or equivalent for API testing, and structured checkout testing across mobile and desktop

Experience diagnosing a live payment incident from logs and API responses, separating provider-side causes from platform-side causes, and explaining the finding to both a provider contact and an engineer

The ability to turn ambiguous provider documentation and undocumented knowledge into specifications and catalogues that engineering can act on

Composure during incidents, and clear communication with the team and stakeholders

English and Russian at working level. Both are in daily use

Will be a significant plus:

Experience with APM and local rails in Asia, Africa or LATAM rather than cards alone

Experience with bank transfer rails, virtual accounts, QR-based methods, mobile money etc.

Background in brokerage, crypto payments, orchestration or another high-volume payments environment; on the provider side, at a PSP, gateway or payment company

Active use of AI tooling in daily work

Ability to work independently and make decisions without constant oversight

Proactive mindset: willingness to propose improvements, fixes, new approaches

What the first year looks like:

In the first months you take over incident first line, build the method and provider catalogue from documentation, existing knowledge and direct querying, and produce the deposit attempt analysis.

By mid-year you have defined the integration acceptance standard and applied it to a live provider onboarding from start to production.

In the second half the catalogue is current, the gate is running, and incidents reach you for decisions rather than for explanations. As the team grows, a Systems Analyst takes over formal verification while the acceptance gate stays with you.

Recruitment process:

HR interview, covering background, motivation and fit

Technical interview on payment integration knowledge, tooling and hands-on experience, including incident diagnosis

Product and problem-solving interview, covering integration decisions and prioritisation

Final interview with senior stakeholders

Benefits

We offer:

Fixed monthly compensation of [depending on experience]

Fully remote work within GMT to GMT+4, with no relocation required

End-to-end ownership of a provider from first call to production, and the go or no-go decision on every integration

Scope that grows with the business: cards, alternative payment methods, a card programme and new entities

Corporate AI tooling as part of the working process

Our clients range from ambitious growth businesses to established organisations, and we are proud of our ability to work across sectors, geographies and different stages of organisational growth. Before applying, we encourage you to research Rosie's People, our services, the calibre of organisations we have supported and our TICK values. Understanding who we are and how we operate will be important to succeeding in this opportunity.

Application Process & Mandatory Questions

Please read the full job description before submitting your application.

As part of your application, please answer all mandatory questions belowwithin your covering letter/notes or as part of your CV. You may include everything within one document if preferred.

We will not progress applications that do not answer all mandatory questions.

    • Serve as the primary ERM partner supporting Protective’s P&C businesses, including the Asset Protection Division and the Excess and Surplus line of business.
    • Provide constructive, independent challenge of business assumptions, actuarial analyses, risk assessments, and management decisions.
    • Provide independent actuarial and ERM advice on business growth, risk-taking activities, acquisitions, strategic initiatives, and emerging risks.
    • Assess insurance risk exposures relative to Protective’s risk appetite, limits, tolerances, and capital framework.
    • Develop and enhance P&C risk metrics, key risk indicators, dashboards, limits, monitoring processes, and escalation procedures.
    • Analyze profitability, underwriting performance, adverse loss development, earnings volatility, catastrophe exposure, concentration risk, and potential capital impacts,
    • Perform and evaluate stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital assessments to identify potential downside exposures.
    • Monitor reinsurance programs, risk-transfer strategies, collateral arrangements, and counterparty credit exposures.
    • Monitor catastrophe exposures, geographic concentrations, and risk-accumulation trends across the P&C platform.
    • Participate in Own Risk and Solvency Assessment activities, regulatory reporting, annual risk assessments, and emerging-risk reviews
    • Translate actuarial and capital analyses into clear recommendations for business leaders, senior management, ERM committees, and Board-level discussions.
    • Evaluate the risk and capital implications of potential P&C acquisitions, new programs, portfolio changes, and market expansion opportunities.
    • Support the integration of acquired businesses and their risk management practices into Protective’s enterprise risk framework.
    • Promote a strong risk culture through education, communication, collaboration, and constructive challenge.

Core Competencies (Skills, knowledge and abilities)

  • Deep knowledge of P&C insurance risks, products, underwriting, pricing, claims, reserving, reinsurance, and capital management.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management principles and their application within an insurance carrier.
  • Ability to evaluate business decisions from actuarial, enterprise risk, and capital management perspectives.
  • Strong actuarial judgment, quantitative analysis, and structured problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate complex financial and risk information, identify material implications, and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen, including the ability to balance growth, profitability, capital, and risk considerations.
  • Ability to provide objective, independent challenge while maintaining strong and productive business partnerships.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex actuarial and risk concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to establish credibility and influence business and senior leaders across organizational boundaries.
  • Sound judgment and effective decision-making in complex, changing, or ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and contribute with limited direction.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, process improvement, and emerging risk awareness.
  • Ability to use artificial intelligence tools responsibly to enhance learning, analysis, and business processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS) designation.
  • At least seven years of experience in Property & Casualty insurance, actuarial risk management, actuarial consulting, or a related P&C actuarial field.
  • Direct P&C actuarial experience and a strong understanding of P&C insurance products and operations.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of underwriting, claims, reinsurance, insurance risk, and capital management.
  • Experience performing or evaluating complex actuarial, financial, capital, or enterprise risk analyses.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical analyses into clear business insights and recommendations.
  • Experience communicating with and influencing leaders and stakeholders across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation.
  • Warranty, asset protection, specialty insurance, or related P&C product experience.
  • Enterprise risk management experience within a P&C insurance carrier.
  • Experience advising business leaders from both actuarial and enterprise risk management perspectives.
  • Experience evaluating capital requirements, capital adequacy, or risk-based capital implications for P&C businesses.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, actuarial due diligence, business integrations, or organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) requirements, insurance regulatory reporting, and risk governance frameworks.
  • Experience developing or evaluating stress tests, scenario analyses, or capital models.
  • Working knowledge of catastrophe modeling platforms and catastrophe-risk management practices.
  • Experience developing risk appetite measures, key risk indicators, dashboards, risk limits, or senior-management risk reporting.
  • Experience providing independent oversight or challenge within a second-line risk function.
