Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are happier customers, enhanced insights, and lower costs.

Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to lower risk and increased efficiency. Our client-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction.

We value our people, their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

The Manager, AI & CX Services leads a professional services delivery team of CX and contact center engineers, delivering complex implementations and migrations across leading CCaaS and UC platforms, plus custom development and Applied AI. The Manager owns the team’s delivery margin, budget, and burn and is accountable for on time, on quality delivery across the full lifecycle.

Leading and developing the team day to day, the Manager reads the funnel to plan capacity, supports pre-sales scoping, and partners across Sales and commercial, pre-sales, and proposal colleagues. Depth in one or more contact center/CCaaS platforms is expected, with breadth across the ecosystem valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a professional services delivery team of CX/contact center engineers to deliver complex implementations and migrations across leading CCaaS/UC platforms and custom development/Applied AI, often spanning multiple platforms and customer locations.
  • Manage resources, schedules, and financials, including the delivery margin, budget, and burn for the team (or single team practice) held, and adhere to stage gate quality and control guidelines throughout the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the team day to day: assign and balance work; build and motivate the team to meet goals, milestones, and responsibilities; and provide feedback, mentorship, and training.
  • Manage issues, risks, change requests, dependencies, and critical path deliverables to ensure successful, on time delivery.
  • Serve as the central point of contact and primary interface for project escalations; establish client and business relationships and manage customer expectations.
  • Plan, document, and manage go-live events and related production changes, including go-live and immediate post go-live incident support, and availability for after hours cutovers, change windows, and urgent escalations as needed.
  • Read the sales funnel and convert it into a forward capacity view for the team; flag under-utilization and hiring needs early.
  • Support pre-sales: review proposal material, SOWs, and executed contracts to determine scope and required resource teams; contribute scoping, feasibility, and level of effort; and protect margin during pre-sales for the team (or single team practice) held.
  • Provide status reporting and dashboards on milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and KPIs to leadership and stakeholders; analyze results and troubleshoot problem areas.
  • Review the customer satisfaction and delivery results (CSAT, NPS, and delivery KPIs) for the team and use data driven insights to identify pain points, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
  • Lead process improvement and help establish delivery practices, templates, tools, and standards, applying lean and agile methods to streamline workflows and drive continuous improvement, and conduct lessons learned reviews at project closure with after action reports.
  • Ensure delivery meets Waterfield Tech standards and remains compliant with RFP, SOW, and contract terms; maintain booking, time entry, and delivery operations within Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations.
  • Collaborate with People & Culture to recruit, onboard, and retain talent and build a collaborative, inclusive team.
  • Continue professional development to stay current on emerging technologies, methods, and platforms; perform other duties as assigned by leadership.

How This Role Is Measured

  • Delivery execution & quality: On time milestone delivery and schedule variance across the team’s engagements; reduction in rework and escalations.
  • Team economics: Delivered margin vs. plan; budget and burn vs. plan; utilization to target for the team held.
  • Customer satisfaction: CSAT/NPS on delivered projects.
  • Capacity & forecast: Forward capacity coverage vs. demand; demand forecast accuracy; early flagging of under-utilization and hiring need.
  • Reporting & standards: Team adherence to established KPIs; timely, accurate reporting and dashboards; process improvement outcomes (cycle time, quality).
  • People: Team retention, engagement, development, and certification/skills growth.

Primary Delivery & Technical Experience

  • Deep, hands-on delivery expertise in one or more contact center/CCaaS practices is required; more than one is preferred: Five9, Genesys, Cisco (Webex Contact Center/UC), Avaya, Zoom, and Google (Contact Center AI/Dialogflow).
  • AI enablement: Conversational AI, virtual agents, agent assist, real-time analytics, and AI-powered self-service.
  • Custom development/Applied AI: Integrations, APIs, and AI-enabled applications that extend the contact center platforms.
  • Multi-vendor/multi-platform delivery: Combining two or more of the above with CRM, WFM, QA, and analytics integrations; legacy to cloud migration delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8+ years delivering technical professional services engagements (contact center/CCaaS implementations and migrations), including planning, resourcing, and execution, with progression into managing professional services delivery teams for contact center/CCaaS platforms.
  • Grounded in hands-on delivery as an implementation consultant, technical/solutions architect, professional services delivery engineer, or telephony/contact center (CCaaS) engineer.
  • Conversational AI design and NLU tuning experience, or experience leading a team with that expertise, required.
  • Hands-on Dialogflow CX development experience, or experience leading a team with that expertise, required.
  • Strong understanding of professional services delivery principles, methodologies, governance, and quality control, working with business stakeholders in a cross-functional matrix environment.
  • Prior experience in a technical support or technical management role preferred.

Technical Proficiency

  • Hands-on familiarity with one or more CCaaS/UC platforms and CX/CCaaS delivery.
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations for booking, time entry, and delivery operations; delivery dashboards.
  • AI-powered delivery and PPM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, AI-enhanced PPM).

Soft Skills

  • Team leadership: motivates and drives resources and stakeholders up, across, and down the organization.
  • Excellent attention to detail; adapts to shifting priorities, competing demands, and timelines.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills; manages multiple complex efforts simultaneously.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and customer service skills across all levels of the organization.
  • A passion for mentoring and developing team members; comfortable with ambiguity and constant change.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s a plus. Emphasis in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

Additional Requirements

  • Manufacturer/platform certifications strongly valued across the CCaaS/UC ecosystem.
  • PMP or an equivalent delivery leadership certification a plus.
  • ITIL a plus.
  • Availability to work flexible hours as needed, including after hours cutovers, change windows, and urgent escalations.

Physical Requirements

  1. Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods (up to 80% of the time).
  2. Lifting: Ability to lift or carry objects up to 10 lbs.
  3. Equipment: Frequent use of computer, telephone, and standard office equipment.
  4. Travel: Ability to travel up to 5% for client meetings, training, or installations.

At Finyard, we’re a global team of engineers, data scientists, marketeers, and financial experts, passionate about technology and innovation. We’re all about bringing revolutionary software services to people all around the world, and have been since 2018.

Our mission is to innovate by launching modern software solutions in the FinTech space, giving users around the world simpler and quicker ways to transact and manage their investments. We are committed to ensuring every product we release is in service of our users, so that as we grow, so do they.

On behalf of our client we are looking for a senior CRM & Lifecycle Marketing specialist to provide services under a service agreement and take ownership of client lifecycle communication across key stages of the customer journey.

The role is focused on increasing client activation, engagement, retention and reactivation through data-driven, cross-channel communication. This is not a purely technical CRM implementation role and not a general copywriting role. We are looking for someone who can understand client behaviour, identify drop-off points and engagement opportunities, design communication journeys, and create messaging that moves clients to the next stage of the lifecycle.

What you will be responsible for

  • Design and develop lifecycle communication programmes across the full client journey: registration,activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention, reactivation and high-value client treatment.
  • Analyse customer behaviour and identify where clients drop off, lose interest, need education, require reassurance, or may benefit from a more relevant product or communication path.
  • Build communication journeys based on audience segments, behavioural triggers, client activity, product usage and business priorities.
  • Define what message, channel, timing and call-to-action should be used for different client segments and lifecycle stages.
  • Own cross-channel CRM communication across email, push, in-app messages, website or platform touchpoints, chat, WhatsApp / messengers, and sales or support touchpoints where relevant.
  • Create client-facing copy and content for lifecycle campaigns, onboarding flows, retention journeys, reactivation campaigns, educational sequences.
  • Develop message logic, talk tracks, macros or communication guidelines for sales and customer support teams where CRM communication requires human follow-up.
  • Work with product, BI, engineering, sales, support, compliance and regional teams to make sure lifecycle communication is relevant, technically feasible, measurable and compliant.
  • Define CRM data and segmentation needs, including behavioural signals, triggers and client attributes required to run effective journeys.
  • Run continuous testing and optimisation of lifecycle campaigns, including subject lines, timing, content, offers, channel mix, journey structure and audience logic.
  • Monitor and report performance of CRM flows and campaigns, using data to identify what should be improved, scaled or stopped.
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice across client communications, including communication adapted for different regions and client segments.
  • Ensure that client-facing communication meets relevant compliance and legal requirements.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, customer engagement or a similar area.

At least 2 years of experience in the fintech environment.

Proven experience designing lifecycle programmes end to end, not only executing standalone campaigns created by someone else.

Strong understanding of customer lifecycle mechanics: onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention and reactivation.

Ability to identify behavioural barriers, lifecycle gaps and engagement opportunities, then translate them into practical CRM journeys.

Strong business and customer thinking: ability to understand what kind of message, hook, content or channel is likely to work for a specific client segment.

Hands-on experience with segmentation, behavioural triggers, journey logic, A/B testing and CRM performance analysis.

Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, Optimove, CleverTap, OneSignal, ZohoCRM, Solitics or similar.

Understanding of cross-channel CRM mechanics across email, push, in-app messages, chat, messengers and sales / support communication.

Excellent written English and strong copywriting skills; ability to write clear, engaging and compliant client-facing communication independently.

Comfortable working with behavioural, product and CRM data: defining segments, interpreting results and understanding what should be tested or improved.

Ability to work independently, structure work clearly and take ownership of outcomes under a service agreement model.

Nice to have

Experience adapting CRM communication for international markets such as MENA, SEA, Africa or LATAM.

Experience building CRM programmes from an early or underdeveloped stage.

Experience creating message libraries, tone-of-voice guidelines or reusable lifecycle communication frameworks.

Experience working with educational client journeys or event-driven communication.

Hiring process

  1. Introductory call with the Talent Acquisition team.
  2. Written exercise. You will be given one of our existing onboarding emails to rewrite, a reactivation brief, and a live market event with a short window to draft the pre-event and post-event messages. This is the core of our assessment.
  3. Technical and strategy interview: journey design, segmentation, measurement.
  4. Final interview with the Chief Revenue Officer.

jobs.title: Director, GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Articulate is seeking a Director of GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics to lead and evolve how we translate company strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, measure business performance, govern the data foundations that support decision-making, and align compensation programs to GTM priorities across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Channel.
jobs.description:
Articulate is seeking a Director of GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics to lead and evolve how we translate company strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, measure business performance, govern the data foundations that support decision-making, and align compensation programs to GTM priorities across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Channel.

This role leads an integrated function spanning GTM strategy and planning, forecasting and performance management, analytics and insights, GTM data strategy and governance, and compensation strategy and analytics.

The Director will own the end-to-end GTM planning system, translating company growth objectives into targets, capacity and resource plans, forecasts, performance frameworks, and operating rhythms. The role will ensure GTM leaders have clear, decision-ready insights into business performance, risks, opportunities, and tradeoffs.

The Director will also provide leadership for GTM data strategy and governance, ensuring that the business logic, metric definitions, data standards, and cross-system requirements underlying GTM decision-making are scalable, consistent, and trusted. In partnership with centralized Data, Engineering, IT, and other teams, this role will establish GTM priorities and requirements while those technical organizations retain responsibility for technical architecture and development.

As the leader of this function, the Director will define priorities and operating models, develop managers and senior individual contributors, and partner closely with GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and executive stakeholders to operationalize company strategy and improve GTM performance.

What you'll do:

    GTM Strategy, Planning & Operating System

  • Lead the end-to-end GTM planning system, including annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, resource allocation, and performance management.
  • Translate company growth objectives and strategic priorities into aligned GTM targets, resource plans, and execution strategies across functions, segments, regions, and products.
  • Establish and continuously improve GTM operating rhythms, including planning cycles, forecast reviews, executive business reviews, and performance-management processes.
  • Develop scalable planning frameworks, governance models, and operating standards that enable GTM teams to adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Evaluate strategic tradeoffs across GTM investments and develop recommendations regarding capacity, coverage, demand generation, retention, enablement, and other GTM investments.
  • Partner with Finance and GTM leadership on scenario planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation.

    • Business Performance, Analytics & Insights

  • Define performance measurement frameworks that provide consistent visibility into GTM health across the customer lifecycle.
  • Lead the development of analytics and insights that enable GTM leaders to understand performance, identify risks and opportunities, and make informed business decisions.
  • Ensure forecasting, pipeline, funnel, retention, productivity, and other critical GTM performance measures are clearly defined and consistently understood.
  • Translate complex business performance into clear, decision-ready insights and recommendations.
  • Identify emerging performance trends and develop recommendations to improve near- and medium-term GTM effectiveness.
  • Establish priorities for GTM analytics based on business impact and ensure analytical resources are focused on the highest-value questions.

    • GTM Data Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the GTM data strategy and governance function, establishing priorities for the integrity, scalability, and evolution of the GTM data foundation.
  • Ensure consistent GTM business logic, metric definitions, dimensions, and data standards across systems, reporting, and business processes.
  • Establish governance for GTM data definitions, lineage, quality, and usage in partnership with Data, Engineering, IT, Finance, and GTM stakeholders.
  • Ensure GTM business requirements are clearly defined and aligned before technical development begins.
  • Oversee prioritization of GTM data initiatives and make recommendations regarding sequencing, dependencies, business impact, and tradeoffs.
  • Ensure data structures and governed data assets support critical GTM use cases including forecasting, pipeline management, compensation, retention, planning, and performance measurement.
  • Partner with centralized Data and technical organizations to ensure GTM requirements inform technical roadmaps while maintaining clear accountability between business ownership and technical execution.
  • Improve adoption and understanding of governed data assets, metrics, and BI capabilities across GTM.

    • Compensation Strategy & Analytics

  • Lead GTM compensation strategy and planning in partnership with GTM and Finance leadership.
  • Ensure compensation programs align with company objectives, GTM priorities, targets, quotas, and desired business outcomes.
  • Lead compensation modeling and analytics to evaluate program effectiveness, cost, performance, and behavioral impact.
  • Establish governance and decision frameworks for compensation design and changes.
  • Partner with GTM leadership on quota and incentive strategy and provide recommendations regarding tradeoffs and program design.
  • Ensure compensation planning is integrated with broader capacity, target, resource, and financial planning.
    • Strategic Decision Support & Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Serve as a strategic partner to GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and other functional leaders.
  • Structure complex and ambiguous GTM problems, bringing together business context, data, financial implications, and operational considerations.
  • Develop recommendations regarding GTM priorities, investments, organizational tradeoffs, and performance improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
  • Collaborate with senior leaders to turn company strategy into actionable GTM plans and ensure alignment across functions.
  • Communicate plans, performance, risks, recommendations, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

    • Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning strategy, planning, analytics, data strategy, and compensation.
  • Translate functional priorities into clear objectives, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Coach managers and individual contributors toward outcomes, impact, and increasingly strategic thinking.
  • Establish clear accountability and decision rights across the function.
  • Build cross-functional relationships that enable the team to operate effectively across organizational boundaries.
  • Continuously evolve the team's capabilities, processes, and operating model as business needs change.
  • Create clarity around priorities and ensure the organization remains focused on its highest-impact work.

What you should have:

  • 12+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, planning, analytics, data strategy, or related functions, preferably within B2B SaaS.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and/or senior individual contributors.
  • Proven experience leading GTM planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of GTM analytics, SaaS metrics, customer lifecycle performance, and executive decision support.
  • Experience with GTM data strategy, metric governance, data definitions, and the relationship between business requirements and modern data ecosystems.
  • Experience with compensation strategy, quota planning, incentive design, compensation analytics, or closely related planning disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems and translate complex information into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong systems thinking and understanding of dependencies across CRM, data warehouse, BI, planning, and GTM execution environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Data, IT, and other functions.
  • Strong leadership, communication, prioritization, and judgment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

About us

Articulate Global, LLC, is the leading SaaS provider of creator platforms for online workplace training. Founded by Adam Schwartz in 2002, Articulate provides creator tools and services that make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online workplace training that’s engaging and effective. Increasingly, organizations must reskill employees for ever-changing remote and hybrid work environments, create learning cultures that attract and retain employees in a tight labor market, and use training to build more equitable, empowering, and engaging workplaces. jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is building a modern contact strategy operation, and Genesys Cloud is one of the most important platforms behind how prospective clients, current clients, and our teams connect. We are looking for a Senior Genesys Engineer to serve as the hands-on technical owner of the platform and help us continue building a reliable, scalable, high-performing contact center environment.

This is first and foremost a senior engineering role. The majority of your time will be spent designing, building, configuring, troubleshooting, integrating, testing, and optimizing Genesys Cloud across inbound routing, outbound dialing, telephony, recording, digital channels, automation, AI, and enterprise integrations.

We are looking for someone who knows Genesys deeply and is comfortable owning genes end to end. You will provide technical direction, mentorship, work prioritization, and quality review while remaining the primary senior engineer. The VP of Contact Strategy will set business priorities, target outcomes, and the Genesys technical roadmap; your job is to translate that direction into strong technical solutions and successful delivery in close partnership with IT, Salesforce, Data Engineering, Legal, Operations, and external technology partners.

What You Will Own

Own the Technical Health of Genesys Cloud

● Serve as the senior hands-on engineer and primary technical escalation. point for Genesys Cloud across the organization.

● Design, configure, maintain, and optimize Architect flows, IVR logic, queues, skills, routing, priorities, overflow strategies, callbacks, outbound campaigns, digital channels, recording, user configuration, and related platform capabilities.

● Identify platform risks, recurring defects, configuration issues, and technical debt before they materially affect employees, prospective clients, or current clients.

Engineer Routing, Outbound, and Agent Workflows

● Build and optimize inbound routing strategies that improve accessibility, reduce unnecessary transfers, and connect interactions to the right team quickly and reliably.

● Design and tune outbound campaigns across preview, progressive, and other approved dialing modes, including contact lists, retries, callbacks, callable-time controls, campaign rules, dispositions, and recycle behavior.

● Partner with operations to translate goals such as speed to lead, contact rate, answer rate, callback completion, transfer success, conversion, and agent productivity into effective Genesys solutions.

Own Telephony and Complex Troubleshooting

● Troubleshoot complex voice and call-delivery issues across Genesys, SIP, BYOC, carriers, SBCs, WebRTC, endpoints, networks, call recording, and integrated systems.

● Partner directly with telecommunications carriers, Genesys Support, implementation partners, and IT to drive technical issues through resolution.

Build Integrations, APIs, and Automation

● Own the Genesys side of integrations with Salesforce, Filevine, data platforms, telecommunications carriers, messaging providers, and other enterprise systems.

● Partner with Salesforce, IT, and Data Engineering teams to define clear system ownership, error handling, monitoring, and support models for cross-platform solutions.

Lead Technical Incident, Change, and Release Execution

● Act as the senior technical lead during major Genesys incidents and recurring platform problems, helping organize diagnosis, mitigation, vendor escalation, and permanent resolution.

● Drive root-cause analysis for significant or recurring issues and implement durable fixes rather than relying on repeated workarounds.

● Follow and improve practical standards for development, peer review, testing, deployment, rollback, validation, documentation, and production changes.

Turn the Roadmap Into Working Solutions

● Translate the Genesys technical roadmap and business outcomes established by the VP of Contact Strategy into technical designs, estimates, dependencies, implementation plans, and measurable deliverables.

● Provide strong technical recommendations when multiple solution paths exist, including clear tradeoffs around complexity, reliability, maintainability, cost, and business impact.

● Prototype, test, and validate new Genesys capabilities before broader rollout, and help ensure releases are stable, documented, and measurable after launch.

Advance AI, Automation, and Platform Capability

● Identify and implement high-value opportunities involving live transcription, Agent Assist, AI routing, speech and text analytics, automated summaries, automated wrap-up, workflow automation, and other Genesys capabilities.

● Partner with Operations, Quality Assurance, Learning & Development, and Analytics to use interaction data and AI to improve coaching, quality, decision-making, and client experience.

● Evaluate new Genesys capabilities based on business value and technical fit rather than adopting technology simply because it is available.

Provide Technical Leadership to the Genesys Administrator

● Provide day-to-day technical direction, mentorship, work prioritization, and review for the Genesys Administrator while remaining deeply hands-on in engineering work.

● Delegate appropriate administration and support work, review higher-risk changes, and help the Administrator expand technical depth and independent problem-solving ability.

● Build knowledge redundancy and clear documentation so the platform does not depend on a single individual for critical support or configuration knowledge.

● Create clear escalation boundaries so routine work is handled independently while complex engineering issues are brought forward quickly.

Protect the Business Through Strong Technical Controls

● Translate approved Legal and Compliance requirements into reliable platform controls related to calling hours, consent, call recording, data retention, do-not-call processes, permissions, and client communications.

● Maintain disciplined governance around administrative access, configuration changes, integrations, credentials, recording policies, and other high-risk platform components.

● Partner with IT and Security to ensure Genesys aligns with enterprise architecture, identity, network, device, security, and data-handling standards

What You Bring

Required:

● 7+ years of progressive experience in contact center technology, CCaaS, telecommunications, platform engineering, or a related field, including significant hands-on responsibility in production contact center environments

● 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud CX administration, architecture, or engineering experience with deep expertise in Architect flows, IVR logic, routing, queues, skills, priorities, overflow strategies, and multi-queue environments.

jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer - Agentic
jobs.excerpt: About SANSFounded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization.
jobs.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Senior SOC Engineer - Agentic to join our Security team. This role is a dual-focus security engineering role. On one side, this engineer owns the design and buildout of our agentic SOC — building the detection engineering, automation, and AI agent infrastructure that allows a lean security team to operate at the scope of a much larger one.

On the other, they serve as a hands-on security engineer across the full breadth of the program: vulnerability management, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, architecture reviews, and compliance support.

Initially the role will split roughly evenly between these two tracks. As the Agentic SOC matures and AI agents absorb more of the operational workload, the balance will shift — but the security engineering work never goes away. This is a role for someone who wants to do real security engineering today while building the systems that redefine what security engineering looks like tomorrow.

As a Senior SOC Engineer - Agentic, you will:

  • Agentic SOC Buildout
    • Design the architecture of the agentic SOC. Define how data flows through the detection and response pipeline, how agents are structured and orchestrated, where human-in-the-loop checkpoints belong, and how the overall system evolves as we expand agent autonomy.
    • Build and own detection engineering. Write, tune, and maintain detections across our internal SIEM environment. Treat detection content as code — version-controlled, peer-reviewed, tested, measured. Establish the lifecycle of design → deploy → measure → tune → improve.
    • Translate SOC operations into automation. Identify the alert triage, investigation, and response work that is ripe for agent augmentation, and define what good looks like for each workflow before it gets handed to an agent.
    • Build automations and integrations across our stack. Connect our MSSP, EDR, SIEM, cloud infrastructure, and identity platforms through integrations, scripts, and playbooks — both deterministic automation where that is the right tool, and agent-driven workflows where it is not.
    • Partner with AI Engineering to build and govern the agent stack. Co-design the MCP servers and tool integrations that let agents work with security systems. Contribute to prompt design, evaluation harnesses, and feedback loops — and own the audit trails and checkpoints that keep agent actions safe and accountable.
    • Operate and improve. Monitor agent performance, investigate failures, tune behavior, and feed real-world outcomes back into the system. The job does not end when something ships.
  • Security Engineering
    • Vulnerability management. Own the vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation tracking program. Work with engineering and infrastructure teams to drive risk reduction across the environment.
    • Cloud security. Assess and improve cloud security posture across AWS and Azure — identity and access management (IAM) policy review, configuration hardening, cloud-native detection, and ongoing posture monitoring.
    • Identity and access management. Partner with IT and engineering on identity architecture, access reviews, privilege management, and authentication standards.
    • Application security. Conduct code reviews, threat models, and security assessments for internal applications and integrations. Partner with development teams to shift security left.
    • Security architecture reviews. Evaluate new technologies, integrations, and infrastructure changes for security risk. Provide pragmatic, risk-based guidance.
    • Compliance and audit support. Support security compliance activities, evidence collection, and audit engagements as needed.
  • Respond to incidents. When something real happens, you are part of the response. The agents help; they do not replace you.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • 7+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or security automation, with enough depth to lead engineering efforts independently — and enough intellectual curiosity to be genuinely excited about rebuilding how a SOC works from the ground up.
      • First-hand experience with what a well-run SOC looks like — alert triage workflows, escalation paths, investigation patterns, incident response lifecycle.
      • Detection engineering experience: writing and tuning detections, measuring efficacy, managing false positives. Expert-level command of at least one detection query language (KQL, SPL, Lucene, Sigma, or equivalent).
      • MITRE ATT&CK fluency as a working tool, not a reference.
      • Hands-on experience with EDR and SIEM platforms in production environments.
  • Ability to design end-to-end security operations pipelines — from log ingestion and detection through enrichment, triage, investigation, and response — with a clear understanding of where automation fits at each stage.
  • Systems thinking: comfortable reasoning about data flows, dependencies, failure modes, and the operational implications of architectural decisions before they are built.
  • Experience designing for scale and maintainability — architectures that a small team can operate, extend, and recover when things break.
  • Exposure to threat modeling concepts applied to security infrastructure — you do not need to have owned this, but you should be ready to grow into it.
  • Comfort thinking through architectural tradeoffs and documenting your reasoning — this is a skill we will develop together, not a prerequisite.
  • Strong Python — production-quality code with testing, version control, code review discipline.
  • Comfortable building integrations against REST APIs across heterogeneous security tools.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms, security automation frameworks, or equivalent home-grown tooling.
  • Git-based workflows; as-code mindset for detections, automations, and infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of AWS; experience with Azure or GCP is a plus.
  • Curiosity about how LLM-based agents differ from traditional automation, and where each fits.
  • Willingness to learn agent frameworks, MCP, and prompt engineering on the job, working alongside our AI Engineering team.
  • Side projects, reading, courses, or hobby experiments with LLMs or agents are a real plus — not because we need expertise, but because we need engagement.
  • Comfortable working with JSON and Markdown — the connective tissue of modern agent tooling, API integrations, MCP server schemas, and documentation.
  • Calibrated skepticism about over-automation — willing to say this should be a script, not an agent, or we should not automate this at all.
  • Operator empathy. A small security team will live with what you build. If you cannot sit with them and understand the work, you will build the wrong things.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This program is being built, not maintained.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience with MSSP-managed detection and response environments.
  • Detection-as-code experience: CI/CD pipelines for detection content, automated testing, content packaging.
  • Prior experience building SOAR playbooks (Tines, Torq, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent).
  • Incident response experience beyond Tier 1 — you have owned investigations end to end.
  • Cloud detection and response experience: audit logging, threat detection services, cloud security posture.
  • Identity-focused detection experience (Entra, Okta, Active Directory, or similar).
  • Any hands-on experience with LLM tooling: building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or MCP servers — even hobby-level.
  • Familiarity with agentic development workflows — CLAUDE.md, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot/Codex, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Prompt injection and LLM adversarial thinking — particularly relevant since security agents constantly read attacker-controlled data.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $155,000 to $205,000 which is comprised of base salary and bonus, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster.

S

ANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Salary: $155,000 - $205,000 (comprised of base salary and bonus)

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Lead
jobs.excerpt: 🧡 CoverflexWork changed.  Pay didn’t. Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🧡 Coverflex

Work changed. Pay didn’t.

Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.
We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.

Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.
We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.

⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)

Role: Cybersecurity Lead
Seniority Level: Lead
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages: English (main) / Portuguese or Spanish or Italian a plus
Main Tools: AWS and/or GCP security tooling, SIEM, detection/response, EDR/MDM, identity/SSO/MFA, and privileged-access tooling, Vulnerability scanning, application security testing, and penetration-testing workflows, Jira/Notion or equivalent risk, remediation, evidence, and roadmap tracking, Scripting/automation for control operation and evidence collection
Location: Remote (Europe only)
Compensation:

  • Base Salary: 65.000€ to 95.000€ gross yearly

  • Bonus / Commissions: No

  • Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan

  • Benefits: All Coverflex benefits apply

  • Contract Type: Permanent

💥 Your Impact

Your role will play a major role in our success because…

The Cybersecurity Lead will help Coverflex grow as a trusted, resilient multi-market fintech. By identifying material risks earlier, strengthening security operations and third-party assurance, and making security evidence reusable, this role will protect customers and company data, support reliable payment and benefits services, preserve ISO 27001 and contractual commitments, and reduce friction in launches, enterprise sales, renewals, and audits.

You’ll know you’re successful if, after 90 days...

  1. 100% of material security risks have an owner, treatment decision, due date, and monthly review; a monthly dashboard and quarterly Management Team risk review are in place; and all required ISMS, cybersecurity, and related privacy documentation has a named owner, review cadence, and current approved version.

  2. At least one executive risk exercise and one technical control validation are completed, with ≥90% of resulting actions closed by their due dates; ≥95% of critical/high vulnerabilities are remediated within policy SLA and all exceptions are formally approved and time-bound.

  3. 100% of defined high-risk changes receive a risk-based review before launch; 100% of critical suppliers are tiered and the highest-risk suppliers are assessed, with contractual and technical gaps tracked.

How we’ll measure success:

  • Establish ownership and visibility: consolidate material security risks, findings, exceptions, critical suppliers, security actions, tooling, spend, and key-person dependencies; own and maintain the core ISMS and cybersecurity documentation, including the Information Security Policy and Cybersecurity Risk Management Plan; and publish a risk-ranked 12-month roadmap and management dashboard. Privacy- and GDPR-specific documentation remains jointly coordinated with the DPO and Legal/Compliance, with explicit ownership agreed for each document.

  • Operationalise security governance and resilience: clarify escalation roles, risk thresholds, control ownership, evidence requirements, vulnerability SLAs, and the risk-exception workflow; run an executive risk exercise and technical control validation covering a critical payment partner.

  • Embed proportionate assurance into growth: establish review gates for high-risk launches, architecture changes, and critical vendors; introduce repeatable threat-modelling patterns; tier critical third parties and track material gaps to closure.

⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard

Let’s be real - here’s what makes this role challenging:

This is a broad, hands-on role in a scaling, regulated, multi-market environment. The person must move comfortably between technical investigation, cloud and product security, risk and assurance, partner management, and executive communication. They will need to influence teams without taking ownership away from Engineering, Product, Legal/Compliance, the DPO, or business leaders; prioritise ruthlessly with limited dedicated capacity; and build useful guardrails without becoming a gatekeeper. Third-party dependencies, an evolving threat surface, remote-first operations, and fragmented security ownership add complexity.

👤 You

Must-haves (evidence, not years)

  • Senior, hands-on security experience in a regulated fintech, payments, SaaS, or similarly high-trust environment

  • Personally conducted security investigations, tuned detections, assessed cloud and identity controls, reviewed architectures, and validated vulnerability remediation

  • Strong cloud, application/product security, IAM, detection/response, vulnerability management, and third-party risk judgement

  • Experience owning ISO 27001 or comparable assurance while keeping the programme outcome-focused

  • Ability to build a proportionate security programme in a scaling company, not only operate within a mature enterprise function

  • Credibility with engineers and the ability to translate technical detail into clear business recommendations

  • Fluent professional English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with payment processors, card ecosystems, regulated partners, or multi-market fintech operations

  • Experience using managed security services and specialist providers effectively

  • Security automation and evidence-collection experience

  • Experience with executive risk exercises and supplier resilience scenarios

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor; practical evidence matters more than certificates

🧬 Your DNA

Pragmatic, calm under pressure, curious, and evidence-driven. You combine sound judgement with a bias for action, challenge constructively, and communicate risk without fearmongering. You are comfortable doing the work yourself while creating leverage through standards, automation, and collaboration. You understand commercial trade-offs, make clear recommendations, and escalate material risks appropriately rather than seeking universal control.

You should add dedicated security depth and consistent ownership while preserving clear accountability in the teams that own systems and decisions. You will make Engineering, Product, IT, Legal/Compliance, the DPO, and leadership more effective through prioritisation, expert challenge, reusable patterns, direct technical support, and reliable follow-through. You should reduce key-person dependency on Technology Leadership and become the trusted bridge between technical evidence and business risk decisions.

👥 Manager & Team

Meet Your Manager

Hiring Manager: Tiago Fernandes, CTO
Location: Portugal
LinkedIn Profile

Profile Snapshot:

  • Who you are as a person: Curious and motivated by solving meaningful problems with durable systems rather than theatre. My approach can be pragmatic, but I also enjoy exploring a problem deeply before converging on the answer.

  • Who you are as a manager: I give experienced people autonomy and trust them to bring judgement, ownership, and a point of view. I do not always provide perfectly clear context at the outset, so I value people who ask questions, help structure ambiguity, and confirm shared outcomes and priorities.

  • Your type of energy: Calm, analytical, low-ego, and action-oriented—particularly in high-pressure and ambiguous situations.

  • Your communication style: Candid and context-rich. I sometimes provide more context than necessary or do not land the clearest version immediately, so I appreciate people who synthesise, ask clarifying questions, and help turn discussion into explicit decisions and next steps.

  • Your feedback style: Thoughtful and conversational, focused on learning and improving the work rather than assigning blame. I value a two-way dialogue and expect people to ask for clarification when the feedback is not sufficiently clear or actionable.

What is it like to work with you?

You will have meaningful autonomy, access to leadership, and support when a risk requires escalation. I expect you to bring a point of view, go deep enough to understand the facts, and be comfortable creating structure from ambiguity. We will not always begin with perfectly packaged context, so asking questions, summarising what you heard, and making decisions explicit are important. Healthy challenge is welcome, as is helping me simplify or sharpen the framing. The goal is to build a trusted security function that enables the business while being honest about material risk.

Your Team

  • Team structure: This is initially a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the CTO and owning the cybersecurity function. It is a hands-on position rather than a people-management layer. You will maintain the security roadmap, backlog, operating metrics, tooling, targeted specialist support, and core ISMS and cybersecurity policies and plans. You will partner with the DPO and Legal/Compliance on GDPR- and privacy-related documentation, with explicit ownership agreed per document. Engineering and other system-owning teams remain responsible for implementation, remediation, service ownership, and recovery.

  • Other stakeholders: Technology Leadership; Engineering and Infrastructure/Platform; Product; IT; Legal/Compliance; the DPO/Privacy; Finance and Procurement; People; Customer-facing teams; the Management Team; external auditors, penetration testers, managed security providers, cloud/SaaS vendors, and critical regulated/payment partners. The Management Team remains the final decision-maker for material residual-risk acceptance and major business trade-offs.

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)

We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.

No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.

Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

📬 Application Clarity

No cover letter required.

Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CV.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

Total candidate time investment: ~3–5 hours end-to-end.

🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)

1. CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves

• Done by People + Hiring Manager.

• You’ll hear from us within 7 business days.

2. Role-Fit Questionnaire (async)
Purpose: capture signals your CV can’t (languages, tools, scenario judgement) and calibrate seniority.

Format: multiple choice + short answers.

Accessibility: prefer a call? Tell us - we’ll swap for a short chat.

3. Hiring Manager Interview - Deep dive into your work • 45–60 min
Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.

4. Behavioural Interview - Show how you think • 45-60 min
Use our case or bring a real artefact (deck, PR, analysis, playbook).
We assess clarity, decision quality, stakeholder thinking, and ethics.

5. Case / Work Sample - Show how you think • ≤90 min
Use our case or bring a real artefact (deck, PR, analysis, playbook).
We assess clarity, decision quality, stakeholder thinking, and ethics.

6. Case Review & Team Chat - Walkthrough + Q&A • 20–30 min
You’ll get actionable feedback either way.

7. Final Conversation (CEO / C-Level) — Values, strategy, and your growth • 30–45 min

Optional: References (2–3 people who’ve seen your recent work) - async.

🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency

We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

  • Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.

  • Meeting recording tools (e.g., ): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.

  • ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.

Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.

⏱️ Speed & Communication

  • Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

  • Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

  • Scheduling:interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

  • Feedback:from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.

jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
Are you ready to leverage your talents to make healthcare better for everyone?
Do you want the opportunity to give back to your community?
Do you want to have fun at work?
Then join the growing team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States!

SUMMARY

HSAG is nationally recognized as an industry leader in healthcare data analysis, measure development, and survey research. We are seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer I with hands-on Amazon QuickSight expertise to design and deliver dashboards supporting HSAG’s Quality Improvement Organization (QIO) contract within the secure Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) environment. Familiarity with Tableau is also desired to support other HSAG visual analytics work.

UNIQUE BENEFITS

The BI Developer I position benefits from HSAG’s commitment to developing future leaders in healthcare data science and quality improvement. Under the direction of the Business Intelligence Architect and other senior DSAA leaders, this position collaborates directly with analysts, data scientists, project leaders, and QIO staff. The role’s primary focus is creating, enhancing, and supporting QIO dashboards in Amazon QuickSight, with opportunities to use Tableau for other visual analytics initiatives.

DESCRIPTION

The BI Developer I is a key contributor to federal analytic work supporting HSAG’s Quality Improvement Organization (QIO) contract. The primary responsibility of this role is to create, enhance, validate, document, and maintain dashboards in Amazon QuickSight within the secure CMS data environment. The successful candidate must be able to translate business and contract requirements into clear, accurate, and actionable dashboard experiences for QIO stakeholders. Data incorporated into these dashboards may include, but are not limited to:

· medical and prescription drug claims

· skilled nursing facility (SNF) home minimum data set (MDS) data

· case review

· facility self-reported

· demographics

· QIO operational data

· publicly reported data (e.g., Care Compare)

· survey and certification data

ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES, DUTIES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as an integral member of HSAG’s Data Science & Advanced Analytics division.
  • Work with HSAG staff, CMS stakeholders, and other customers to elicit, document, and refine dashboard requirements.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, document, and maintain Amazon QuickSight analyses, datasets, reports, and multi-level dashboards in the CMS environment.
  • Develop efficient, intuitive QuickSight dashboard navigation, drill-downs, filters, parameters, calculations, and role-appropriate views.
  • Apply data validation and quality-control procedures to confirm that dashboard measures, calculations, labels, and visualizations accurately reflect approved specifications.
  • Maintain dashboard version documentation and support controlled promotion of dashboard changes in accordance with CMS and HSAG processes.
  • Create and maintain Tableau dashboards or visualizations for other assigned HSAG work, as needed.
  • Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions and advanced BI visualizations, applying effective data visualization and dashboard usability practices.
  • Use approved data sources and reporting tools to validate dashboard measures, investigate data issues, and support ad hoc analysis.
  • Develop clear dashboard documentation, data definitions, user guidance, presentations, and related project materials.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting to HSAG staff, stakeholders, and providers regarding QuickSight dashboards, data, access, and functionality.
  • Coordinate the technical User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process, document findings, resolve defects, and support production readiness for dashboards.
  • Manage assigned work across the dashboard development lifecycle, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality products that align with project schedules, QIO contract requirements, security expectations, and milestones.
  • Communicate complex technical and analytic topics clearly through written documentation, demonstrations, and oral presentations.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer information systems, or a quantitative discipline.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining visualization solutions in Amazon QuickSight is required. Candidates must demonstrate practical QuickSight expertise, including experience creating analyses, dashboards, calculated fields, filters, parameters, and interactive visualizations.
  • Familiarity with Tableau dashboard development is required to support additional HSAG visual analytics work; hands-on Tableau development experience is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience documenting business and technical requirements based on user interviews are required.
  • Experience with Databricks is preferred.

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working with healthcare data, Medicare data, claims data, quality improvement data, or other regulated data is preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle several projects simultaneously and work with multiple teams.

CMS ACCESS AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

    This position requires access to CMS data systems and secure computing environments. As a condition of performing assigned QIO work, the selected candidate must successfully complete all required CMS vetting, identity verification, background investigation, security, privacy, and access-authorization processes applicable to the role.

    The employee must maintain eligibility for CMS system access, complete required security and privacy training, comply with CMS and HSAG policies for handling sensitive information, and promptly provide documentation or information needed to establish and retain access.

    Employment in the role and assignment of CMS-related duties are contingent upon obtaining and maintaining the required CMS approvals and system access. Inability to obtain or retain required access may affect the individual’s ability to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Power BI Developer
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies.
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Power BI Developer with strong data engineering expertise. This role will design and build Power Apps applications, Power Automate workflows, and Power BI solutions using governed Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and Veterans Health Administration (VHA) data assets, including the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW). The role will also develop the data pipelines and models that support these solutions. The incumbent will own solutions end-to-end, including data modeling, ingestion and transformation logic, application and report development, and ALM governance, to ensure deliverables are maintainable, performant, and compliant.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Power Apps Development
  • Design, build, and deploy canvas and model-driven Power Apps that operationalize VA/VHA data and replace manual, spreadsheet, or email-driven processes.
  • Architect Dataverse as the application data backbone — designing tables, columns, relationships, keys, business rules, calculated/rollup columns, and security roles.
  • Connect apps to Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server/Azure SQL, and the CDW using standard, premium, and (where required) custom connectors, and to external data through virtual tables and dataflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible (Section 508/WCAG) screens, forms, and views, and implement application logic using Power Fx.
  • Develop reusable components, component libraries, and PCF controls to standardize UX and accelerate delivery across apps.
  • Apply ALM and Power Platform governance — solutions, managed/unmanaged layering, environment strategy, deployment pipelines, and source control (Git / Azure DevOps) — through the Power Platform admin center.
  • Optimize app performance (delegation, data-source efficiency, concurrent loading) and harden apps with appropriate security and data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
Power Automate Development
  • Build and maintain cloud flows to automate data movement, approvals, notifications, and process hand-offs across Dataverse, SharePoint, Outlook/Teams, SQL, and VA systems.
  • Develop scheduled, automated (event-triggered), and instant flows, using connectors, expressions, environment variables, and robust error handling, retries, and logging.
  • Implement desktop flows / RPA (Power Automate Desktop) to automate interactions with legacy or non-API systems where appropriate.
  • Orchestrate ingestion and transformation steps within larger data pipelines, coordinating with Dataverse, dataflows, and downstream reporting.
  • Design flows for reliability and observability — including monitoring, alerting, and graceful failure handling and document trigger conditions and dependencies.
Power BI Development
  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models against the CDW and other VA data sources.
  • Author robust data models with star-schema design, relationships, and well-documented DAX measures, calculated columns, and Power Query (M) transformations.
  • Configure row-level security (RLS), gateways, refresh schedules, incremental refresh/partitioning, and workspace/app deployment.
  • Tune model and report performance (query folding, aggregations, model size, DAX optimization) and apply deployment pipelines for promotion across dev/test/prod.
  • Build certified, reusable datasets and shared semantic models that serve multiple downstream reports and apps.
Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
  • Design and build ingestion and transformation pipelines (ETL/ELT) that move data from VA source systems and the CDW into Dataverse, Azure SQL, and Power BI semantic models.
  • Develop and maintain Power Platform dataflows, Azure Data Factory, and/or SSIS pipelines, including logic for staging, cleansing, conforming, and loading.
  • Design dimensional and normalized data models (fact/dimension structures, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions) to support analytics and applications.
  • Implement performant data connectivity — gateways, virtual tables, dataflows, and direct SQL — with attention to refresh windows, volume, and security constraints.
  • Build data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks into pipelines, and instrument monitoring/alerting for pipeline health.
  • Apply CI/CD and source control to data assets, and partner with data engineering teams on shared pipeline patterns and reusable transformation logic.
VA/VHA Data Sources, Systems & the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW)
  • Work directly with VA/VHA clinical, operational, financial, and administrative data sources and the CDW, including its domains and fact/dimension structures.
  • Understand and work within CDW access methods, refresh schedules, security considerations, and system constraints, and how source systems feed the CDW and downstream layers.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to understand and leverage data flows across development, test, and production environments.
  • Enable analysts and engineers to use VA data assets effectively (CDW tables, views, and approved reporting layers) through working solutions and concise reference material.
Business Process Engineering & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Partner with VA/VHA stakeholders to elicit data, process, and application requirements and clarify business and technical needs.
  • Map current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) processes, identifying manual hand-offs and opportunities to automate or improve with Power Platform solutions.
  • Translate business questions and operational needs into data models, app/flow designs, and report requirements.
  • Facilitate working sessions, demos, and reviews to validate solution and process accuracy with subject matter experts.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Technical Documentation, Metadata & Governance (Supporting)
  • Document the logic behind delivered solutions — Power BI models and DAX, Power Apps data connections and Power Fx logic, Power Automate flows, and pipeline transformations — for reuse, governance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, source-to-target mappings, and data lineage for the datasets and models you build, with consistent naming conventions and definitions.
  • Validate that engineered datasets, app data connections, and flows align with documented business rules, security requirements, and data quality expectations.
  • Support data governance and compliance by documenting data ownership, stewardship, usage constraints, and adherence to VA, federal, and program standards.
  • Maintain version-controlled documentation repositories alongside source-controlled solution artifacts.
Methodology, Standards & Continuous Improvement
  • Contribute reusable app, flow, model, and pipeline patterns, plus templates and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery tooling, efficiency, and governance.
  • Support Agile or hybrid delivery, producing solutions and documentation aligned with sprint-based, iterative delivery.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years building solutions with the Microsoft Power Platform, with hands-on, production experience across Power Apps (canvas and/or model-driven), Power Automate, and Power BI.
  • Demonstrated Power Apps development: Dataverse modeling, screen/form design, Power Fx logic, and data connections to Dataverse, SharePoint, and SQL-based sources.
  • Demonstrated Power Automate development: cloud flows using connectors, expressions, and error handling for data movement, approvals, and process automation.
  • Demonstrated Power BI development: data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), refresh, and report/dashboard delivery.
  • Hands-on data engineering experience: building ETL/ELT or data pipelines, data modeling, and working with structured and semi-structured data from multiple systems.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases and proficiency in SQL for building, reviewing, and validating data structures and logic.
  • Working knowledge of Power Platform data connectivity (Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL) and how governed data assets support these solutions.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality practices, and the ability to document the logic behind delivered solutions.
  • Experience supporting business process engineering (process mapping, as-is/to-be workflows, requirements elicitation).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including translating technical content for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating within cross-functional teams.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust
Preferred Qualification
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
  • Advanced Power Platform expertise: complex DAX, performance tuning, RLS, deployment pipelines, custom/premium connectors, PCF controls, Power Fx, and model-driven app development.
  • Power Platform ALM at scale: solution layering, environment strategy, DLP policies, and source control (Git / Azure DevOps).
  • Data engineering tooling: Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Synapse, Azure SQL, dataflows, and cloud data platform experience.
  • Relevant certifications: PL-100 (App Maker), PL-200 (Functional Consultant), PL-400 (Developer), PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), or Azure data certifications (DP-203, DP-900).
  • Prior experience supporting the VA, VHA, or other federal healthcare agencies.
  • Direct experience with the VA Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), VA data domains, or enterprise VA systems.
  • Formal process improvement experience (BPMN, Lean/Six Sigma).
  • Experience with data cataloging, metadata, or documentation platforms (Confluence, SharePoint, data catalogs).
  • Experience in Agile delivery supporting analytics or data modernization initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

PFS offers a benefits package that may include health, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; disability and life insurance; a retirement plan; paid time off; and other programs to support employees and their families. Learn more about PFS Benefits.

The posted salary range represents PFS's good-faith estimate for this role. Actual compensation offered will be determined by a combination of factors, including but not limited to: the candidate's education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience;internal equity; geographic location; and contract and organizational requirements. PFS is committed to fair, consistent, and equitable compensation practices across the organization, and offers are calibrated to maintain internal pay equity while remaining competitive in the external market.

Salary Range $100,000 - $130,000

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other status protected by law.

Accommodations

Workplace Health, Safety, and Compliance
