jobs.description:
We are an international broker. Our clients fund and withdraw through roughly 60 payment methods across Asia, Africa, LATAM and the Middle East.

Payments is now a standalone function, and we are building the team around it.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who will own our connector layer and everything downstream of it: building a canonical adapter layer so that providers plug in rather than get built one by one, moving payment methods to server-to-server and embedded flows, and making transaction status reliable and observable across the estate.

You will also be the payments function's technical counterpart to the orchestration platform team: the behaviour we need from the platform is specified here, argued here and reviewed here.

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Building and owning the connector and adapter layer, so that adding or replacing a provider becomes configuration and a thin adapter rather than a new integration each time
  • Migrating payment methods from redirect flows to server-to-server and embedded flows where the provider supports it, and measuring the result
  • Owning everything downstream of the orchestration layer: reconciliation, transaction status handling on our side, method configuration and payment flows into the client portal
  • Making transaction status reliable end to end, through active status polling, idempotent processing and reconciliation
  • Building observability over transaction status and provider performance across the estate
  • Specifying the behaviour we need from the orchestration platform: transaction state machine, idempotency, polling, routing and cascading rules. You design it, argue for it and review what comes back
  • Supporting integration work for our card programme
  • Extending the same integration set to acquired entities as configuration rather than a new build each time

Requirements

  • 5+ years in backend engineering, strong in TypeScript, Node.js, comfortable in relational databases
  • Production experience with payment systems: authorisation, callbacks, refunds, reconciliation and retry behaviour
  • Practical understanding of idempotency, asynchronous status handling, transaction state machines and designing for partial failure. This is the core of the role rather than a detail, and you will both build against it and specify it
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs of uneven quality, including working directly with a provider's integration team to resolve what the documentation does not answer
  • The ability to own a service rather than close tickets: architecture decisions, standards and root cause fixes
  • English and Russian at a working communicative level

Will be a significant plus:

  • Exposure to .NET for work touching the client portal
  • Experience with APM and local rails in Asia, Africa or LATAM rather than cards alone
  • Experience with bank transfer rails, virtual accounts, QR-based methods, mobile money etc.
  • Event-driven patterns in production: transactional outbox, idempotent consumers, sagas
  • Background in brokerage, crypto payments, orchestration or another high-volume payments environment; on the provider side, at a PSP, gateway or payment company
  • Active use of AI tooling in daily work
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions without constant oversight
  • Proactive mindset: willingness to propose improvements, fixes, new approaches
  • What the first year looks like.
  • In the first months you take over the integration codebase with a documented handover, strengthen transaction status handling, and ship your first server-to-server integration.
  • By mid-year the adapter layer is in place, new providers go live against it rather than as one-off builds, and transaction status and provider performance are observable across the estate.
  • In the second half the migration to server-to-server and embedded flows runs as a programme across methods, and the same integration set starts extending to our other entities. As the team grows, a Systems Analyst takes over instrumentation and verification while integration engineering stays with you.

Recruitment process:

  • HR interview, covering background, motivation and fit
  • Technical interview on backend engineering and the payments domain
  • Home task as a case from the real needs
  • System design and problem-solving interview, covering integration design, failure handling and status modelling
  • Final interview with senior stakeholder.

Benefits

Fixed monthly compensation of [based on experience]

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Dockwa Dockwa is the operating system for the marine economy.
jobs.description:
About Dockwa

Dockwa is the operating system for the marine economy.

More than 1,250 marinas run their business on our software and more than 500,000 boaters use our app to find and book slips, fuel, service, and more. Nearly half a million reservations moved through us in the last twelve months. We own the boater marketplace, marina operations, and the payments layer underneath both.

That distribution is the whole argument. When anyone can generate software, the durable advantage is being the system an industry already runs on. We have that in boating and we just raised to go take it global.

About the Role

You will build the software marina operators use to run their businesses, and the boater app on the other side of it.

Engineering is six people today and will be fourteen inside a year. That is a small team against a large surface: reservations, payments and money movement, dock and slip management, rent roll, boater CRM, service and work orders, accounting integrations, a native iOS app, and multi-currency as we move internationally. The gap between team size and surface area is the job. It means you make real decisions early, and your judgment matters more than your tenure.

You will own problems rather than tickets. Scoping, design, implementation, deploy, and what happens after. You will also spend real time in code you did not write, in a twelve-year-old system carrying live payment traffic, which is its own kind of skill.

Most of our customers run seasonal businesses where a bad Saturday morning costs them a weekend of revenue. You will know within days whether what you shipped helped them.

Who Thrives Here

The people who thrive at Dockwa have usually founded something, or joined something early and grew with it. They think in outcomes rather than tickets. They have opinions about the product and the business, not only the code. They would rather ship something an operator notices on a Saturday morning than win an argument about abstractions.

You should want to steer. There is more consequential work here than there are people to do it, which means you will help decide what gets built, not just build what was decided. We also treat AI as core development infrastructure rather than a side experiment, and we expect you to already work that way.

What You Need

  • Production web applications you shipped and then owned, not just contributed to.
  • Real AI fluency with receipts. Not tool familiarity. Work you could not have delivered without it.
  • Comfort across a full stack. Ours is Rails, React, Postgres and AWS, but we will take judgment over stack match every time.
  • The ability to read and improve unfamiliar code without proposing a rewrite.
  • Writing clear enough to explain a technical tradeoff to a PM, a support teammate, or a marina operator.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Payments and money movement experience: Stripe or Stripe Connect, ACH, settlement, reconciliation, multi-currency.
  • Vertical SaaS or B2B software where your users operate a physical business rather than sit at a desk.
  • International product work: currency, localization, tax, compliance.
  • AWS beyond EC2 and S3: queuing, caching, and background jobs at scale.
  • Experience on a team small enough that you were the one on call for what you built.

How We Hire

Short, collaborative, and built around real problems rather than memory tests or puzzles. We are screening for motivation and judgment over trivia, and we want you to finish the process more excited than you started it.

How We Work

We are a small team that is winning. Problems grow exponentially with each person added, not linearly, so we keep the organization lean on purpose and put people at the source of problems with real ownership.

We automate before we hire. We ship quality at speed and treat those as compatible. We own the full loop from discovery to payment to analytics, because controlling the data is what makes the intelligence products possible.

We move fast, and context does not always land perfectly. It is always fine to ask why.

We have an institutional partner in PSG and an annual plan that’s in our control. We’re investing heavily in product and engineering because the operating system of the marine economy is ours to build and own. Acquisitions are part of how we grow, and we have dedicated budget behind that as well.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for range on purpose. Different vantage points produce better arguments, and on a team this small every viewpoint in the room changes the outcome. Dockwa is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company leveraging innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability within the plastic surgery industry.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company leveraging innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability within the plastic surgery industry. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming how the industry operates.

Data is a critical product within our company, and we are investing heavily in our data capabilities. Our platform is what aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery practices run their business on, covering scheduling, clinical records, forms and consents, invoicing and payments, patient communications, and the marketing that sits in front of all of it. It is a multi-tenant platform holding millions of patient records under HIPAA and GDPR, and we onboard new practices every month.

Our job is to give patients an experience that feels considered at every step, to make the practice itself run efficiently, and to grow that practice as a result. Data is what makes all three possible. A patient's journey with a practice runs from first lead through consultation and procedure to follow-up, and a practice can only improve that journey, staff against it, and invest behind it when the numbers describing it are right. Getting that picture back to our clients accurately is a large part of what they pay us for. Every practice that joins us arrives by migrating off a legacy system, so migration here is ongoing work rather than a one-time project.

While we are a remote-first company, we are currently only able to hire candidates located in the following U.S. states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, OK, OR, PA, RI, TX, UT, and WA. We hope to expand to additional states in the future.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to be the most experienced engineer on our data team. This is a hands-on role by design. You will pair with the team daily, set the standards the data function works to, and take the lead on the architecture decisions that shape what we build next.

The remit is broad. You will own the target design for the warehouse and the curated layer that sits on top of it, define the semantic layer so that every business metric carries one agreed definition, and establish the standards for naming, lineage, and data quality that the whole function works to. All of it serves the same end. A practice should be able to see the patient journey clearly enough to improve it, see where its time and capacity actually go, and know which of its decisions grew the business. You will also take migration from something skilled people do carefully to something the platform does repeatably.

Our warehouse is Amazon Redshift running a medallion model, fed from PostgreSQL by Python pipelines and from marketing sources by Fivetran, with Power BI on top. You will own the recommendation on where that architecture goes next, and then you will build it.

We also build with AI as a default rather than as an experiment. Coding agents draft quickly here, so the skill we hire for and level on is knowing what to build and recognizing what is wrong with a draft. Our data team already works with Claude Code connected to the warehouse every day.

As the Senior Data Engineer, you will:

Architecture and Modeling

  • Own the target architecture for the warehouse and the curated layer, decide where that design goes next, and write down the reasoning behind the call.
  • Design the semantic layer as a single metric repository, where each business metric means one thing and the definition, the formula, and the reasoning behind it are all recorded.
  • Set the standard for naming, labeling, and lineage, and bring enumerated values and business rule history into data the warehouse can resolve directly.
  • Build the configuration model for practice-specific business rules, so that each new practice's setup arrives as data the platform can apply.

Building With the Team

  • Pair with the data engineers daily. Review their work in a way that teaches, and let them review yours.
  • Build the gold layer and a baseline report library that every new practice gets from day one, covering the patient journey, practice capacity, and growth.
  • Extend infrastructure as code and CI across the warehouse and its pipelines, with tests that catch schema drift when the product changes.
  • Bring the unstructured clinical record into the warehouse in structured form, including the journals, notes, and form submissions that arrive as HTML and PDF.

Automation and AI in the Data Platform

  • Deepen the automation around migration profiling, delta reconciliation, data quality checks, and report provisioning.
  • Put AI to work inside the pipelines for enrichment, anomaly detection, and metadata generation, including a data dictionary and enum catalog that stay current because they are generated.
  • Make the warehouse safe and useful for AI. That means a complete catalog with descriptions and enumerations, a semantic layer that natural language queries resolve against instead of raw tables, a golden set of questions that measures accuracy before business stakeholders get access, and strict adherence to the rules governing which tools may touch patient data.

Migrations and Partnership With Engineering

  • Take migration from something skilled people do carefully to something the platform does repeatably, with pre-migration profiling, a matching framework for post go-live deltas, LLM-assisted schema mapping and record matching where it earns its place, and rejected record reporting so that nothing is dropped silently. The design target is two practice go-lives a month.
  • Partner with the engineering teams on the platform changes the data function depends on, and define with them the change contract that keeps the platform and the warehouse in step as new fields and statuses ship.
  • Work directly with product and commercial leadership on what to measure, not only on how to measure it. You should be the person who can tell a stakeholder which number actually says whether the patient experience improved, whether the practice got more efficient, or whether it grew.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in data engineering, including end to end ownership of a warehouse or lakehouse architecture, from ingestion through to the curated layer that people actually query.
  • Deep SQL and Python, with production experience on a modern cloud warehouse. Redshift is what we run today, and Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks experience transfers.
  • Hands-on experience building a semantic or metrics layer yourself, using dbt or an equivalent tool.
  • Production experience with orchestration and infrastructure as code on AWS (e.g., Airflow and Terraform).
  • Experience designing and maintaining dimensional or Data Vault models in production..
  • Data quality testing and observability built into the pipeline, using dbt tests, Great Expectations, or an equivalent, alongside daily use of coding agents and AI tooling in your own work.
  • AI applied inside a data platform, such as LLM classification of unstructured records, entity matching, anomaly detection, or natural language querying over a semantic layer, with an evaluation set that told you how well it worked.
  • Experience with regulated data, such as healthcare or financial data.

Benefits

What We Offer

At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • 401k Plan
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Company equity opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible schedules
  • Collaborative and thriving team culture guided by Adoreal’s core values

Why Adoreal?

Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles:

  • We do what is best for the company, not what is best for individuals of the company—we take pride in our work, but not in pride itself—the success of Adoreal is more important than our egos.
  • We always share relevant information and admit our mistakes freely and openly (even when it is worrisome or uncomfortable to do so). Candid communication and a solution-oriented mindset is rewarded.
  • We innovate by finding the right problems, then solving them. We thrive on change that minimizes complexity and improves situations for our stakeholders.

  • We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day.

About the Role

Market My Market is looking for a Senior Director, Client Experience to own the Client Experience department. Today that department serves more than 320 clients and is made up of two Directors, Client Experience, roughly 11 Client Experience Managers, and 7 Client Success Assistants. This is the leader our two Directors report to, and the person the whole department looks to for direction, standards, and accountability.

This is a leadership seat first. It is built for someone who has already run a client-facing organization inside a fast-growing digital marketing agency, who knows what it takes to keep clients for years, and who can set the tone for how an entire department communicates, inspects its own work, and gets ahead of problems before clients feel them.

You will also keep your feet wet by managing a small portfolio of approximately five accounts of your own, so you are living the same client conversations, reports, and results your team is accountable for. You will own retention, the client messaging standard, and the department's operating rhythm. You will look at the KPIs every week, ask the questions no one else is asking, and teach your directors and their teams to do the same. When something is off, you will propose the fix, not just flag the issue. The Senior Director, Client Experience reports to the CEO and sits on the leadership team.

What You Will Own

Department Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable Client Experience Managers a team of roughly 11 Client Experience Managers and 7 Client Success Assistants serving 320+ clients. This role will have a handful of direct reports, and will also monitor the success of Client Experience Managers and Client Success Assistants that report to other Directors of Client Experience
  • Set clear expectations and scoreboards for every seat in the department, then inspect against them consistently. Praise in public, correct in private, and never let a miss go unaddressed.
  • Own the department's operating cadence: weekly KPI reviews, portfolio health reviews, one-on-ones, and quarterly rocks that ladder up to company goals.
  • Build the bench. Identify and develop the next generation of CX leaders and make sure every director and manager has a growth plan.
  • Represent Client Experience on the leadership team and partner with the SEO, Content, Paid, Creative, and Business Development leaders so clients experience one company, not five departments.

Client Retention & Portfolio Health

  • Own client retention and lifetime value across every account the department manages. Retention is the number this role is measured on first.
  • Build and run an early-warning system for at-risk clients: know which accounts are drifting before they tell us, and make sure there is a documented save plan and an owner on every one.
  • Personally get involved in the accounts that matter most and the escalations that could cost us a client, then turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook for the team.
  • Drive renewals, upsell, and cross-sell as a natural outcome of well-run accounts, working closely with Business Development.
  • Set the standard for onboarding, the first 90 days, and QBRs so every client understands what we are doing, why, and what it is producing.
  • Manage approximately five client accounts of your own to the same standard you hold the team to, and use that hands-on experience to keep your coaching, playbooks, and expectations grounded in reality.

Messaging & Value Communication

  • Own the messaging standard for the entire department: how we talk about results, how we explain what happened in a month, how we deliver hard news, and how we frame the next recommendation.
  • Build the frameworks, templates, and talk tracks that turn rankings, traffic, calls, and leads into a clear ROI story a practice or business owner cares about.
  • Review client-facing communication, reports, and meeting recaps regularly and coach to the standard. If a client is confused about the value they are getting, that is on us.
  • Make sure every CXM can explain the full MMM offering, including SEO, paid ads, content, web, and Google Business Profile, and position it in a way that fits each client's goals.

KPIs, Inspection & Proactive Operations

  • Define the department's KPIs, including retention, NPS, response time, meeting cadence, upsell, and portfolio health, and report on them to the CEO and leadership team every week.

  • Get the most out of the tools we have already invested in, including Zoom Revenue Accelerator, HubSpot, Claude, Replit, and our internal apps, then push them further. Use call intelligence to coach, CRM data to spot risk, and AI to take manual work off the team's plate.

Solutions & Opportunities

  • Come to the table with solutions. When a process breaks, a client churns, or a report misses the mark, own the root cause and bring a proposed fix with a plan to roll it out.
  • Look for opportunities others miss: new service lines clients are asking for, packaging that would retain better, processes that would free up capacity, and gaps between what we sell and what we deliver.
  • Partner with the SEO Director, Content Director, and PPC Manager on delivery issues that show up in client conversations, and push for fixes that stick.
  • Contribute to case studies, webinars, and thought leadership that show clients and prospects what great looks like.

What Success Looks Like

  • Across the department: Every director and manager knows their numbers, owns their scoreboard, and can explain the story behind it without prompting.

Als Cloud Engineer (gn) - AWS gestaltest und entwickelst du unsere Cloud-Plattformen kontinuierlich weiter. Damit wir gut zusammenarbeiten können, setzen wir für diese Position einen bestehenden Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland voraus.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere Cloud-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt auf AWS, sodass sie sicher, skalierbar und effizient betrieben werden kann
  • Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Infrastructure-as-Code-Umgebungen (z. B. mit Terraform) und automatisierst Abläufe mithilfe eigener Scripts (Python, Go, Bash) sowie AWS-native Services
  • Du konzipierst, betreibst und verbesserst CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. mit GitHub Actions) für Anwendungen und Infrastrukturkomponenten
  • Du entwickelst Self-Service-Lösungen, die unsere Entwicklungsteams in die Lage versetzen, Cloud-Ressourcen eigenständig und sicher zu nutzen – und unterstützt sie bei Bedarf im operativen Einsatz
  • Du gestaltest Lösungen für Monitoring, Logging, Alerting und Observability, um einen zuverlässigen und transparenten Plattformbetrieb sicherzustellen
  • Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Cloud-Plattform durch neue Technologien und Ansätze gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau, Betrieb und der Automatisierung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen - idealerweise auf AWS
  • Du verstehst grundlegende Prinzipien moderner Cloud-Architekturen und kannst sie bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform sinnvoll anwenden

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich aktiv ein und kommunizierst klar und konstruktiv - auch teamübergreifend

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

jobs.description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

Associate Director, Quality Auditor, GVP

Closing Date: 9th October 2026 (COB)


Business Introduction

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:

Our approach to R&D

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic quality professional to join GSK as an Associate Director, Quality Auditor, GVP within R&D Quality and Risk Management.

The purpose of this role is to provide independent Quality Assurance across GSK R&D by delivering comprehensive global audit programmes and influencing quality and compliance strategies. This position plays a key leadership role in ensuring compliance with international pharmacovigilance regulations, GSK policies and procedures, and industry best practices. The successful candidate will define audit scope and methodology, lead complex audits, identify emerging compliance trends, drive quality improvements across the organisation, and support regulatory inspections.

This is an influential position requiring strong leadership, expert knowledge of pharmacovigilance quality systems, and the ability to partner effectively across multiple functions and geographic regions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver risk-based pharmacovigilance audits across processes, systems and third parties to assess compliance with global regulatory requirements and GSK standards.
  • Develop and execute audit strategies and plans that align with organisational priorities and emerging compliance risks.
  • Provide independent quality oversight by identifying compliance risks, evaluating quality systems, and recommending sustainable improvements.
  • Lead discussions with senior stakeholders to communicate audit outcomes, drive effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and monitor their implementation and effectiveness.
  • Analyse audit data, compliance trends, and quality metrics to identify systemic issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a key quality partner during regulatory inspections and inspection readiness activities.
  • Provide expert advice on pharmacovigilance regulatory expectations, quality risk management, and compliance practices.
  • Influence and collaborate across global matrix teams to strengthen quality culture and compliance performance.
  • Coach, mentor and develop auditors and business partners, sharing best practices and contributing to organisational capability building.

Why You?

Basic Qualifications

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific, pharmacy, life sciences, quality-related discipline, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Significant experience within the pharmaceutical industry, quality assurance and/or pharmacovigilance.
  • Extensive knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and quality management expectations.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and leading complex quality audits.
  • Experience developing corrective and preventive action strategies and evaluating effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and planning skills.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across global matrix organisations.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 25%).

Preferred Qualifications

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Experience leading or coordinating regulatory authority inspections.
  • Broad knowledge across multiple GxP disciplines.
  • Expertise in risk-based quality management, root cause analysis and quality-by-design methodologies.
  • Experience using digital technologies, AI/ML solutions and data analytics to inform quality oversight activities.
  • Experience auditing complex third-party and supplier relationships.
  • Professional auditing certification or equivalent formal auditor training.
  • Established external network within quality, compliance or regulatory organisations.

Location and Working Style

  • Role based in United Kingdom or Poland.

- Home-working model.

  • Regular travel to support audit execution, inspections, and stakeholder engagement activities.

EU BASED ONLY!

WHO WE ARE

Delve Deeper is a performance media agency focused on the charity and nonprofit sector, partnering with organizations that invest $5M–$20M annually in media. We help mission-driven teams maximize impact through advanced digital strategies that drive measurable, scalable results.

Our expertise includes advanced analytics, intent-based audience segmentation, full-service media management, and personalized creative—delivering a fully integrated, data-driven approach to growth.

More than a vendor, we serve as a strategic partner, helping organizations solve complex media challenges and turn them into clear outcomes. With decades of leadership experience, Delve Deeper is a trusted voice in the charity space.

We’ve also been named Built In Colorado’s “Best Places to Work” for five consecutive years, reflecting a culture that values performance, growth, and people. As a privately owned company, we move quickly, support our team holistically, and create meaningful opportunities for advancement.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Dedicated individual contributor focused entirely on building and maintaining a multi-agent AI system that automates performance media trading decisions. This is not a generalist developer role. You will work within a complex multi-agent codebase, operate under strict evaluation-first protocols, and develop deep enough understanding of the business domain to make sound implementation decisions without constant oversight. Data errors have direct financial consequences for clients — engineering quality is non-negotiable.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Agent Development:Build, iterate, and maintain AI agents within the architecture and boundaries defined by the Lead AI Engineer. Own your agents end-to-end: prompt design, tool wiring, context routing, failure handling, and output validation.
  • Data Integration:Integrate data components across media platforms — ingesting, normalizing to schema, and routing to the correct agent context. Work within defined data contracts and surface schema drift before it becomes a runtime failure.
  • Evaluation-First Development:No feature enters development without defined success criteria and regression tests. Run prompt benchmarking, track output quality across model versions, and flag hallucination patterns or quality regressions proactively. Evaluation is not a post-build step.
  • Pipeline & ETL Work:Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines supporting daily automated callouts and weekly optimisation reporting. Own data freshness and pipeline reliability for the agents you are responsible for.
  • MCP Connector Work:Operate within and extend the MCP connector library for external platform APIs. Handle rate limits, retries, and failure modes — connectors must be resilient in production, not just in testing.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Workflows:Build and maintain Slack-based approval flows — agent callouts, feedback capture, exception alerts, and operational notifications. These are the primary interface between the AI system and human decision-makers.
  • Production Reliability:Own the reliability of your agents in production. Monitor output quality, respond to incidents, drive root-cause fixes rather than surface patches. Alert the Lead AI Engineer early on scope or complexity that affects delivery.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 4+ years across software, data engineering, ML, or AI platform work with direct ownership of production systems
  • Experience with media platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, Semrush, SerpAPI)
  • Strong Python and SQL — production-grade, not just analytical scripts
  • MCP or equivalent integration layer experience
  • Hands-on experience building or operating LLM applications, agentic systems, or tool-calling workflows
  • Workflow orchestration tooling: Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, dbt
  • ETL/ELT pipeline design and data reliability in production — schema management, contract enforcement, freshness monitoring
  • Cloud infrastructure: AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerized deployments (Docker)
  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks and success criteria for model outputs
  • Slack API and webhook-based workflow automation
  • Familiarity with vector databases and RAG patterns for long-context data retrieval
  • Experience shipping systems that mix model logic, deterministic business rules, and human approval flows
  • LLM evaluation tooling — token cost tracking, hallucination detection, model benchmarking

THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Generalist developers without LLM or agentic system experience
  • Prompt engineering work without responsibility for data quality and pipeline reliability
  • Low-code automation builders (n8n, Make, Zapier)
  • A role with loose evaluation standards or optional quality gates
  • Research-only AI scientists without production ownership
  • A role where shipping late with a perfect solution is acceptable
  • Candidates who need architecture decisions made for them before starting
  • A role without direct accountability for production incidents on your agents

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

Serves as the lead manager responsible for delivery of lab data processing services.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

  • Advises Department of Justice attorneys, paralegals, and case managers on all phases of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM); especially: Data Collection, Processing, Hosting, Review, Analytics, and Production.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • At least five years of experience at the management/supervisory level.
  • Requires thorough knowledge of the litigation discovery process, and the EDRM workflow.
  • Working knowledge and certifications of document review software such as iConect, Relativity, Venio or similar tools.
  • Undergraduate degree required, preferably in computer science or related field.
  • Only the Contracting Officer can approve a waiver of the degree requirement.
  • At least eight years of experience performing eDiscovery roles including but not limited to electronic files processing (EFP), image and data file conversion, data culling using review tools, quality assurance, database loads and retrieval, and data analysis and review.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with litigation support tools such as LAW, IPRO, Concordance, MS Office Suite, and LiveNote highly valued.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This is a fully remote position; work is performed from a home office.
  • Must be located in or near the Washington, DC area and available for short-notice on-site meetings.
  • Work is primarily sedentary, performed while using a computer for extended periods of time.

This is a performance-driven role focused on identifying potential customers, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities, and booking meetings for the sales team.

You’ll execute outbound campaigns across email, cold calls, LinkedIn, and multi-channel sequences, while working closely with sales and marketing teams to continuously improve outreach performance.

If you’re proactive, resilient, competitive, and motivated by measurable sales results, this role is a strong fit.

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Research

  • Handle objections confidently and professionally

  • Keep lead stages and statuses current
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and organized pipeline tracking
  • Ensure qualified opportunities are handed off accurately and on time

Sales & Marketing Collaboration

  • Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership on qualified handoffs
  • Collaborate with marketing teams on messaging and lead quality
  • Share insights from prospect conversations to improve positioning
  • Provide feedback on objections, market trends, and prospect needs
  • Support broader outbound growth initiatives as needed

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 1–2+ years of SDR, BDR, outbound sales, or lead generation experience

  • Familiarity with outbound platforms such as:
    • Outreach.io
    • Salesloft
    • Apollo
    • HubSpot Sequences
  • Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to personalize messaging and conduct professional prospect outreach
  • Strong organization and follow-through
  • Comfortable working toward activity, meeting, and pipeline targets
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup

Preferred Experience

  • 2–4 years of SDR or BDR experience with demonstrated quota attainment
  • Experience selling:
    • B2B SaaS
    • Marketing services
    • Staffing or recruiting services
    • Agency services
    • Professional services
  • Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts
  • Experience generating pipeline for high-ticket B2B sales

    • MEDDIC
    • Challenger
    • Sandler

Tools & Tech

LinkedIn Sales Navigator | Apollo | ZoomInfo | Crunchbase | Outreach.io | Salesloft | HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re motivated by targets and measurable performance
  • You’re confident communicating through phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • You’re resilient and comfortable handling rejection
  • You enjoy creating opportunities from cold prospects

Your day may start by researching target accounts and building prospect lists before launching email and LinkedIn sequences.

We are seeking a Sales Operations Manager for a full time and direct hire role for one of our amazing partners in the travel & tour industry. This role is remote, but living is Southern California or at least PST time zone is preferred. You MUST be living in the United States, and you MUST be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder. This role does NOT offer sponsorship, it's NOT a consulting role, and we do NOT work with 3rd parties!

﻿

Overview:

Our client is a growing travel organization with a multi-region sales team and an expanding portfolio of products and services. They are looking for a hands-on Sales Operations Manager to strengthen the systems, processes, data, and reporting that support a growing sales organization. You will work closely with the sales leadership and regional sales leaders to improve forecasting, pipeline visibility, CRM adoption, sales reporting, account management, and overall sales execution. This is not a role focused solely on pulling reports. This is for someone who can look at a sales process, identify what's working and what's not, build a practical solution, and then work with the team to make sure it actually gets adopted. You'll partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Technology, Product, and Operations and will have significant visibility into how the sales organization operates. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how a growing sales organization operates. You will have ownership over critical sales systems and processes and play an important role in turning data into better decisions, stronger execution, and more predictable revenue.

Responsibilities:

Sales Reporting & Performance

  • Develop and maintain sales KPIs, dashboards, and performance scorecards.
  • Build reliable weekly and monthly reporting around pipeline, activity, production, forecasting, and results.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into sales performance, risks, opportunities, and follow-up items.
  • Develop account-level reporting and target lists to identify inactive accounts, overdue opportunities, and potential rebooking opportunities.
  • Support sales meetings, pipeline reviews, 1:1s, planning sessions, and other performance-management rhythms.
  • Turn sales data into actionable recommendations for Sales leadership.

CRM & Sales Process

  • Own Sales Operations processes within HubSpot, including data standards, reporting, workflows, dashboards, and adoption.
  • Maintain accurate account ownership, territories, lead routing, and account assignment information.
  • Partner with Technology to improve CRM configuration, integrations, testing, and data quality.
  • Establish processes that improve visibility from lead generation through opportunity management and conversion.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and reduce administrative work.
  • Improve CRM adoption and ensure sales teams have accurate, useful information at their fingertips.

Sales Planning & Enablement

  • Support sales campaigns through target-list development, action tracking, and performance reporting.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and Finance on territory, capacity, quota, and compensation planning.
  • Help develop and maintain sales onboarding materials, playbooks, training resources, and performance-tracking tools.
  • Lead cross-functional Sales Operations initiatives from initial concept through implementation and adoption.

In your first year, you'll help create a sales organization where:

  • Sales leadership has reliable, actionable pipeline and forecasting information.
  • Accounts and opportunities have clear ownership, status, timing, and next steps.
  • Sales performance is measured consistently across regions and individual contributors.
  • CRM data is accurate, trusted, and actively used by the sales team.
  • Sales leaders can quickly identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
  • Reporting becomes increasingly automated and less dependent on manual processes.
  • New processes are not only implemented but actually adopted by the sales organization.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting a distributed B2B sales or account-management organization.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or another major CRM, including dashboards, reporting, workflows, and data management.
  • Strong Excel skills and the ability to work confidently with large and imperfect datasets.
  • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, territory/account assignment, lead routing, and performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into clear business recommendations.
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical processes and system requirements.
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives through implementation and adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in travel, tourism, cruise, hospitality, or travel-advisor distribution.
  • Experience with affinity, dealer, franchise, channel, or relationship-based sales models.
  • HubSpot administration or certification.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, SQL, or data warehouses.
  • Experience with Softrip, TourTools, or similar travel-industry platforms.
  • Experience with EOS or another structured operating system.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. You must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

GPU Systems Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: GPU Systems Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a GPU Systems Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.
How to Apply

About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As a Pediatric Neuropsychologist, you will deliver remote virtual neuropsychological evaluations for children and young adults facing neurodevelopmental, social, and school-related challenges. Utilizing modern, technology-enabled telehealth platforms, you will focus directly on patient care, conducting virtual diagnostic assessments, interpreting standardized digital batteries, and delivering actionable feedback for families. Working alongside tele-psychometrists and a multidisciplinary care team, your evaluations will directly inform personalized treatment plans that treat the root causes of complex behavioral and cognitive profiles.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Conduct Virtual Diagnostic Evaluations: Lead 100% remote neuropsychological assessments for pediatric populations with autism spectrum profiles, ADHD, and learning differences.
  • Deliver Actionable Feedback: Conduct virtual intake interviews and interactive feedback sessions with caregivers, translating clinical data into clear, practical recommendations for families and schools.
  • Collaborate Across Specialties: Partner closely with tele-psychometrists for battery scoring and provide expert diagnostic consultation to internal therapists, prescribers, and care coordinators.
  • Maintain High-Quality Documentation: Complete thorough, timely diagnostic reports and EMR documentation adhering to clinical quality and payer standards.

What Makes You, You

  • Pediatric Diagnostic Expertise: Deep clinical experience evaluating complex neurodevelopmental and social-emotional presentations in children.
  • Telehealth & Digital Platform Savvy: Skilled in building quick rapport with children over video and navigating digital assessment tools (e.g., Q-interactive) and EMRs.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Passionate about working within an integrated, whole-child model alongside multidisciplinary clinicians.
  • Detail-Oriented & Efficient: Strong report-writing skills with a focus on timely, high-quality clinical documentation.

The Basics You’ll Need

  • Education: Ph.D. or Psy.D. in Clinical Psychology or School Psychology from an APA/CPA-accredited program.
  • Fellowship: Completion of a 2-year post-doctoral fellowship in Pediatric Neuropsychology.
  • Licensure: Active, unrestricted Psychologist license in PA, VA, NJ, MD, or commitment to obtain multi-state licensure. ABCN board certification or board eligibility is highly preferred.
  • Experience: 1+ years post-licensure experience conducting pediatric neuropsychological evaluations (telehealth testing experience preferred).
  • Workspace: Private, quiet, HIPAA-compliant home office with a high-speed, dedicated internet connection.

Compensation

  • Hourly Contract Rate: $110-$135 (Contract/1099)

Fostering an Inclusive Environment

Blackbird is committed to cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging. We celebrate unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

$110—$135 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for bringing together Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance around a common revenue strategy, consistent data, scalable processes, and clear accountability.

As INNERGY continues to scale, the VP of Revenue Operations will create the infrastructure needed to improve predictability across the entire customer lifecycle, from pipeline generation and conversion through implementation, retention, expansion, and renewal.

You will serve as a trusted partner to executive leadership, translating company strategy into revenue plans, operating rhythms, forecasts, systems, and actionable insights. The right leader will be equally comfortable presenting to executives, challenging assumptions with data, and digging into the details of a process or system when needed.

What You'll Own

Revenue Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with the CRO, CFO, CEO, and GTM leadership to translate company goals into an integrated revenue operating plan.
  • Lead annual and quarterly revenue planning, including capacity modeling, territory and coverage strategy, quota planning, productivity assumptions, and resource allocation.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and KPIs across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other revenue-generating functions.
  • Build scenario models that help leadership understand risks, opportunities, and tradeoffs before making investment decisions.
  • Create a scalable RevOps roadmap aligned with INNERGY's growth strategy.

Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence

  • Own the company's revenue forecasting methodology and operating cadence.
  • Improve forecast accuracy and provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline, bookings, retention, expansion, and revenue performance.
  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting that turn complex data into actionable insights.
  • Establish consistent definitions and a trusted source of truth for revenue metrics.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities early and drive action across the organization.

GTM Process & Execution

Systems, Data & Technology

  • Partner with Finance to ensure alignment between operational forecasts and financial planning.
  • Conduct funnel, cohort, segmentation, and performance analysis to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations and ensure insights lead to action.

Leadership & Organizational Alignment

  • Build and develop a high-performing Revenue Operations organization as the company scales.
  • Establish operating rhythms that create accountability and alignment across GTM leadership.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the executive team and functional leaders.
  • Bring structure and clarity to complex, cross-functional problems.
  • Influence effectively across functions, balancing the needs of individual teams with what's best for the overall business.
  • 10+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, Business Operations, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years leading teams and operating at a senior leadership level.
  • Significant experience within a scaling B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business.
  • Demonstrated ownership of revenue planning, forecasting, analytics, and GTM operations.
  • Experience supporting multiple GTM functions, including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and metrics, including ARR, NRR, GRR, CAC, churn, pipeline coverage, conversion, and sales productivity.
  • Experience designing scalable processes and operating models during periods of rapid growth or organizational change.
  • Strong CRM and revenue technology experience, with the ability to think beyond individual systems and design an integrated GTM architecture.
  • Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to translate data into executive-level recommendations.
  • Experience partnering directly with C-suite executives and presenting complex information in a clear, concise way.
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge assumptions constructively, influence without direct authority, and drive accountability across functions.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have established a trusted and scalable revenue operating system that gives leadership significantly greater visibility and confidence in how the business is performing.

Success will include:

  • A consistent and reliable revenue forecasting process.

  • Improved visibility into pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, and revenue performance.
  • Strong alignment between Revenue and Finance.
  • Executive dashboards that drive decisions rather than simply report activity.
