We need an ambitious, curious leader to become a Project Analyst on the Technology Team to help drive the biggest change in the company’s history.

The Opportunity – Why Join

Are you ready to redefine how an entire industry engages with customers? At AAA Life we leverage technology to put human connection at the heart of what we do. If you are someone who thrives on purpose and wants to make a tangible difference in people’s lives when it matters most, then join AAA Life who has the unique ability to access tens of millions of existing AAA customers powered by the strength of one of America’s most trusted brands. We have embarked on a mission to double in size - Becoming one of the largest providers in the US. These facts showcase why we're the right choice:

  • On purpose: a leading professional services firm found that the commitment, empathy and dedication of employees at AAA Life was the highest across a benchmark of top US companies
  • On growth: we have the privilege to offer our products to tens of millions of Americans that are proud members of AAA
  • On making a difference: we serve Americans by delivering life insurance products that make a true difference for families during their hardest times, not wealth management instruments (more details on this during the interview)
  • On culture: USA Today named us 2025 top workplace nationwide. We believe the job of an insurance company is to do good. Our mission is to help our members during what is often the hardest times in their lives. We pick up the phone to people who have lost loved ones and offer our genuine support. That is why we will always put human connection at the heart of what we do - always being there to talk to our members person to person. We believe the job of an insurance company is to pay out. That is what insurance is for. Most of our members have real life policies - policies that bring peace of mind during life, and genuine support in the event of death. We are not here to chase the super-rich with annuities and wealth management products. AAA has been one of the most trusted names in America because it believes in providing the services that middle class Americans need.

Responsibilities

The Role

You will join a small, newly formed, and highly visible Transformation Office responsible for leading the company’s most strategic, enterprise‑wide transformation initiatives. These programs are complex, mission‑critical, and backed by multi‑million‑dollar investments. As a key driver within the Transformation Office, you will translate strategy into execution—turning transformational vision into measurable outcomes and sustained business impact.

This is a high visibility Project Change Management Analyst role – serves as a central point of accountability for portfolio‑level performance, financial transparency, and delivery insight across IT initiatives. It partners closely with initiative leads, Finance, and Centers of Excellence to consolidate financial and delivery data into consistent, executive‑ready reporting, Steering Committees, and governance forums. The role ensures disciplined portfolio reporting across agile, waterfall, and hybrid efforts, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, and performance gaps to enable informed decisions, strengthen governance, and drive value realization throughout the transformation.

The Next Phase

Our mission is to provide those services for as many people as we can. To achieve that we need to evolve. We need to boldly embrace innovation and technology. Your leadership will help us deliver on our mission together and achieve our transformation. At AAA Life, empathy and progress go hand in hand, creating a culture where bright ideas flourish and meaningful impact grows. If you are drawn to an environment that values purpose as much as potential, we invite you to join us. Because here, being there for people isn’t just a promise—it is our driving force.

Position Responsibilities

  • Track and report on IT project performance, including actual vs spend, forecasted costs, delivery milestones, and KPI progress 
  • Monitor financial performance across IT initiatives, ensuring alignment with budgets, forecasts, and expected value realization 
  • Consolidate updates from Transformation Office, Initiative Leads (including Product Owners and Scrum Masters), Finance and COE Managers into executive-ready reporting 
  • Identify, analyze, and escalate delivery risks, dependencies, and performance gaps 
  • Prepare standardized metrics reports and dashboards for Steering Committee (SteerCo), Technology Leadership, and executive stakeholders to support governance and decision‑making.
  • Partner with Finance to validate financial data, including capital vs. expense spend, labor, and vendor costs 
  • Ensure consistency and integrity of reporting across the IT portfolio, including adherence to PMO standards and governance frameworks 
  • Support reporting across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies 
  • Participate in recurring forums (e.g., IT Transformation stand-ups, finance reviews) to surface insights and ensure alignment 

Core Competencies – How You Will Contribute

  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret financial and delivery data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights 
  • Financial Acumen: Understanding of IT budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking (including Capital vs. Expense and Operating Expense) 
  • Data Visualization & Reporting: Ability to create clear, concise, and executive-ready reports and dashboards 
  • Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in reporting, data validation, and reconciliation 
  • Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical and financial information into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders 
  • Stakeholder Management: Effective collaboration with IT, Finance, PMO, and business leaders 
  • Risk Awareness: Proactive identification and escalation of risks and issues 
  • Adaptability: Ability to operate in fast-paced, evolving IT and transformation environments 

Qualifications

Required Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in IT project reporting, PMO, financial analysis, or technology program support
  • 2-5 years of experience supporting IT projects or transformation initiatives in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid environments
  • 3-5 years of proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • 3-5 years of experience with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Clarity) preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience tracking IT financials, including resource costs, vendor spend, and infrastructure investments

Preferred Experience

  • Experience using Power BI and SQL analytics to track adoption, workforce readiness, and transformation KPIs, translating insights into executive‑ready reporting.
  • Proficiency with Atlassian Jira and Confluence to support agile delivery, transformation governance, and change documentation.
  • Experience with Monday.com or similar work‑management tools to coordinate cross‑functional initiatives and track transformation milestones.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for leadership communications, dashboards, and reporting.

How You’ll Work

  • Work Solution: Hybrid (Tuesday- Thursday) or Remote (USA)

What We Bring to the Table

  • Hybrid work environment that promotes work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting from your first day
  • Employer 401k match and employer contribution to a pension plan
  • Generous PTO and paid parental leave to support your family needs
  • Various associate resource groups and community involvement initiatives

Essential Job Functions 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. 

 

This job requires the ability to perform duties contained in the job description for this position, including, but not limited to, the above requirements.  Reasonable accommodation will be provided for otherwise qualified applicants as needed to enable them to fulfill these requirements. 

 

AAA Life Insurance Company does not offer immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes visa types such as H-1B, TN, and STEM OPT. Please do not apply if you currently require or may require employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

Overview

LMI is seeking a skilled Policy Specialist at a consultant level to support the United States Postal Service (USPS). The Policy Specialist will be part of an LMI team who will assess, adjudicate, and update/redraft USPS policies to eliminate unnecessary policies and streamline operations. The Policy Specialist will interface with the owner of policies (clients) and will provide recommendations to update policy and process, which includes, but is not limited to separation of policy and process, language that will clarify policy content, subject matter recommendations to improve USPS business, methods for improving policy management, ways to address gaps and risks in the policy/process, and content for elimination. The Policy Specialist will assist the Task Lead in monitoring risks, coordinating document progression, scheduling, data review as well as meeting planning and coordination in a virtual environment with USPS stakeholders. Work will include methods for improving the policy management processes. A successful Policy Specialist will be able to act as the right hand of the assigned Task Lead in facilitating team activities, shepherding forward excellent products, maintaining deadlines and requirements, and delivering high-quality outputs to the client.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and writing of policies and policy-related materials (guidance documents, standard operating procedures, etc.) to direct work processes
  • Consult closely with policy owners, stakeholders, legal experts, and labor relations specialists to draft and edit policy language
  • Facilitate productive and collegial client interactions in working group meetings and through individual communication channels
  • Support the assigned task lead with coordination, scheduling, and administrative duties
  • Support and communicate the development of policy deliverables for USPS review
  • Help the LMI team deliver excellence, including reaching program milestone achievements and assessing customer feedback
  • Support the assigned task lead with building and maintaining trusted partner relationships with USPS customer leadership
  • Coordinate and support engagement with USPS stakeholders, including steering committees and working groups, to develop roles, responsibilities, and an implementation plan for execution of work
  • Track task progress and ensure compliance with implementation plan and stakeholder expectations

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in public policy, public administration, business administration, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment, including supporting concurrent deliverables with shifting deadlines.

The Indirect Buyer is responsible for leading and managing Indirect Purchasing activities by researching, evaluating, negotiating, and analyzing as it related to the procurement of goods and services for the various group companies with FUJIFILM across North America. Processes requisitions and purchase orders with attention to policy compliance, detail and time management. Manages expenditure and capital purchase orders for MRO goods and services. Communicates with vendors and facilities leadership and provides documentation as needed.

This position must work East Coast hours Monday - Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. At Fujifilm you’ll have the opportunity to explore and grow your skills in new, exciting ways. Whether you’re shaping tomorrow’s tech or redefining today’s processes, we’ll provide a flexible work environment and dynamic culture where innovation thrives.

Our Americas HQ is nestled in Valhalla, New York, a charming town known for its excellent schools, beautiful parks, and easy access to the vibrancy of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Purchase Order Management & Processing
  • Place and manage purchase orders for one FUJIFILM Group Company within their designated ERP, including blanket purchase orders for indirect non-stock materials.
  • Process purchase orders for assigned Group Companies, with a basic understanding of processes, end users, approvers, and business requirements. Execute end-to-end purchasing processes from requisition through purchase order issuance, goods receipt, and vendor payment with regular support from leadership. Proven ability to negotiate purchase terms and conditions with supervision to achieve favorable outcomes.
  • Documentation & Compliance

jobs.title: Sr Salesforce Developer
jobs.excerpt: About DealerOn We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America.
jobs.description:
About DealerOn

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

Job Description:

The Senior Salesforce Developer is responsible for the administration, configuration, customization, and ongoing development of DealerOn's Salesforce platform. This role combines hands-on Salesforce administration with custom application development to deliver scalable business solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), and other integrated technologies.

Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and cross-functional leaders, the Senior Salesforce Developer serves as a technical leader and subject matter expert responsible for evaluating business processes, architecting and recommending scalable technical solutions, configuring declarative functionality, developing custom applications and integrations, and ensuring the Salesforce platform remains secure, performant, and maintainable. The Developer translates complex business requirements into thoughtful, sustainable technical solutions and provides technical guidance throughout the solution lifecycle, from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

The Senior Salesforce Developer partners across departments to identify opportunities to improve processes, leverage Salesforce capabilities, and drive operational efficiency. This role requires sound technical judgment in determining when to utilize declarative functionality versus custom development, with a strong focus on scalability, reusability, system architecture, data integrity, security, and minimizing technical debt. The Developer also contributes to platform governance, development standards, solution design, and the continued evolution of the Salesforce ecosystem to support current and future business needs.

This is a senior-level remote position requiring a high degree of autonomy, technical expertise, business acumen, and cross-functional collaboration.

Essential Functions:

Administration

  • Serve as a Salesforce Administrator responsible for the day-to-day health, maintenance, and optimization of the Salesforce platform.
  • Configure and maintain objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, permission sets, profiles, sharing rules, queues, public groups, and custom metadata.
  • Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role hierarchy, permissions, and security while ensuring compliance with company policies.
  • Troubleshoot user issues, investigate system errors, and provide timely resolution for Salesforce-related support requests.
  • Monitor Salesforce platform health, storage, integrations, and overall system performance.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business decision-making.
  • Evaluate new Salesforce releases and recommend features that improve business processes.
  • Maintain platform documentation including configuration changes, system architecture, and administrative procedures.

Development

  • Serve as the technical lead for complex Salesforce projects and enhancements, including breaking requirements into technical work, estimating development effort, identifying dependencies, coordinating development activities, and proactively addressing technical risks and blockers.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, SOQL, APIs, and other Salesforce technologies.
  • Build custom applications utilizing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud/CPQ.
  • Develop, manage and maintain the Salesforce code repository, development lifecycle, and version control process, including organizing and maintaining source code and metadata, building branching and merging strategies, supporting code reviews, resolving merge conflicts, and ensuring changes are properly documented, tested, and promoted across Salesforce environments.
  • Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for complex Salesforce development, architecture, integration, performance, and security issues.
  • Make recommendations and technical decisions regarding development approaches, platform architecture, tools, integrations, and technology adoption.
  • Utilize JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Web Services, and Salesforce APIs to develop and enhance business applications.
  • Investigate and resolve complex Salesforce application, automation, integration, data, and performance issues. Perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions rather than temporary fixes.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests and ensure adequate test coverage for development work.
  • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce development best practices and coding standards.
  • Analyze business requirements and determine the appropriate balance between declarative configuration and custom development.
  • Own and drive technical solution architecture for complex Salesforce initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate system architecture, data models, automation, integrations, and technical dependencies to identify risks and ensure solutions will scale with evolving business requirements.
  • Define technical standards and patterns for Salesforce development, integrations, automation, and data management.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to Salesforce administrators, developers, and other technical team members.
  • Establish and promote development standards, coding conventions, design patterns, and engineering best practices across the Salesforce environment.
  • Mentor and develop technical team members by providing guidance on architecture, solution design, development practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making.
  • Identify legacy code, inefficient automation, outdated development patterns, and architectural limitations. Develop and prioritize remediation strategies to improve the long-term health, maintainability, and scalability of the Salesforce platform.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation for custom solutions and integrations.
  • Facilitate the testing and implementation of Salesforce and JIRA tools. Includes coding, configuration, maintenance, installation, testing, and debugging, as well as managing timelines

Required Experience

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or related field or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications as a Salesforce Platform Developer I and Salesforce Administrator.
  • 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex enterprise Salesforce solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience owning technical architecture and solution design for complex Salesforce implementations or major initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience making technical recommendations and decisions that balance business requirements, platform capabilities, scalability, security, maintainability, and technical debt.
  • Experience leading development standards, code reviews, deployment practices, and technical governance within a Salesforce environment.
  • Experience designing and managing integrations between Salesforce and multiple external systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers and administrators and providing technical leadership within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from discovery and solution design through development, deployment, and post-production optimization.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including data architecture, security model, sharing, automation, integration patterns, governor limits, platform limits, and performance considerations.
  • Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and clearly articulate recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and long-term implications to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position is open to US residents only.

The targeted salary range for this position is $95,700 - $144,200.

The posted salary range for this position may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; internal pay equity; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions.

Perks and Benefits:

Aside from the awesome people you will get to interact with on a daily basis, we offer a number of benefits, including:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Company matched 401K plan
  • Flexible PTO + Sick Leave

Discover Impactful Work:


The Medical Director/Senior Medical Director provides medical oversight of clinical trials to ensure company SOPs, client directives, good clinical practice, and regulatory requirements are followed. General Support:

Adheres to client SOPs/directives and project specific WPDs for assigned projects. Adheres to PPD’s corporate policies and SOPs/WPDs.

Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary:

athenahealth is seeking a Senior Manager, Content Production to lead hands-on content creation and subject-matter ownership for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). This person will own the RCM content roadmap within the broader editorial strategy and will write the majority of RCM content, with particular emphasis on blogs and eBooks. Beyond RCM, this person will flex into related solution areas, including Value-Based Care and Payer, Interoperability, and Patient Experience, as business priorities and content needs evolve.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an accomplished healthcare technology writer who can develop deep RCM fluency, build trusted relationships with internal subject-matter experts, and translate complex topics into clear, authoritative content for a range of audiences and specialties. The role reports to the Senior Manager, Editorial Content and partners closely with Product and Portfolio Marketing, Brand, and Integrated Marketing across a highly cross-functional, matrixed organization.

About the Team:

The content team develops strategic, story-driven content aligned with audience needs, buyer journey stages, and go-to-market priorities. The team uses a newsroom-style beat model: each beat owner develops subject-matter depth, cultivates expert relationships, and takes responsibility for the quality, relevance, and ongoing development of content in that domain, while remaining adaptable enough to support adjacent beats when priorities shift.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the RCM beat and its content roadmap within the broader editorial strategy, serving as this beat's primary owner.
  • Flex into adjacent solution areas, such as Value-Based Care and Payer, Interoperability, and Patient Experience, as needed, developing working fluency quickly enough to produce credible, well-informed content on short notice.
  • Develop deep fluency in athenahealth's RCM solutions, customer needs, market context, and go-to-market priorities; become the content team's trusted RCM subject-matter owner.
  • Write athenahealth’s RCM content, with a primary focus on high-quality blogs and eBooks that support audiences across the funnel.
  • Conduct interviews, review data, and perform research to develop accurate, useful, and compelling content grounded in genuine subject-matter depth, across RCM and adjacent domains as assigned.
  • Tailor content approach and voice for a variety of audiences and specialties, including Specialties, Enterprise, Small Group, and Group segments.
  • Serve as a content consultant for related landing pages, emails, and webinars, helping partners maintain narrative consistency and editorial quality.
  • Create clear, well-scoped briefs for freelance writers when additional support is needed, and review their work for accuracy, quality, and alignment.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate stakeholder review and approval cycles across a highly matrixed, cross-functional organization, track feedback and decisions, and keep partners informed of content status and next steps.
  • Partner with Product and Portfolio Marketing, Brand, and Integrated Marketing to connect content with messaging, campaigns, and go-to-market initiatives across RCM and adjacent solution areas.
  • Apply SEO and AI search optimization practices, including AIO, LLMO, and GEO, to content planning, briefs, and execution.
  • Use performance insights supplied by reporting partners to refine topic selection, formats, and future content plans.
  • Conduct periodic audits of RCM (and, as needed, adjacent domain) content to identify gaps, overlaps, refresh opportunities, and priorities for new content
  • undefined

Expected Education & Experience:

  • 8-10 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or professional writing roles, including substantial experience creating long-form B2B content.
  • Healthcare industry experience required; direct experience with RCM strongly preferred. Familiarity with Value-Based Care and Payer, Interoperability, or Patient Experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated success operating in a highly cross-functional, stakeholder-heavy, matrixed organization, coordinating input and approvals across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex, technical, or regulated subject matter into polished, accessible content.
  • A strong portfolio that includes long-form business content such as blogs, eBooks, guides, reports, or case studies.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop genuine subject-matter expertise quickly across more than one domain, and to build productive relationships with internal experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Proven ability to flex tone, depth, and format for different audiences and specialties (e.g., Enterprise vs. Small Group, general vs. specialty-specific).
  • Working knowledge of SEO and AI search optimization practices and how they inform content planning and execution.
  • Strong judgment, organization, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and produce high-quality work in a changing environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in English, journalism, marketing, communications, or a related field.

Expected Compensation

$96,000 - $162,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Position Overview

Power Your Future with Qualus in our T&D Canada business as an Senior Engineer - Transmission Line. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, Transmission Lines, this position can be hybrid in either our Vancouver BC or Calgary AB office, or remotely in other locations in Canada. If you have a successful track record and thrive on challenges in a fast-paced environment, this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting engineering projects by creating detailed scopes and estimates, performing engineering calculations, developing detailed plan and profile design drawings, modeling using the highly specialized, custom-purpose software: PLS-CADD.
  • Supporting engineering projects by performing electrical studies that include EMF, Audible Noise, Radio Interference, Grounding, Step & Touch Potentials, AC Interference of pipelines and railways, Conductor Ampacity, Corona, Line Impedance Parameters, Fault calculations, using CDEGS and MATHCAD.
  • Preparing technical engineering reports and memos.
  • Designing structures for high voltage transmission lines using PLS-POLE and PLS-TOWER.
  • Engineering of transmission line projects from ‘definition phase’ through the ‘implementation phase’.
  • Preparing staged design review packages in accordance with client’s standards and maintaining detailed documentation of designs and calculations.
  • Undertaking in-depth analysis/studies of problems, and identifying solutions and preparing reports to support studies/recommendations.
  • Providing technical advice and guidance to design engineers.
  • Proactively monitoring project engineering schedule and managing budgets for assigned projects.
  • Providing procurement support to prepare material specifications, requisitions, scope documents, material take-off and technical evaluation of bids.
  • Providing construction support and overall project engineering coordination during installation and commissioning with the client and subcontractors.
  • Responding to information requests from site and completing project documentation including as-builts, calculations and return of data to the client.
  • Maintaining and enhancing relationships with internal groups and external contractors and clients.
  • Traveling and visiting project sites during project definition and execution.
  • Supporting the management in planning, business development, proposal, performance evaluations and appraisals.
  • Developing and implementing specifications, standards, templates and engineering tools.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Transmission, Electrical, Civil/Structural Engineering Degree from a recognized university along with a Professional Engineering Designation.
  • 10 - 15+ years of transmission line engineering experience is required.
  • Proven experience within a Transmission Utility or EPC organization designing transmission lines utilizing PLS–CADD/PLS-TOWER/PLS-POLE is required.
  • Knowledge of electrical/structural aspects of power transmission system.
  • Knowledge of transmission line materials (structures, conductors/OHSW, OPGW/ADSS, insulators, hardware accessories and fittings.
  • Direct experience on the safety aspects of the design of high voltage transmission lines.
  • Utility-specific knowledge and safety requirements.
  • Construction support experience for Transmission projects.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

jobs.description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.

Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

Sobre a oportunidade

Você é quem conecta o protótipo à produção. Vai desenhar e construir a engenharia de ML do motor de precificação — o serving de inferência, os pipelines de treino e a engenharia de features — para que modelos complexos rodem em tempo real, com baixa latência, sobre Ray. Foca na modelagem e no código de ML; a plataforma e o runtime ficam com o time de MLOps/Plataforma, com quem você trabalha lado a lado.

Seus Desafios

  • Serving de inferência —desenhar o pipeline de modelos encadeados sobre Ray Serve — composição de modelos, baixa latência e estratégias de atualização.
  • Treino distribuído —construir pipelines de treino (Ray Train/Data), HPO (Ray Tune) e modelos treinados por tenant, com checkpointing resiliente.
  • Engenharia de features —definir e materializar features no feature store (Feast/Redis), garantindo consistência entre treino e produção.
  • Otimização e RL —implementar e otimizar os componentes de otimização (programação linear) e de RL offline do pipeline de preço.
  • Qualidade do modelo —monitorar drift do ponto de vista de modelagem, validar versões e produzir explicabilidade (SHAP) — em parceria com MLOps.
  • Liderança técnica —atuar como referência, mentorar e definir, com o time, o que é viável e escalável.

Você faz o handoff com os cientistas de dados, recebe dados dos data engineers e entrega ao time de MLOps/Plataforma para deploy e operação.

Stack & Ferramentas

  • ML serving & treino:Ray (Serve, Train, Tune, Data, RLlib)
  • Registry & features:MLflow, Feast + Redis
  • Otimização:programação linear (Gurobi, HiGHS), RL offline
  • Linguagem & runtime:Python; Docker; leitura de Iceberg

O que Buscamos

Essenciais

  • Experiência comprovada colocando modelos de ML em produção.
  • Python e fundamentos sólidos de Engenharia de Software (APIs, testes, código limpo).
  • Serving e otimização de inferência para baixa latência.
  • Familiaridade com containers (Docker) e com fluxos de MLOps (registry, deploy).
  • Conforto com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code).

Diferenciais

  • Ecossistema Ray (Serve, Train, Tune, RLlib) — forte diferencial.
  • Feature stores (Feast) e serving de baixa latência com Redis em escala.
  • ﻿Otimização/solvers (Gurobi, HiGHS) ou revenue management em tempo real; RL offline.
  • Serving de IA generativa (vLLM, LiteLLM) e arquiteturas multi-tenant.

Informações adicionais

  • Trabalho Remoto
  • Tempo de Projeto:6 meses, com possibilidade de extensão/internalização.

jobs.excerpt: Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
jobs.description:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

You will own and shape how Praxis designs, governs, secures, and operates AWS at scale—from account structure and identity to the platforms and applications that run on them. You will be a hands-on builder, using your depth in cloud infrastructure and software engineering to create secure, reliable systems that enable our teams to move quickly.

You will work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. You will build and improve the systems that keep our teams moving fast while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and compliance. You will work primarily in TypeScript and Python, use modern AI tooling as part of your daily engineering workflow, and take direct accountability for production operations, including on-call.

You will be expected to see problems, take ownership, and drive them through resolution. You will move quickly through incremental, well-controlled changes, question assumptions when there is a better path, and turn operational learnings into durable improvements. Just as importantly, you will raise the bar for the people and systems around you by sharing what you know, communicating clearly, and helping the broader team build and operate better.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve AWS architecture for enterprise workloads, including multi-account foundations, landing zone / Control Tower patterns, networking, security baselines, and shared platforms.
  • Establish and continuously improve AWS governance, including organizational structure, SCPs, tagging, cost controls, compliance, audit readiness, and durable operational standards.
  • Design and operate identity and access across AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations for SSO, federation, role mapping, access reviews, and least-privilege access.
  • Build, harden, and operate AWS platforms and full-stack services using TypeScript and Python, including compute, containers, serverless, data stores, messaging, and cloud automation as needed.
  • Drive operational excellence across AWS platforms and workloads by building effective monitoring, alerting, dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, runbooks, incident response practices, and durable fixes to recurring problems; participate in the on-call rotation and own incidents through resolution and learning.
  • Automate infrastructure and delivery through Infrastructure as Code—preferably Pulumi and/or SST—and CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on safe, incremental delivery and low blast radius.
  • Partner across engineering and IT to translate needs into secure, maintainable solutions, improve production readiness and operational practices, mentor other engineers, and use sound judgment to move fast without breaking things.

Qualifications

  • Senior-level software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience building and operating production systems on AWS.
  • Strong full-stack engineering capability in TypeScript and Python, including APIs, services, tooling, and cloud automation.
  • Deep experience with core AWS services used in enterprise environments, including IAM, Organizations, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudWatch, KMS, Config, and GuardDuty.
  • Proven ability to design and operate AWS governance at scale, including multi-account strategy, policy guardrails, access control, security standards, and operational controls.
  • Strong AWS networking fundamentals, including VPNs, peering, Transit Gateway, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Experience with enterprise SSO; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) federation into AWS is strongly preferred, including SAML/OIDC, IAM Identity Center, application and role mapping, and access lifecycle practices.
  • Experience working in regulated or audit-ready environments, with strong habits around change control, evidence and traceability, least privilege, and durable controls.
  • Demonstrated operational ownership: able to establish meaningful alerts and monitors, reduce noise, improve reliability, respond to incidents, and turn operational learnings into engineering improvements.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience; Pulumi and/or SST strongly preferred. Terraform or AWS CDK experience is transferable and welcome.
  • Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Proficient with modern AI coding and productivity tools, with the judgment to validate outputs, test changes, manage risk, and maintain production quality.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$12,500—$150,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Hours: Full-time Time-Zone: U.S. Central Time (CST) or significant overlap

Terms: Independent Contractor

Compensation: $1600

Hiring Process: Application → Interview → Take-Home Assessment → CEO Interview → References & Background Check

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anavah Talent is a fast-growing U.S.-based staffing and recruiting firm that helps companies build exceptional remote teams across the Philippines, Latin America, and South Africa. We're looking for our first dedicated Operations & Finance Lead to become the operational backbone of the business.

This role owns payroll operations, contractor administration, client invoicing, HR coordination, operational reporting, and internal systems. Beyond execution, you'll help build the operational infrastructure that allows the company to scale efficiently through better documentation, automation, and process improvement.

You'll support approximately 30–50 active contractors while partnering closely with leadership, recruiters, clients, and contractors to ensure operations remain accurate, organized, and scalable.

ABOUT YOU

Do you enjoy bringing order to fast-moving environments? Are you the person who naturally creates checklists, documents processes, and finds better ways of doing things?

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing finance, operations, HR administration, and systems improvement. You take pride in accuracy, meet recurring deadlines without constant oversight, and constantly look for opportunities to reduce manual work through better processes and automation.

If you're excited about helping build the operational foundation of a growing U.S. startup, we'd love to meet you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Payroll & Finance Operations

Own and continuously improve the end-to-end payroll and finance operations function.

  • Own two monthly contractor payroll cycles using Wise
  • Review contractor timesheets, invoices, reimbursements, bonuses, deductions, and adjustments
  • Validate payroll data and investigate discrepancies before approval
  • Prepare payroll approval summaries and recommendations for leadership
  • Maintain and improve the Contractor Masterfile and payroll controls
  • Process contractor rate increases and compensation changes
  • Support month-end financial reconciliation and reporting
  • Manage Stripe subscriptions and recurring billing
  • Maintain accurate financial and operational records
  • Identify weaknesses in existing financial processes and implement stronger controls


Client Billing & Business Operations

Build reliable systems for client billing and day-to-day business operations.

  • Own preparation and reconciliation of client invoices
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies
  • Establish standardized billing workflows and controls
  • Maintain Monday.com boards, operational trackers, and business systems
  • Build reporting that gives leadership visibility into operational performance
  • Maintain organized HR, finance, and operational records
  • Coordinate recurring operational meetings and administrative workflows
  • Support leadership with cross-functional operational initiatives
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions

Contractor Operations & People Administration

Own the contractor lifecycle and create a consistent, scalable contractor experience.

  • Manage contractor onboarding and offboarding workflows
  • Maintain Independent Contractor Agreements, tax forms, background checks, and compliance documentation
  • Establish reliable contractor records and data management processes
  • Track PTO, contractor changes, compensation changes, and other lifecycle events
  • Conduct scheduled 7-, 30-, 60-, 90-day, and annual contractor check-ins
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for payroll and contractor questions
  • Coordinate contractor engagement initiatives, anniversaries, and recognition
  • Identify opportunities to improve the contractor experience and reduce administrative friction

Systems, Process Improvement & Automation

Build the operational infrastructure that allows the company to scale.

  • Audit existing processes and identify gaps, inefficiencies, and risks
  • Design and implement scalable operational workflows
  • Develop, document, and maintain SOPs
  • Create checklists, templates, trackers, and operational controls
  • Establish clear ownership and handoffs between teams
  • Build dashboards and KPI reporting
  • Standardize recurring processes across operations, finance, HR, and recruitment
  • Identify repetitive manual work suitable for automation
  • Implement automation using AI, Zapier, Make, Google Apps Script, or similar tools
  • Evaluate existing tools and recommend better systems where appropriate
  • Continuously improve processes as the company grows


Leadership & Operational Ownership

Act as a strategic operational partner to the CEO.

  • Proactively identify problems before they become operational issues
  • Bring recommendations and solutions, not just problems
  • Establish priorities and manage multiple recurring deadlines
  • Create visibility into operational risks, bottlenecks, and outstanding items
  • Partner with recruitment and leadership to improve cross-functional workflows
  • Help establish the operational standards and infrastructure required for future growth
  • Take ownership of projects from problem identification through implementation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Operations, Finance Operations, Payroll, HR Operations, Bookkeeping, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience owning operational processes independently
  • Experience supporting a U.S.-based company, startup, staffing firm, or distributed remote organization
  • Strong experience with payroll, contractor payments, client billing, financial reconciliation, or related finance operations
  • Demonstrated ability to build or improve systems and workflows, not simply follow existing processes
  • Experience creating SOPs, operational documentation, trackers, controls, or dashboards
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience using platforms such as Wise, Stripe, QuickBooks, Monday.com, or similar business systems
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience supporting contractor-based or remote-first organizations
  • Experience in a staffing, recruiting, professional services, or agency environment
  • Experience building operational systems from the ground up

  • Experience building dashboards and KPI reporting

Langate is an award-winning provider of web development services in three main categories: business, healthcare, and education. At Langate, we are passionate about crafting digital solutions that make a real impact, and we take immense pride in our strong collaboration with the U.S. market.

In addition to professional expertise, we value excellent communication skills. Collaboration and effective teamwork are the cornerstones of our success, and we believe in fostering an environment where everyone's voice is heard and valued.

About the project

You will join the team behind a large online store that sells durable medical equipment to customers across the United States, including products for people with physical and cognitive disabilities. The business is mature and high-volume, with active marketing and merchandising teams that generate a steady flow of new requests.

The platform is being modernised step by step: it is moving from a legacy Adobe ColdFusion codebase to an Angular front end with a .NET Core back end. The customer-facing storefront went live on the new stack in early September. The admin area and several internal modules that cover inventory, supplier and service workflows are still on the old technology and will be migrated next, alongside new features requested by the business.

Much of the existing logic is custom-built and only partly documented, so a meaningful part of the work is reconstructing how the current system behaves and turning that into requirements the team can build against.

What you will do

  • Gather high-level business requests from client stakeholders and turn them into clear, buildable requirements for the development team.

  • Run feature kick-off and clarification calls with the client two to three times per week, prepare the questions in advance and follow up until the open points are closed.

  • Investigate how existing functionality works, form and validate assumptions with stakeholders, and document the behaviour that has never been written down.

  • Write well-structured user stories, functional descriptions and acceptance criteria, following the team's established documentation standards, and keep them current as decisions change.

  • Walk the development and QA team through each feature, stay available during implementation and confirm that what was delivered answers the original business need.

  • Analyse edge cases, dependencies and cross-module impact before development starts, and challenge requests that are unclear, contradictory or unlikely to deliver the expected value.

  • Create basic wireframes and UI mockups to illustrate feature concepts and support developer hand-off.

  • Support QA by reviewing test scenarios against the documented acceptance criteria.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Business Analyst on software development projects.

  • Strong requirements analysis and documentation skills: the ability to translate vague business needs into clear, structured specifications, including functional and non-functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Proven ability to work independently with stakeholders: you dig into a vague request, ask the uncomfortable questions and keep going until the real need is clear.

  • Strong attention to detail, including edge cases, permissions, validation rules and alternative flows.

  • Strong command of English at B2 level or above. Written documentation is the primary deliverable, and stakeholder communication is daily.

  • Strong proficiency with generative AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) for accelerating documentation, analysis and research tasks.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology and with tools such as Azure DevOps and Confluence; basic wireframing skills in Figma, Balsamiq or similar.

Nice to have

  • Experience with e-commerce platforms, checkout flows or digital retail is a strong plus.

  • Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) or to admin and back-office systems is a plus. The audience of the store includes people with disabilities, so accessibility is treated seriously; this knowledge can also be built up on the project.

  • Experience on projects that migrate a legacy system to a modern stack.

  • Experience documenting reports and back-end logic is a plus.

Team

You will be part of a collaborative, cross-functional team that includes four developers, two QA Engineers with automation expertise, a Project Manager, and two Business Analysts. The development team includes dedicated Front-End and Back-End Engineers.

You will also work directly with the client’s Software Director and in-house Business Analyst, with regular opportunities to collaborate with Marketing, Merchandising, and other business teams.

Schedule

Full-time, remote, 40 hours per week, 5/2. The start of the day is flexible; the working day is planned so that it overlaps with the client in the US Eastern time zone, with calls typically taking place in the afternoon and early evening Kyiv time.

Hiring process

Interview with the recruiter, then one joint interview with the project manager and the current business analyst (about 1.5 hours, including practical cases). No test assignment and no separate client interview.

We offer

  • B2B contract, paid sick leave and 20 days of paid vacation

  • Official Ukrainian holidays are non-working days

  • Flexible work schedule and remote work

  • Free English lessons, paid courses and certifications

  • Career development plan and mentoring

  • Coach and psychologist consultations, workshops

  • Medical health insurance

Why this role is worth your attention

This is a large, living product with real growth ambitions, and the analyst sees all of its levels: from the storefront a customer uses to the internal processes that keep orders, suppliers and service moving. There is a substantial backlog and a clear modernisation roadmap, so the work is varied rather than repetitive.
The client is reasonable and collaborative, meetings are scheduled around the team, and the analyst's opinion genuinely influences what gets built. The role suits someone who prefers to shape the solution rather than pass requirements along, and who is comfortable taking ownership of a domain over time.

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionNetImpact Strategies is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to provide hands-on platform engineering for a Federal Agency.
jobs.description:
Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to provide hands-on platform engineering for a Federal Agency. This role delivers complex remediation, integrations, automation, scripting, scoped applications, and approved platform enhancements while providing early-window Tier 3 engineering support and protecting upgradeability through reusable, well-tested ServiceNow-native solutions.

Work schedule: Monday-Friday, representative early engineering shift supporting the start of the 6:00 a.m.-2:30 p.m. Eastern service window; planned after-hours activities and rotating on-call support as required.

This position requires U.S. citizenship and a post-award Government background investigation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain ServiceNow platform capabilities from approved user stories and technical designs using governed SDLC and Agile practices.
  • Perform complex Tier 3 remediation and root-cause analysis for application logic, scripts, failed automations, performance issues, integrations, and defects in production-supported capabilities.
  • Develop server- and client-side ServiceNow logic using JavaScript/Glide APIs, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and other approved platform capabilities.
  • Design and implement reusable enterprise integrations and supporting application logic using REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, integration actions, service accounts, certificates/credentials, and approved error-handling/observability patterns.
  • Build scoped/low-code applications, catalog items, workflows, portals/workspaces, and reusable components while minimizing unnecessary custom code and preserving upgradeability.
  • Use source control, update sets/application repositories, CI/CD, code scanning, debugging/profiling, and automated tests to validate changes and retain technical evidence for release decisions.
  • Partner with the CTA on design/code reviews and with the Tester on ATF/regression coverage, performance validation, rollback readiness, and post-deployment verification.
  • Provide early-window engineering depth during incidents and releases, enabling operational restoration to continue while code/configuration causes are isolated and remediated.
  • Support platform security remediation, data-quality improvements, Health Scan/technical-debt actions, and restoration of unnecessary customization toward out-of-the-box patterns when approved.
  • Maintain technical documentation, code comments, release notes, knowledge articles, and transition materials sufficient for another qualified engineer to operate and maintain delivered capabilities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Certifications

  • Five or more years of ServiceNow development experience in enterprise environments.
  • Strong ServiceNow JavaScript/Glide development skills and experience with Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, ACLs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, scoped applications, catalog/workflow development, and ServiceNow APIs.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP, MID Servers, OAuth/service accounts, and reusable integration patterns.
  • Experience with source control, CI/CD, code scanning, ATF or other automated testing, debugging/profiling, and governed release promotion.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Application Developer (CAD); relevant CIS certification strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of ServiceNow performance, security, upgradeability, data modeling, and technical-debt considerations.
  • Ability to support the assigned early engineering window and planned after-hours/on-call events.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background-investigation and sensitive-information requirements.

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

  • Federal consulting or financial-regulatory experience.
  • Experience with App Engine Studio, UI Builder/Workspace, ITOM/CMDB, SPM, Performance Analytics, or SecOps capabilities.
  • Experience modernizing custom ServiceNow solutions toward reusable out-of-the-box platform patterns.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $125,000-145,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

ABOUT US

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTE

NetImpact Strategies is committed to complying with all applicable provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended (“ADA”), and applicable state and local laws. It is NetImpact’s policy not to discriminate against any qualified person or applicant with regard to any terms or conditions of employment on the basis of such individual’s disability. Consistent with this policy of non-discrimination, NetImpact will provide reasonable accommodations to an individual with a disability, as defined in the ADA or applicable law, who has made NetImpact aware of his/her disability, unless doing so would cause undue hardship to NetImpact.
