jobs.title: Staff Enterprise Architect
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Enterprise Architect, you will design and evolve how GitLab's internal systems are configured, integrate, perform and scale to support a rapidly growing business. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Architecture and AI Intelligent Automation, you will apply all four architecture lenses (business, application, data, and technology) to the systems in your scope, treating AI as a standing consideration inside each rather than a separate workstream.

Enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio direction, and standards ownership sit with the Director. Your job is depth: turning that direction into designs detailed enough to build, and being the person trusted with the hardest technical problems in the enterprise. You will not manage people. You will lead through architecture, as the partner to our Applications engineering teams and to Integration, RPA, and Intelligent Automation, and as a reviewer on the Architecture Review Board, where the aim is to make architecture an enabler rather than a gate.

What you'll do

Business architecture

  • In collaboration with product management and process owners, map the current-state processes and capabilities supported by the systems in your scope, tying each capability to its supporting systems, owners, and systems of record, and identify and resolve where those systems create friction, manual handoffs, or duplicated work, including handoffs an AI agent could remove entirely.
  • Architect end-to-end processes that span front-office and back-office systems, including new product introduction, CPQ and quote-to-cash, billing and revenue recognition, renewals, and record-to-report, together with the customer service processes that run alongside them, including case and escalation management, entitlements, and service level commitments, rather than optimizing any one system in isolation.
  • Redesign workflows before automating them, so we aren't encoding broken processes into new tooling. For each step, decide what an AI agent should handle, what deterministic automation should handle, and what stays with a person.

Application architecture

  • In collaboration with the Applications engineering teams, serve as their embedded architect, producing high level designs and patterns for changes to Salesforce, NetSuite, Zuora, Zendesk, and other core platforms. Favor configuration and supported extension patterns over customization, evaluate each platform's native AI before anything bespoke is built, and keep system roadmaps aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Design for maintainability and supportability: clear service ownership, observability and error handling in integrations, documented runbooks, and realistic total cost of ownership.
  • Go deep on the platforms in your scope, staying current on release notes, published limits, API behavior, and known constraints, so designs account for what the platform will actually do rather than what the documentation promises.
  • Govern application change by reviewing significant build proposals, data model changes, and third-party package additions before they are committed, giving teams a clear and timely decision, and keeping platforms on supported versions and ready to upgrade.
  • In collaboration with each domain's technical lead, or the vendor where that is the better source, run quarterly health checks on Salesforce, NetSuite, Zuora, Zendesk, and Workato, measuring customization footprint against each platform's published ceilings for API and governor limits, automation, storage, transaction and ticket volumes, AI consumption, and licenses. Publish a report card showing headroom, what is trending toward a limit, and who owns the fix.

Data architecture

  • Architect data flows across operational and analytical planes, including the retrieval and grounding patterns that make enterprise data usable by AI, alongside API-first integrations, event-driven patterns, batch pipelines, data warehouse models, and reverse ETL back into business systems.
  • Design data access and handling patterns that meet privacy, residency, and SOX requirements, setting explicit boundaries on what AI models and agents may read, retain, or act on, plus field-level controls for sensitive customer and financial data.
  • Establish integration and data contracts between systems, so downstream consumers aren't adversely affected by upstream schema changes.

Technology architecture

  • Define platform and integration patterns for the systems in your scope, spanning iPaaS (Workato), identity and access management, secrets handling, and the cloud services those systems depend on. Define how each system exposes its capability to AI agents, through APIs, tool interfaces, and scoped permissions.
  • In collaboration with Infrastructure, design for reliability and scale, covering environment strategy, sandbox and test data management, and non-functional requirements, while CI/CD and disaster recovery remain theirs to own.
  • In collaboration with Security, design authentication, authorization, and service-to-service access for the systems in your scope, applying the standards they and the Director set.
  • In collaboration with the enterprise AI team, recommend, use case by use case, whether a need is best served by domain-specific AI embedded in a business application or by a shared enterprise AI capability, applying their decision and model governance framework, and assemble the evidence each recommendation rests on: data access and sensitivity, reuse across functions, and cost.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud and platform consumption, covering right-sizing, license and API-limit management, and eliminating spend on unused or duplicated capacity.

Across all four domains

  • Produce the designs teams build from: target-state architectures, decision records, reference patterns, and high level designs for major projects and significant platform changes. Specify them in enough detail to build against: data models, field-level mappings, error and retry behavior, failure modes, and how AI output is evaluated where a design uses it. Every design must satisfy SOX, internal control, and security requirements.
  • Co-author those designs with engineering teams and stay with them through build, making the call on trade-offs, resolving ambiguity in the spec, and unblocking decisions so delivery doesn't stall.
  • Take the hardest technical problems in your domains personally, building proofs of concept when a decision cannot be settled on paper, including the production issues no one else has been able to root-cause.
  • Collaborate very closely with adjacent technology teams, including Data, Security, and Infrastructure, so that architecture is thought through end to end and serves the whole enterprise rather than one function at a time.
  • Maintain a prioritized inventory of technical debt across your domains and drive it down by attaching remediation to funded projects, upgrades, and migrations already touching that surface. Root-cause production defects rather than clearing them, fixing the design so the same class of defect stops recurring.

What you'll bring

  • Deep expertise in application architecture and data architecture, with working fluency in business process and technology architecture, AI as a working lens across all four, and the judgment to know which lens a given problem needs.
  • Strong hands-on background in integration, automation, and applied AI, including retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and agent orchestration on a platform such as Claude, plus the evaluation and guardrails that make them safe to deploy, the judgment to know where AI belongs and where it does not, and fluency using AI in your own daily work, including AI-assisted development, rather than only designing it for others.
  • Hands-on experience architecting core business systems, including ERP, CRM, CPQ, billing, financial, and customer service platforms, with the discipline to keep them standard, upgradeable, and SOX-compliant, plus fluency in the processes that cross them, from quote-to-cash through record-to-report.
  • Expert-level knowledge of data modeling, integration architecture patterns, and API design for enterprise systems, plus practical experience with data warehouse technologies and ELT, ETL and reverse ETL pipelines, across operational and analytical use cases.
  • Depth in iPaaS tooling and the operational realities of running integrations in production, including cost and consumption optimization, plus working knowledge of the cloud platforms those integrations run on.
  • A track record of driving architectural change through influence rather than authority: designs that survived implementation, standards adopted on platforms owned by other teams, a clear technical position held in review forums without losing the partnership, and trade-offs explained in plain business language to Director and VP stakeholders, in writing and async.

About the team

The Enterprise Architecture team at GitLab designs, governs, and evolves the internal technology landscape that powers our business. We build with Claude across our enterprise systems, from agent-assisted workflows in our core platforms to the tooling our own team uses daily. We set architecture direction for the Applications, Integration, and RPA teams: how core systems connect, where automation belongs in a business process, and the standards every build is held to for scale, security, and SOX compliance. We partner early in the cycle with product management, engineering teams, and system owners in Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations, and we collaborate very closely with the Data, Security, and Infrastructure teams. Together we ensure our architecture enables speed and quality for the rest of the enterprise. For more on how we work, see the Enterprise Applications Team Handbook Page.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

jobs.excerpt: The PLH Virtual Senior Medical Lead position is responsible for being a clinical leader in the organization in terms of clinical mentorship, capacity to train new providers, and being the champion for PLH policy and procedures.
jobs.description:
The PLH Virtual Senior Medical Lead position is responsible for being a clinical leader in the organization in terms of clinical mentorship, capacity to train new providers, and being the champion for PLH policy and procedures. A person in this position would exemplify a commitment to the PLH mission and values, an understanding of the importance of championing new and established policies and procedures working closely with the Director of Compliance to introduce new policies. The position requires a willingness to be collaborative, positive, and solutions-based as a leader to the Medical Leads and partner to the Medical Directors.

The senior lead position includes being part of the PLH clinical pool which requires the provider to be accessible to fellow providers to discuss and process clinical issues that can arise through the day. The senior lead virtual position can include leading the virtual (GVR team) with day to day responsibilities, keeping the glossary up to date with partnerships, keeping track of day to day operations in GVR to keep wait times low and patients being seen in an adequate time frame in compliance with PLH mission.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets all the above PLH medical provider expectations and PLH medical lead expectations.
  • Serves as an advanced clinical resource and mentor to PLH medical providers, providing guidance related to clinical care, documentation standards, workflows, and adherence to PLH expectations.
  • Facilitates the clinical championing of the online glossary, providing continuous updates and collaboration with the outreach team to guide all clinical providers.
  • Acts as a lead virtual trainer and clinical support resource for new PLH medical providers, including clinical onboarding, orientation, workflow education, documentation expectations, and ongoing development support.
  • Provides coaching, mentorship, and constructive feedback to providers related to clinical practice, documentation quality, compliance expectations, and organizational standards.
  • Performs provider/chart reviews and co-signing responsibilities as assigned and appropriate.
  • Promotes adherence to PLH Clinical and Administrative Policies and assists in updating and communicating clinical pearls, best practices, and workflow improvements.
  • Assists with the development, review, and improvement of clinical protocols, policies, and procedures in collaboration with Medical Directors and the Director of Compliance.
  • Works closely with the Director of Compliance to support compliance initiatives, audit readiness, documentation standards, and quality improvement efforts.
  • Serves as a point of contact for clinical compliance needs and quality improvement efforts, supporting communication between patient care teams and administration.
  • Reviews clinical quality trends and assists in identifying opportunities for improvement on workflows.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by PLH Clinical Leadership.

Qualifications:

Must be mostly a virtual provider and not solely in house to support provider training, mentorship, and clinical development online.

  • Must have served as a PLH Medical Lead for a minimum of one year.
  • Must consistently meet Medical Lead productivity and performance expectations.
  • Demonstrated excellence in clinical documentation, compliance standards, and quality patient care.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide clinical mentorship, coaching, and constructive feedback to other providers.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to partner effectively with providers, Medical Directors, Compliance, and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to PLH mission, values, patient-centered care, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to identify challenges, provide solutions, and support implementation of organizational initiatives.

Job Breakdown:

The Senior Medical Lead is a Full Time (40 hours per week), exempt salary position that includes maintaining clinical provider responsibilities and productivity expectations while dedicating designated administrative time to leadership responsibilities.

Administrative responsibilities may include provider mentorship, chart reviews, training support, compliance initiatives, clinical quality improvement projects, EHR support, and policy/procedure implementation.

Clinical hours will be scheduled based on organizational needs. Administrative hours will be a minimum of four (4) hours per month or additional time as approved by the Medical Director, Director of Compliance, and Executive Team based on clinical business needs.

The Senior Medical Lead role provides clinical leadership and support to the organization but does not replace or assume the responsibilities of the Medical Director or Director of compliance roles.

Salary: Standard Promotion opportunity 1-3% increase of base salary

jobs.title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Sênior
jobs.excerpt: A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.
jobs.description:
A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.

Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, , Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades:

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

jobs.excerpt: Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives.
jobs.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

Job Title: Product Expert – Veeva RIM Submissions, Archive, and Publishing

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with real-world life science industry experience in Regulatory Operations or Regulatory Affairs to drive customer success with our Veeva Regulatory Information Management (RIM) products in Europe. If you are a person who has a blend of experience building regulatory submissions and understanding of the key technical product features behind these processes, then this could be the role for you!
Product Experts play a key role in the product organization, supporting software product managers specialising in Submissions, Submissions Archive and Publishing applications. You will advocate the voice of the customer by creating problem statements, using a blend of your industry knowledge, experience with European/ ROW regulations, and an understanding of real need behind the ask, to help shape the product roadmap for Submissions, Submissions Archive, and Publishing. Product Experts build strong relationships within the Veeva RIM community, lead educational campaigns, create content to showcase Veeva RIM, and represent the product organization in online communities, customer meetings and at industry events.
This role is ideal for someone passionate about RIM processes, eager to collaborate with customers from end users to executives, and excited to drive their success. You should have the skills and personal characteristics to work with autonomy, proactiveness and drive – demonstrating the ability to succeed where there is ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Do

    • Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva RIM products, especially focused on the Veeva Submissions, Submissions Archive and Publishing use cases and associated features.
    • Stay up to date with the latest features and roadmap direction and be able to communicate the future roadmap vision.
    • Provide education for Veeva RIM customers in our Customer Communities and a range of forums. Product experts are key in communicating the value of our products, the customer business problems we are solving and presenting product functionality.
    • Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate product roadmap and vision.
    • Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva RIM product suite.
    • Be the customer advocate for future product innovations. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback into problem statements, identifying the needs of the customer, feeding these insights into roadmap strategy and release planning.
    • Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.
    • Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

Requirements

    • 3+ years within the regulatory industry for life sciences in Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related areas. Note that typical candidates will often come from Submission Publishing, Submission Managers, Regulatory Affairs Consultants and Specialists.
    • 3+ years of experience working in consulting, solution consulting, support, or business liaison roles.
    • Experience in using and/or implementing RIM applications and processes including substantial experience working with document management, submission building, publishing, and archiving electronic submissions.
    • Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to problem statements that clearly identify the needs of the customer – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to understand technical specifications and software development documentation and translate them to end users and business teams.
    • Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote.
    • Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
    • Self-directed team player with a positive attitude.
    • Willingness to travel up to 15%, including travel to the USA.
    • Based in Europe (with ability to work across time zones).

Nice to Have

    • Veeva Product experience
    • Fluency in another European language
    • Experience performing software demonstrations and creating engaging videos

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Income Tax Manager to support our U.S. corporate income tax compliance and quarterly and annual tax accounting processes.

In this role, you will manage the ASC 740 tax provision process, oversee federal and multistate income tax compliance, and contribute to the continued growth and scalability of our tax function as our technology footprint expands.   • Monitor and analyze federal, state, and local tax legislation and assess its potential impact on the company, including modeling the effects of proposed legislation.
  • Prepare and review Earnings and Profits (E&P) calculations, tax basis balance sheets, income tax payable proofs, and related analyses.
  • Manage foreign subsidiary return-to-provision reconciliations, including tax basis balance sheets and income tax payable proofs.
  • Prepare and review tax account reconciliations, return-to-provision analyses, and other tax provision support schedules.
  • Manage research tax credit calculations and documentation projects in partnership with third-party tax advisors and internal R&D teams.
  • Support tax audits, assessments, and related information requests.
  • Conduct tax research and analysis on matters affecting the company, including mergers and acquisitions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve tax processes, systems, and controls as the business and technology environment evolves.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of combined corporate tax and/or public accounting experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Taxation, or a related business field.
  • Significant experience with ASC 740, including valuation allowances, tax basis balance sheets, income tax payable proofs, and related technical accounting matters.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. corporate income tax compliance and the tax considerations affecting multinational corporate groups, including NCTI, foreign tax credit limitations, repatriation, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance and other teams across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Taxation or Accounting.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation.

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with Alteryx or similar data analytics tools.

Location Designation: Fully Remote

OGC, Group Benefit Solutions Counsel, Absence Management

Office of the General Counsel | New York Life

Work Arrangement

Fully Remote

Relocation Assistance: Relocation assistance is not available for this opportunity.

About the Office of the General Counsel

Join the Office of the General Counsel where we collaborate with diverse business units, providing effective and creative legal guidance that aligns with New York Life's core values. Your work directly impacts how the company makes decisions, fostering sound business practices, safeguarding its reputation and optimizing efficiency. Become part of a team dedicated to serving as a trusted partner, helping the business navigate the legal landscape and achieve its goals.

Role Overview:

New York Life's Office of the General Counsel (OGC) is seeking an experienced attorney to serve as a key legal partner to the Group Benefit Solutions, Absence Management business.

In this role, you will provide strategic, practical legal advice regarding the development, implementation, administration, sale, and ongoing enhancement of New York Life's absence management and leave administration solutions, statutory disability and paid family and medical leave offerings, workplace accommodation services, and related group insurance and service offerings.

You will work closely with leaders and subject matter experts across Product, Operations, Claims, Distribution, Compliance, Government Affairs, Risk, Technology, and other functions to evaluate complex and evolving legal requirements, translate those requirements into practical business and operational guidance, and help the business make informed decisions that appropriately balance legal and regulatory risk with business objectives.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic area shaped by a rapidly evolving landscape of federal, state, and local leave, disability, accommodation, employee benefits, and insurance laws.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as a principal legal resource to the Group Benefit Solutions Absence Management business on legal and regulatory matters affecting leave administration, statutory disability and paid family and medical leave programs, workplace accommodations, and related products and services.
  • Advise on the full lifecycle of Absence Management products and services, including product strategy and design, development of new capabilities, implementation, administration, Distribution and marketing, client arrangements, and ongoing product and operational enhancements.
  • Analyze complex federal, state, and local legal and regulatory requirements affecting Absence Management offerings and translate those requirements into practical product, administrative, and operational guidance.
  • Monitor and assess legislative, regulatory, and other legal developments and partner with Product, Operations, Claims, Distribution Compliance, Government Affairs, and other stakeholders to evaluate their impact and implement appropriate changes to products, services, processes, and business practices.
  • Provide risk-based legal advice to business leaders, clearly identifying legal and regulatory risks, areas of uncertainty, available options, and potential mitigants to support informed business decision-making.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to address complex operational and client issues involving leave administration, statutory disability, workplace accommodations, and related services and to develop practical, scalable solutions.
  • Review, draft, and negotiate client agreements and other arrangements relating to Absence Management products and services, and help develop and maintain contract provisions, templates, guidance, and playbooks that promote consistency and efficient legal support.
  • Advise, in coordination with other subject matter experts within the Office of the General Counsel, on related issues involving ERISA, group insurance regulation, employment law, privacy and data use, technology, and other areas relevant to the Absence Management business.
  • Support the development and launch of new products, services, and capabilities and provide legal guidance regarding associated client communications, marketing materials, implementation approaches, and operating models.
  • Build strong relationships with business leaders and other partners and serve as a practical, solutions-oriented legal advisor who understands both the legal environment and the business's strategic and operational objectives.
  • Lead or participate in initiatives to improve legal-service delivery, develop scalable guidance and tools, and enhance legal and business processes.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an ABA-accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one state bar.
  • Five or more years of relevant legal experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, insurance company, employee benefits organization, absence management provider, or comparable environment.
  • Meaningful experience advising on absence management, employee leave, workplace accommodations, employee benefits, employment law, or a closely related area, including experience with FMLA, ADA, PWFA, and state paid family medical leave programs. s,.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex and evolving legal requirements and translate them into clear, practical advice for product, operational, and business teams.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to identify and communicate legal risk in a manner that enables business leaders to make informed decisions.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills, including the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to operational professionals, product teams, business leaders, senior executives, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions, manage multiple priorities, exercise sound legal judgment, and develop pragmatic solutions to complex legal and business issues.
  • Strong commercial contracting skills, including experience drafting and negotiating client agreements and developing contract templates or playbooks.
  • Knowledge of laws and regulations affecting leave and absence management products and services, including federal and state leave requirements, statutory disability and paid leave programs, workplace accommodation requirements.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience advising an insurer, employee benefits organization, third-party administrator, or other provider of absence management or leave administration services.
  • Knowledge of ERISA and insurance regulation.
  • Experience supporting group insurance or employee benefits products and services.
  • Experience advising on product development, implementation, or regulatory-change initiatives involving technology-enabled administrative services.
  • Experience working with Product, Operations, Claims, Distribution, Compliance, Government Affairs, Risk, Privacy, Technology, or other cross-functional partners.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $166,500-$238,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, performance, and team leadership. You’ll oversee Paid Media, Marketing Operations, and Strategy, ensuring alignment, accountability, and results across the full marketing funnel. If you’re someone who can step back to define strategy and dive deep to drive execution, and you care deeply about measurable impact, this role is for you.

*Candidates must live in California, Colorado, Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, or Washington.

Why should you choose Etna?

  • We live our values
  • Flexible and remote work culture that supports work / life balance
  • Progressive paid time off system where taking vacations and time off is encouraged
  • Our people
  • Everyone’s favorite part of working here is the people they work with

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams by mentoring Directors and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

  • Ensure strong marketing operations performance, driving efficiency, scalability, and effective execution across all client programs
  • Guide the evolution of agency products and operational protocols, adapting to new technologies and advancing performance marketing capabilities

  • Contribute to revenue growth and forecasting by aligning performance outcomes with business targets and identifying expansion opportunities

  • 5+ years of leadership experience within a digital marketing agency, with a hands-on approach to guiding teams and outcomes

We have a special interest in finding candidates with excellent organization and communication skills. While a strong skill set and innate intelligence will get you in the door, a kind personality, and the ability to fit in with our team here at Etna are necessary traits of a successful applicant.

Job Title:Licensed Therapist/Counselor

Employment Type: W-2 Full-Time 25-30 client hours/week

Location: Remote (U.S.)

About Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM)

Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM) is a fast-growing, fully remote mental health practice dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based care to youth and families across multiple states. Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.

We’re building a culture that is mission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.

Why Join VPM

At VPM, you’ll be part of a team transforming access to youth mental health through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.

What you can expect:

  • Mission-Driven Impact: Contribute to meaningful work improving access and outcomes for youth and families.
  • Remote by Design: Fully remote environment with clear expectations and supportive infrastructure.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, empathy, and shared learning.
  • Growth & Leadership Pathways: Opportunities to expand scope and take on leadership or consulting responsibilities as we scale.
  • Professional Development: Access to training, resources, and continued learning opportunities aligned to role scope.
  • State & School-Based Partnerships: Join initiatives that strengthen school-based mental health delivery and expand access across communities.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

We are seeking compassionate, skilled clinicians who are:

  • Deeply passionate about improving youth mental health outcomes
  • Comfortable working in a virtual care environment
  • Committed to collaboration, clinical excellence, and measurable results

Key responsibilities include but limited to:

Direct Client Care

  • Deliver individual tele-therapy sessions for K–12 students referred by participating schools
  • Utilize short-term, evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT, and solution-focused therapy
  • Address a range of concerns including anxiety, grief, trauma, academic stress, and family or peer conflict
  • Provide services to diverse student populations, including multilingual learners and those without insurance

Collaboration & Communication

  • Coordinate with school counselors, family resource managers, and administrative teams
  • Engage in family outreach when appropriate to promote continuity of care
  • Participate in case consultations, supervision, and ongoing professional development
  • Maintain responsive and professional communication with both school and internal VPM partners

Documentation & Compliance

  • Complete all clinical documentation (intake, progress, and discharge notes) within 48 hours
  • Ensure compliance with all licensure board requirements, HIPAA, FERPA, and program-specific standards
  • Contribute to quarterly outcomes reporting through standardized metrics and case summaries

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Preferred Experience:

Licensure

  • Licensed in Virginia as LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent

Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of clinical experience
  • Prior experience in therapy, community mental health, or tele-health preferred
  • Experience with trauma-informed care and crisis response a plus

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in evidence-based interventions (CBT, DBT, solution-focused, narrative therapy)
  • Strong time management, organization, and documentation skills
  • Commitment to culturally responsive, strengths-based, and trauma-informed care
  • Self-directed with strong virtual presence and professionalism in remote settings

Professional Communication & Attendance (Essential Function)

Reliable communication and attendance are essential job responsibilities. Team members must:

  • Attend required onboarding, internal meetings, supervision sessions, and trainings (as applicable)
  • Notify the team as soon as possible regarding delays, absences, or scheduling conflicts
  • Maintain timely, professional communication during scheduled work hours
  • Uphold remote-work standards, including a private workspace and reliable internet connection

Remote Work Requirements

To support client confidentiality and team effectiveness, this role requires:

  • A private, quiet workspace suitable for professional work
  • Reliable high-speed internet and ability to use required systems/tools
  • Comfort working independently while staying connected through remote collaboration

Tools & Systems

This role uses the following tools as part of day-to-day work:

  • BambooHR (HRIS + onboarding)
  • EnGuard (secure email)
  • ClickUp (project + task management)
  • SimplePractice (EHR/telehealth + documentation, as applicable)

Paneled (Highly Preferred)

Benefits & Time Off (W-2 Eligible Roles)

VPM supports your well-being with benefits designed for health, stability, and real work-life balance.

  • Health, Dental & Vision: Company-sponsored plans available, with an employer contribution for eligible full-time employees.

If you require accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or perform essential job functions, please contact HR at to request assistance. All accommodation requests are handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. If qualified for a role, our talent acquisition team will contact you. Please only reach out if accommodation with the application/interviewing process is required.

Employment Eligibility & Compliance: All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, verification of licensure (as applicable), and eligibility to work in the United States without company-sponsorship. Location: US (Remote)

Who are we?

Incubeta is a global marketing partner helping ambitious brands drive profitable growth. We bring media, creative, data, and technology together into one integrated solution, working with CMOs and senior business leaders who want clarity, accountability, and measurable business impact.

In the Americas, we are entering an important growth phase. We already have strong capability, proven solutions, and differentiated intellectual property in place. What we are building now is greater enterprise momentum.

To accelerate that trajectory, we are hiring a Principal, Enterprise Growth to drive enterprise pipeline creation and new client acquisition at scale across North America. This is a leadership-level individual contributor role focused on one core outcome: getting Incubeta in the room, opening new revenue streams, and converting complex enterprise opportunity into sustained growth.

This is not a traditional sales management position. It is a mandate to build senior-level access, shape high-value commercial opportunities, and establish Incubeta as a credible growth partner for large, complex organisations.

We are looking for someone who can create real market pull, operate confidently at C-suite level, and translate our integrated capabilities into compelling commercial opportunities.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role with a singular mandate: generate and convert enterprise-level new client revenue at scale.

You will own North America net new revenue performance and personally drive the enterprise pipeline required to achieve it. This is not a role for someone who waits for RFPs to appear. It is a senior revenue operator role focused on high-value opportunity creation, strategic pursuit, and commercial conversion.

Your remit includes:

  • Owning annual net new revenue targets exceeding $10M and maintaining disciplined oversight of pipeline health, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and conversion quality.
  • Personally originating, qualifying, and advancing complex enterprise opportunities from first conversation through contract execution.
  • Building senior-level access with CMOs, Chief Marketing Officers, senior marketing leaders, transformation stakeholders, procurement leaders, consultants, and executive buyers.
  • Securing and leading C-suite discussions that uncover strategic business priorities and position Incubeta as a credible growth partner.
  • Using your understanding of media agency and media AOR buying processes to influence opportunities early, shape the brief, and position Incubeta before an RFP is issued.
  • Building relationships across the new business consultancy, pitch consultant, agency search, and media intermediary ecosystem.
  • Structuring and negotiating high-value agreements, including scope architecture, pricing strategy, performance metrics, procurement, and legal terms.
  • Navigating complex procurement, legal, and executive decision-making processes with commercial confidence and persistence.
  • Building a focused territory and account-based pursuit strategy across North America.
  • Positioning Incubeta’s integrated media, creative, data, and technology capabilities around clear client outcomes rather than isolated services.
  • Developing compelling value propositions, pursuit strategies, proposals, and executive presentations for complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Partnering closely with the broader sales, marketing, strategy, media, creative, data, technology, and delivery teams to ensure alignment and coordinated pursuit strategy.
  • Working alongside Finance to protect margin integrity while driving ambitious revenue growth.
  • Leveraging existing infrastructure, including HubSpot, internal sales processes, and SDR/outbound support, without becoming dependent on it.
  • Maintaining strong CRM discipline across qualification, opportunity stages, next steps, close plans, forecasting, and commercial documentation.
  • Travelling across North America as needed to build relationships, progress opportunities, and strengthen market presence.

This role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently, thrives in enterprise selling environments, and can create immediate market momentum without relying on large internal infrastructure.

What you need to be successful

This role requires proven enterprise credibility, strong commercial discipline, and the ability to create opportunity through influence, access, and persistence.

To succeed, you will bring:

  • A strong track record within a media agency, media AOR, integrated marketing agency, creative agency, marketing services business, consultancy, or adjacent professional services environment.
  • Direct experience originating and closing enterprise-scale engagements, ideally in the $5M to $15M range.
  • Experience selling media, integrated marketing, digital transformation, data, technology, creative, or related services to large and complex organisations.
  • Clear evidence that you have carried your own quota, owned your own pipeline, and built new business yourself rather than relying heavily on inherited opportunities or inbound RFPs.
  • A strong understanding of how media agencies, creative agencies, in-house teams, marketing operations functions, and procurement teams work, including stakeholder dynamics, budget ownership, internal politics, and transformation priorities.

jobs.title: Onboarding Training Facilitator
jobs.excerpt: Wider Circle is looking for a remote Healthcare Onboarding Training Facilitator to join our Learning & Development team on a contract basis.
jobs.description:
Wider Circle is looking for a remote Healthcare Onboarding Training Facilitator to join our Learning & Development team on a contract basis. Right now, that mostly means onboarding non-clinical frontline staff, but the mix of roles you train will shift over time as our hiring needs change. This is a training-delivery role first, built to flex across whichever new hire population needs it most.

Company Overview

Wider Circle is a mission-driven healthcare organization working to improve health outcomes for older adults and complex populations by addressing social and clinical barriers to care. We partner with health plans and providers across the country to run community health programs, connecting members with neighbors and Wider Circle staff who help them stay engaged in care and healthy at home. Our approach has been shown to build trust, improve members' experience, and reduce unnecessary hospital visits — and it's been featured in published health research. Today, Wider Circle runs its programs in hundreds of communities nationwide and serves members and patients both in-person and via telehealth.

About the Role

Training is delivered live over video conference to new hires distributed across the country, so you'll need to be as effective coaching a webcam room as you'd be in person.

Wider Circle's culture and care model are unique, and getting new hires ready to begin working with patients quickly — to a consistent standard — matters directly to patient experience and program outcomes. Most of your time will go toward onboarding Care Navigators, who are Wider Circle's first point of contact with patients. You'll train them to build trust with patients via phone and video interactions, complete health assessments, take clear and consistent notes, and schedule intake appointments. You'll also introduce them to Wider Circle's culture and the tools and systems we use to manage patient interactions.

This is a contract engagement reporting into Wider Circle's Learning & Development team. You'll take existing onboarding curricula and facilitator guides and use them with new hire cohorts — facilitating live remote sessions, managing logistics, grading and coaching, and feeding field-level insight back into the materials themselves. You will be an active partner in improving materials over time by noticing what isn't landing, flagging it, and helping fix it.

What You'll Do

Training Delivery

  • Serve as the face of Wider Circle to incoming new hires as you facilitate live video-based onboarding sessions to distributed new hires introducing health screening scripts, intake workflows, technology tools and systems, HIPAA and consent requirements, and escalation pathways
  • Create a welcoming, engaging, participatory learning environment — role-play calls, coach in real time, and adjust pacing to the cohort in front of you
  • Administer and grade final training assessments and provide clear, actionable feedback on homework and practice assignments
  • Serve as the go-to point of contact for new hires during onboarding — answering questions, troubleshooting confusion, and flagging anyone falling behind before it becomes a problem

Scheduling & Logistics

  • Coordinate training cohort schedules with hiring managers and new hires, working around start dates and staffing needs
  • Own day-to-day logistics for each cohort: calendar invites, session reminders, materials distribution, tool setup and tracking attendance and completion
  • Communicate proactively with managers on cohort progress, readiness, and any scheduling conflicts

Materials & Feedback Loop

  • Distribute training materials, job aids, and assessments to new hires, and keep completion records accurate and audit-ready
  • Build and maintain relationships with hiring managers across the roles you train, actively soliciting their feedback and incorporating it into updates to the relevant training curriculum, scripts, and materials — closing the loop between what's taught and what actually happens on the job

Other Training Programs

  • Take on onboarding delivery for other new hire roles as Wider Circle's hiring needs shift — expect this to be a regular part of the job, not a rare exception
  • Support the wider Learning & Development team with other training program development and delivery as needed — content review, ad hoc facilitation, or logistics for adjacent programs (e.g., Care Advocate onboarding)
  • Bring back patterns and insights from the training room that could improve L&D's broader programs

Requirements

What You Bring

The following are required for this role:

  • Experience facilitating training in a healthcare, call center, care coordination, or comparable regulated environment — you're comfortable with HIPAA and compliance-sensitive content
  • Demonstrated experience delivering live, remote training to new hire cohorts, including role-play, real-time coaching, grading assessments and troubleshooting technical challenges that can arise in remote training environments
  • Strong scheduling and coordination skills — you can juggle multiple cohorts, managers, and calendars without dropping details
  • Comfort giving direct, specific feedback on homework and assessments in a way new hires can act on
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can hold a virtual room, explain a workflow clearly, and write feedback that lands
  • Instructional design experience — you can suggest or draft improvements to materials, not just deliver them as-is – and can work with subject matter experts to turn their knowledge into engaging, interactive training
  • Relationship-building skills: you build trust with managers quickly and know how to solicit honest feedback, not just collect compliments
  • Organized and detail-oriented — accurate attendance, completion, and assessment records matter here
  • Comfortable with LMS platforms (we use TalentLMS) and standard tools like Slack and Google Suite; able to learn Healthie or similar care platforms
  • Ability to work independently and manage your own schedule in a remote, fast-changing environment
  • Comfortable ramping up on and delivering training for a new role's curriculum on relatively short notice

Bonus Points For

  • Prior experience as a Care Navigator, Community Health Worker, or other frontline patient/member-facing role at a health care organization
  • Familiarity with value-based care, social determinants of health, or care coordination workflows
  • Experience working in a start-up environment where processes and roles evolve quickly
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish or another language relevant to Wider Circle's member population)

Ideal Candidate

    • Cares about setting new hires up to succeed, not just getting them through a checklist
    • Builds trust quickly — with new hires in the training and with managers on the other side of the feedback loop
    • Notices when something isn't working and says so, rather than waiting to be asked
    • Comfortable holding people to a standard while still being encouraging and approachable
    • Organized enough to run multiple cohorts and manager relationships at once without things slipping

Benefits

  • Rate: $30–35/hour
  • Type: Independent contractor, 1099
  • Location: Remote (U.S.)
  • Hours: 30–40/week
  • Duration: Three months, with potential to renew as a contractor or convert to employee status depending on performance and business needs
  • Reports to: Learning & Development team
  • Partners with: Hiring managers across onboarding roles, Care Delivery Operations

jobs.excerpt: REPORTS TO Head of Growth & Ecommerce LOCATION Remote TYPE Full-time · no direct reports Why this role existsAt BioTRUST, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier, more vibrant lives — and our website is how most of them find us.
jobs.description:
REPORTS TO Head of Growth & Ecommerce

LOCATION Remote

TYPE Full-time · no direct reports

Why this role exists

At BioTRUST, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier, more vibrant lives — and our website is how most of them find us. Nearly all of our revenue runs through BioTRUST.com and our landing pages, and today that entire surface sits with one person. We’re rebuilding the function around a different idea: one strong technical operator inside the company, supported by contracted development for the work that genuinely needs engineers. We’re looking for a Technical Ecommerce Manager to be that operator. You know Shopify inside and out, you would rather fix the thing than file a ticket about it, and you can tell a configuration problem from a code problem in minutes. Just as importantly, you’re genuinely curious about the positive impact nutrition and healthy aging can have on people’s lives and you’re excited to help build it. You’ll be the single front door for everything on our site — building pages and funnels, running the request queue, protecting site health, and deciding what is worth sending to developers. It’s hands-on work with real ownership and very little bureaucracy between you and shipping something. Let’s build something great together.

What you will do

  • Site operations. Product pages, collections, homepage, promotions. You build them, schedule them, and verify they actually went live the way they were supposed to.
  • Landers and funnels. We build landing pages through an automated pipeline. You will write the specs it builds from, QA in staging, publish, and keep the record of what we tested and what won.
  • Checkout and subscription. Our subscription program runs on Recharge. You will own plan setup, customer-facing flows, and a weekly watch on payment failures and declines.
  • The technical stack. Theme, apps, integrations, tracking. You fix what is configuration and write the spec for what is code.
  • Triage and project management. Customer Service, Brand and Product all need things from the site, and every request comes to you — you reproduce it, classify it, and either resolve it or route it. Nothing reaches our development partner without going through you first. The whole queue lives in Notion: requests logged and triaged, specs written where developers can find them, a visible priority order and release calendar, and stack documentation kept current — so anyone who asked for something can see where it stands without asking you again.
  • Vendor management. You manage our development support — reviewing estimates, tracking hours, holding them to their response times, and catching scope creep before it is billed.
  • Site health. A monthly review: speed, error rates, conversion by funnel step, things quietly broken. Nobody else is watching.

One thing to know going in

A site relaunch is on the horizon

This role will be central to it. That is the best part of the job and the hardest part of the job, and we would rather you know now than find out in week three.

It also shapes who we are looking for: we need someone who has been through a relaunch, replatform or major redesign before — not observing it, doing it. We will ask you to walk us through one.

What you need to be able to do

Hands-on technical

  • Read and edit Liquid — templates, sections, snippets. Build a new section by adapting an existing one, and debug why one is not rendering.
  • Confident HTML and CSS. Fix a broken layout, adjust responsive breakpoints, restyle a component
  • Intermediate JavaScript — read existing scripts, write small vanilla JS, debug console errors.
  • Shopify theme architecture — sections, blocks, schema, JSON templates, theme settings.
  • Basic Git — branch, commit, read a diff, revert.
  • Browser devtools — inspect, console, network tab, and run a Lighthouse audit you can act on.

Platform

  • Shopify admin at expert level — products, variants, metafields, automated collections, markets, navigation, redirects.
  • A subscription platform at configuration level (Recharge preferred): plan setup, swaps, skip and pause logic, dunning and failed-payment flows, the customer portal.
  • Discounts and checkout configuration — including a clear sense of what cannot be changed without a developer, so you do not promise things we cannot do.
  • App stack management — install, configure, audit. Spot when two apps conflict, and spot the ones injecting scripts and slowing the site down.

Data and tracking

  • Google Tag Manager — build and debug tags, triggers and variables. Fluent in preview mode.
  • GA4 — set up events, build a funnel exploration, and recognize when the data itself has broken.
  • Verify Meta pixel and CAPI are firing correctly, and understand deduplication.

Project and vendor

  • Write a spec a developer can build from
  • Build and run workflows in Notion — databases, views, templates and dashboards for intake, prioritization, release tracking and documentation. Comparable tools count (Asana, Jira, Linear, ClickUp) if you can show a workflow you designed and other people actually used.
  • Manage a development partner — review estimates, track hours against a retainer, enforce response times.
  • Own a QA checklist, and hold a release when it fails.
  • Coordinate across Growth, Customer Service, Brand and Product team members.

Experience

  • 3+ years running a Shopify store day to day in a direct-to-consumer business. Shopify Plus preferred.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with a subscription platform.

Nice to have

  • Supplements, health or wellness category experience.
  • A CRO or experimentation background.
  • SQL, or comfort reconciling numbers across systems that disagree.
  • Experience working alongside an automated build or deployment pipeline.

What this job is not

  • Not a software engineering role. You will not build applications or work on infrastructure.
  • Not a design role. You will implement and improve, not art-direct.
  • Not a marketing strategy role. You will partner closely with Growth, who set the offers and the angles.
  • Not a management role. No direct reports today. You will manage a vendor, not people.

What You Bring

  • A self-starter’s instinct. No one is going to hand you a prioritized list. You decide what matters first, keep several things moving at once, and are comfortable working in an environment where the plan changes.
  • Serious organizational skills. Requests, specs, releases and deadlines arrive from Growth, Customer Service, Brand and Product at the same time. You keep all of it moving without anything quietly falling off the list.
  • Clear, direct communication. You set expectations, tell people what is and is not possible, and can explain a technical constraint to someone non-technical without making them feel lost.
  • Comfort with data, and the instinct to reach for it. You look at conversion, error rates and funnel numbers before deciding what to change, and you let what you find guide the next move.
  • A willingness to help and learn. We are a small and mighty team, so the edges of this job move. You will pick up tools and systems you have not used before because someone has to — and you would rather learn it than wait for it.

Key Skills

Attention to detail

Communication & collaboration

Analytical thinking

Time management

At Wellbeam Consumer Health, we are inspired by our consumer. We are creating the leading ecommerce-focused consumer wellness business, delivering value-added products that help people thrive. We’re focused on dramatically accelerating existing brands as well as adding select, new digitally-native consumer wellness brands.

The current Wellbeam portfolio includes Eu Natural, a digitally-native provider of vitamin and mineral nutritional supplements; Penetrex, a leading joint & muscle relief and recovery brand; TruSkin, a leading skincare brand with a range of high quality, plant-powered products including the #1 best-selling facial serum on Amazon; and BioTRUST Nutrition, a fast-growing, leading eCommerce, nutrition brand with a portfolio of premium-quality, science-based products that focuses on making health living and health aging more accessible and enjoyable. Wellbeam is backed by American Pacific Group.

jobs.description:
A FCamara está em busca de um(a) profissional que possua um forte conhecimento técnico em desenvolvimento de software, especialmente em C#, e que seja capaz de aplicar esse conhecimento para projetar e implementar soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e seguras. A capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e resolução de problemas também são essenciais para o sucesso nesta função.

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Justificar a escolha dos padrões em relação aos requisitos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender ao requisito de não indisponibilidade do serviço de controle de lançamentos em caso de falha do consolidado diário.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas de integração adequadas e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Analisar a qualidade da divisão do sistema em partes menores e gerenciáveis.

➢ Abstrair e segregar responsabilidades entre as camadas.

Implementação:

➢ Garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Solid, Clean Code, etc).

➢ Escrever código legível, organizado e de fácil manutenção.

➢ Utilizar a linguagem C# de forma eficiente.

➢ Implementar testes com boa cobertura, qualidade e relevância.

➢ Cumprir os requisitos técnicos obrigatórios.

➢ Atender aos requisitos de negócio.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura.

➢ Justificar as decisões arquiteturais.

➢ Definir os fluxos de dados.

➢ Escrever instruções claras e detalhadas de como a aplicação funciona e como rodar localmente (Readme).

➢ Centralizar documentações.

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões do sistema.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Diferenciais e Boas Práticas:

➢ Garantir que o código seja executado de forma local e sem erros.

➢ Utilizar estratégias de Docker e Docker Compose.

➢ Implementar pipeline automatizada (CI/CD).

➢ Utilizar estratégias de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).

➢ Realizar estimativas de custos.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade ➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em design e implementação de arquiteturas de software escaláveis, resilientes e seguras.

➢ Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software utilizando a linguagem C#.

➢ Experiência com a aplicação de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, etc.).

➢ Experiência com a implementação de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc.).

➢ Experiência com padrões de arquitetura (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento da linguagem C# e do ecossistema .NET.

➢ Sólido conhecimento de padrões de design de software (Design Patterns).

➢ Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum, Kanban).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).

➢ Familiaridade com metodologias de testes (TDD, BDD).

➢ Familiaridade com Docker e Docker Compose.

➢ Conhecimento de CI/CD (Integração Contínua / Entrega Contínua).

➢ Conhecimento de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).

Habilidades:

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe.

➢ Habilidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas complexos.

➢ Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Habilidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias e ferramentas.
